sentences: I saw an old man sitting on a wooden bench. 我看到一位老人坐在木凳上。
It takes about an hour to get there by bus. 搭公車去那裡大約需要一小時。

meaning: 一種表面粗糙、多孔的熔岩（夏威夷地質術語）
sentences: The geologist carefully walked across the aa, which cut through her boots with its jagged edges. 地質學家小心地走過這片粗熔岩，鋒利的邊緣割破了她的靴子。
Unlike smooth pahoehoe, aa lava forms a rough, clinkery surface as it cools. 不像平滑的繩狀熔岩，粗熔岩冷卻後形成粗糙的礫狀表面。

meaning: 印度茜草植物，其根可用於製作紅色染料
sentences: Traders valued aal for the red dye extracted from its roots. 商人們非常看重印度茜草，因為其根部可以提取紅色染料。
The textile artisan soaked the cloth in aal dye to achieve a rich crimson hue. 紡織工匠將布料浸泡在茜草染料中，以獲得濃郁的深紅色調。

meaning: 夏威夷原生灌木或小喬木，木質堅硬，常見於乾燥地區
sentences: The aalii shrub is remarkably drought-resistant and thrives on the dry slopes of Hawaiian mountains. 夏威夷灌木非常耐旱，在夏威夷山脈的乾燥坡地上生長茂盛。
Native Hawaiians used the hard wood of the aalii to make tools and weapons. 夏威夷原住民用這種灌木的堅硬木材製作工具和武器。

meaning: 荷蘭液體計量單位，約等於四十一加侖
sentences: The brewer bought one aam of cider for the tavern. 釀酒師為酒館買了一阿姆（荷蘭舊液量單位）的蘋果酒。
They measured the oil by the aam. 他們以阿姆這個荷蘭舊液量單位計量油量。

meaning: 阿尼（埃及神話中與托特相關的狒狒神）
sentences: Aani is often depicted as a baboon in ancient Egyptian texts. 阿尼在古埃及文本中通常被描繪成一隻狒狒。
The god Aani was associated with the scribal arts. 阿尼神與書寫藝術有關。

meaning: 土豚，一種非洲大型夜行性穴居哺乳動物，以螞蟻和白蟻為食
sentences: The aardvark uses its long sticky tongue to extract termites from deep within their mound. 土豚用長而黏的舌頭從白蟻丘深處舔食白蟻。
Spotting an aardvark in the wild is rare because they are nocturnal and very shy. 在野外發現土豚是很罕見的，因為牠們是夜行性且非常害羞的動物。

meaning: 土狼，一種非洲夜行性哺乳動物，外形像鬣狗，主要以白蟻為食
sentences: Unlike its hyena relatives, the aardwolf feeds mainly on termites rather than large prey. 與鬣狗的親緣動物不同，土狼主要以白蟻為食，而非大型獵物。
The aardwolf's striped coat provides camouflage among the dry grasslands of Africa. 土狼的條紋皮毛在非洲乾燥草原中提供了良好的偽裝。

meaning: 亞倫（人名，聖經中摩西的哥哥）
sentences: Aaron was the first High Priest of the Israelites. 亞倫是以色列人的第一位大祭司。
The rod of Aaron famously sprouted blossoms. 亞倫的杖神奇地開了花。
The Aaronic priesthood is a significant concept in some religious traditions. 亞倫祭司職位在某些宗教傳統中是一個重要的概念。
He studied the Aaronic blessing found in the scriptures. 他研究了聖經中的亞倫式祝福。
The garment had an Aaronical style according to the historical description. 根據歷史描述，這件衣服具有亞倫祭司式的風格。
They discussed the Aaronical duties within the temple. 他們討論了聖殿內的亞倫祭司職責。

meaning: 亞倫的後裔；亞倫支派成員
sentences: The Aaronites were tasked with maintaining the tabernacle. 亞倫的後裔負責維護帳幕。
Historically, an Aaronite held special status in the community. 歷史上，亞倫的後裔在社區中擁有特殊地位。
The text refers to Aaronitic lineages throughout history. 文本提到了歷史上的亞倫後裔血統。
They explored Aaronitic traditions in the ancient Levant. 他們探索了古代黎凡特的亞倫傳統。

meaning: 雅盧（埃及神話中的蘆葦原，死後居住之地）
sentences: The righteous souls were said to reside in Aaru. 正義的靈魂據說居住在雅盧。
Aaru is the heavenly paradise of ancient Egyptian religion. 雅盧是古埃及宗教的天堂。
He has a six-pack of abs. 他有六塊腹肌。
Ab is a common nickname. 阿布是一個常見的暱稱。

meaning: 阿拉伯長袍，一種用粗羊毛製成的寬鬆外袍，在中東地區穿著
sentences: The elder wrapped himself in a traditional aba to keep warm during the desert night. 老人裹上一件傳統長袍，在沙漠夜晚保暖。
The merchant sold finely woven aba cloth in the bazaar to travelers passing through. 商人在市集中向過路旅人販售精織的阿拉伯長袍布料。

meaning: 阿巴布達人（居住在埃及和蘇丹之間的游牧民族）
sentences: The Ababdeh people have lived in the Eastern Desert for centuries. 阿巴布達人已在東部沙漠居住了幾個世紀。
An Ababdeh guide helped the explorers navigate the dry terrain. 一名阿巴布達嚮導幫助探險者在乾旱的地形中穿行。

meaning: 阿巴巴人（剛果民主共和國的一個族群）
sentences: The Ababua live primarily in the northern regions of the country. 阿巴巴人主要居住在該國的北部地區。
Traditional Ababua music is a subject of anthropological study. 傳統的阿巴巴音樂是人類學研究的主題。

meaning: 列線圖，一種以多條曲線表達數學關係的圖表，用於工程計算
sentences: Engineers in the early twentieth century relied on the abac to solve complex equations quickly. 二十世紀初的工程師依靠列線圖快速解決複雜方程式。
The abac allowed pilots to calculate fuel consumption without a computer. 列線圖讓飛行員無需電腦即可計算燃油消耗。

meaning: 馬尼拉麻，一種產自菲律賓的芭蕉科植物，其纖維用於製作繩索和紙張
sentences: Abaca fiber is prized for its strength and is widely used in making ropes for ships. 馬尼拉麻纖維以其強韌著稱，被廣泛用於製造船用繩索。
The Philippines is the world's largest producer of abaca, supplying fibers to global markets. 菲律賓是全球最大的馬尼拉麻生產國，向全球市場供應纖維。

meaning: 酪梨（古老或葡萄牙語用語）
sentences: She sliced an abacate into her salad. 她把一顆酪梨切進沙拉裡。
The vendor sold abacate at the market. 攤販在市場賣酪梨。

meaning: 南美洲的一種鸚鵡（古老用語）
sentences: Early explorers recorded sighting the colorful abacay among the tropical trees of South America. 早期探險家記錄了在南美洲熱帶樹木間發現這種色彩鮮艷的鸚鵡。
The abacay was captured and sold as a prized exotic bird in European markets. 這種南美鸚鵡被捕捉，作為珍貴的異國鳥類在歐洲市場出售。

meaning: 以燒紅的金屬置於眼前使人失明（古代刑罰動詞）
sentences: The history book said the ruler would abacinate prisoners. 歷史書說那位統治者會用酷刑使囚犯失明。
The class discussed why no one should abacinate another person. 全班討論為什麼不該用酷刑使人失明。

meaning: 以燒紅金屬致盲的古代刑罰行為
sentences: Abacination was used in ancient times as a punishment reserved for political rivals. 致盲刑罰在古代被用來懲處政治對手。
The chronicle recorded abacination as one of the cruelest methods employed by the emperor against rebels. 年代記記載了致盲刑罰是皇帝對付叛亂者所使用的最殘忍手段之一。

meaning: 小型馬賽克磚片；鑲嵌藝術中使用的小方塊石片
sentences: The craftsman carefully placed each abaciscus to form the detailed mosaic floor of the palace. 工匠小心地放置每塊小馬賽克磚，拼出宮殿精緻的地板圖案。
Thousands of abaciscus tiles were required to complete the intricate Roman mosaic. 需要數千塊小石片才能完成這幅複雜的羅馬鑲嵌畫。

meaning: 擅長使用算盤的人；算盤計算師
sentences: The merchant hired a skilled abacist to manage the accounts of his trading company. 商人聘用了一位技術熟練的算盤師來管理其貿易公司的帳目。
Before calculators were invented, a trained abacist could perform complex arithmetic at remarkable speed. 在計算機發明之前，受過訓練的算盤師可以以驚人的速度進行複雜的算術。

meaning: 向後；措手不及，感到吃驚
sentences: She was taken aback by the sudden announcement of her promotion. 她對突然宣布的晉升感到措手不及。
The wind caught the sail aback and forced the ship to slow down sharply. 風吹到帆的反面，迫使船急速減速。

meaning: （棘皮動物）背向口面的，位於口面相反側的
sentences: The abactinal surface of the sea star is typically rough and covered with small spines. 海星背口面通常粗糙，並覆蓋著小刺。
Researchers examined the abactinal side of the urchin to study its dorsal features. 研究人員檢查了海膽的背口面，以研究其背側特徵。

meaning: 在棘皮動物背口面方向地
sentences: The tube feet extend abactinally along the upper surface of certain echinoderms. 管足在某些棘皮動物的背口面沿上表面延伸。
The scientist noted that pigmentation was distributed abactinally across the specimen. 科學家注意到色素沉積沿著標本的背口面分布。

meaning: 大規模牲畜盜竊；搶劫家畜（古老法律用語）
sentences: Abaction was considered a serious crime in ancient Rome, punishable by severe penalties. 大規模牲畜盜竊在古羅馬被視為嚴重罪行，可處以嚴厲懲罰。
The frontier settlers reported multiple incidents of abaction, losing entire herds overnight. 邊境定居者報告了多起大規模牲畜盜竊事件，一夜之間失去了整群牲畜。

meaning: 牲畜竊賊；大規模盜竊家畜的人
sentences: The sheriff organized a posse to track down the abactor who stole fifty horses from the valley. 警長組織了一支巡邏隊，追捕從山谷偷走五十匹馬的牲畜竊賊。
In Roman law, an abactor was distinguished from a common thief by the scale of the livestock stolen. 在羅馬法律中，牲畜竊賊因盜竊牲畜的規模而有別於普通小偷。

meaning: 小型鑲嵌石片；用於馬賽克的小方塊
sentences: The restorer matched each abaculus by color and size to repair the ancient mosaic floor. 修復師按顏色和尺寸配對每塊小石片，修復古代馬賽克地板。
Hundreds of abaculus pieces were found scattered across the excavation site. 在挖掘現場發現了數百塊散落的小石片。

meaning: 算盤。傳統的計算工具，常用來進行加減乘除等珠算運算。
sentences: The teacher used an abacus to show the students how old methods of calculation worked. 老師用算盤向學生展示傳統計算方式如何運作。
The small shop owner still keeps an abacus beside the cash register. 那位小店老闆仍在收銀機旁放著一個算盤。

meaning: 阿巴德派（伊斯蘭教哈瓦利吉派的分支，通常指伊巴德派）
sentences: The Abadite sect has a strong presence in Oman. 阿巴德派在阿曼有很強的影響力。
They studied the theological differences of the Abadite movement. 他們研究了阿巴德派運動的神學差異。

meaning: 在船尾方向；位於船的後部（古老航海用語）
sentences: The captain ordered the crew to stow the cargo abaff to improve the ship's balance. 船長命令船員將貨物存放在船尾處，以改善船的平衡。
The lookout spotted the approaching vessel abaff the main mast. 瞭望員在主桅杆後方發現了接近的船隻。

meaning: 在船尾方向；位於或朝向船的後部
sentences: The lifeboat was stored abaft the main mast, ready for emergency use. 救生艇存放在主桅杆後方，隨時備用。
The wind was blowing abaft the beam, filling the sails perfectly. 風從側後方吹來，完美地填滿了風帆。

meaning: 鞠躬；敬禮；表示尊敬的姿態（古語）
sentences: The courtier made a deep abaisance before presenting the letter to the queen. 廷臣在將信件呈遞給女王之前，深深地鞠了一躬。
Visitors to the temple were expected to perform an abaisance upon entering the sacred hall. 進入神聖大廳的訪客須在入內時行禮致敬。

meaning: 象牙黑顏料；一種由燒焦象牙或骨頭製成的黑色顏料
sentences: Renaissance painters used abaiser to create deep, rich blacks in their oil paintings. 文藝復興時期的畫家使用象牙黑顏料在油畫中創造深邃濃郁的黑色。
The restorer identified abaiser as the pigment used in the darkest areas of the old masterpiece. 修復師確認在這幅古老傑作最暗的部分所使用的顏料是象牙黑。
The coat of arms featured an eagle abaissed, with its wings lowered in a position of humility. 這個紋章上有一隻翅膀向下垂放的老鷹，展示謙遜的姿態。
The herald described the bird on the shield as abaissed, distinguishing it from a flying pose. 紋章官將盾牌上的鳥描述為翅膀下垂的，以區別於飛翔的姿態。

meaning: 將財產或權利轉讓給他人；讓渡（法律古語）
sentences: The family chose to abalienate the land to a relative. 那家人選擇把土地讓渡給親戚。
The lawyer explained how to abalienate the property. 律師說明如何讓渡財產。

meaning: 財產或權利的轉讓；讓渡行為（法律古語）
sentences: The abalienation of the family land was recorded in the official legal documents of the estate. 家族土地的轉讓記錄在莊園的官方法律文件中。
Abalienation in Roman law required witnesses and a formal declaration before the transfer was valid. 羅馬法律中的財產讓渡需要見證人和正式聲明才能使轉讓生效。
Abalone is considered a luxury delicacy in many Asian cultures. 在許多亞洲文化中，鮑魚被視為一種奢華的佳餚。
The divers went deep into the ocean to collect wild abalone. 潛水員深入海中採集野生鮑魚。

meaning: 阿巴馬（位於奈及利亞的一條河流或地區名）
sentences: The explorers reached the banks of the Abama. 探險者到達了阿巴馬河岸。
Abama is known for its local agricultural production. 阿巴馬以其當地的農業生產而聞名。

meaning: 安培（CGS單位制中的電流單位，等於十安培）
sentences: The abampere is defined as the current that produces a force of two dynes per centimeter between parallel conductors. 安培被定義為在平行導體之間每公分產生兩達因力的電流。
In modern physics, the abampere has been largely replaced by the SI unit of ampere. 在現代物理學中，CGS安培已基本上被國際單位制的安培所取代。
The sailors had to abandon the sinking ship during the storm. 水手們在風暴期間不得不放棄那艘正在下沉的船。
It was a difficult decision to abandon the project after years. 經過多年後決定放棄（停止）這個專案是一個艱難的決定。
The legal team debated whether the contract was abandonable under the terms agreed upon. 法律團隊討論了在已商定的條款下該合約是否可以被放棄。
Not all responsibilities are abandonable; some obligations must be honored regardless of circumstances. 並非所有責任都可以被放棄；有些義務無論情況如何都必須履行。
They found an abandoned kitten in the park and took it home. 他們在公園裡發現了一隻被遺棄的小貓，並把它帶回家。
The old factory has been abandoned for over a decade. 這座舊工廠已經被廢棄超過十年了。

meaning: 以放縱或無拘無束的方式；肆無忌憚地
sentences: He laughed abandonedly at the absurd situation, releasing all his pent-up stress. 他對這荒唐的情形放聲大笑，釋放了所有積累的壓力。
The children danced abandonedly in the rain, not caring about getting wet. 孩子們在雨中無拘無束地跳舞，完全不在乎淋濕。

meaning: 被讓渡財產的人；在保險法中指接受棄船權的保險人
sentences: In maritime law, the abandonee receives ownership of the ship after the insurer pays out the claim. 在海事法律中，被讓渡人在保險人理賠後獲得船隻的所有權。
The court ruled that the abandonee had the right to salvage the cargo from the wrecked vessel. 法院裁定被讓渡人有權從失事船隻中打撈貨物。

meaning: 遺棄者；放棄或拋棄他人或責任的人
sentences: The abandoner of the project left the team without clear direction or resources. 放棄這個專案的人讓團隊失去了明確的方向和資源。
Society often judges an abandoner harshly, especially when family members are left behind. 社會通常對遺棄者給予嚴厲評判，尤其是當家庭成員被拋棄時。

meaning: 自願離開與其有特殊關係的人，例如妻子、丈夫或孩子；遺棄。
sentences: Since he left her, she's suing him for divorce on grounds of abandonment. 自從他離開她後，她以遺棄為由起訴他離婚。
The term abandonment refers to the voluntary leaving of a person to whom one is bound by a special relation, as a wife, husband or child; desertion. 遺棄一詞是指自願離開與某人有特殊關係的人，例如妻子、丈夫或孩子；遺棄。

meaning: 阿巴尼克的（與特定歷史或地理實體有關）
sentences: The researchers examined the Abanic artifacts in detail. 研究人員詳細檢查了阿巴尼克的文物。
The Abanic culture is relatively obscure in mainstream history. 阿巴尼克文化在主流歷史中相對模糊。

meaning: 阿班忒斯人（古希臘優卑亞島的古代居民）
sentences: The Abantes were known for their unique hairstyle in battle. 阿班忒斯人因其戰鬥中獨特的髮型而聞名。
Homer mentions the Abantes in the Iliad. 荷馬在《伊利亞特》中提到了阿班忒斯人。

meaning: 一種不會刺穿腦膜的外科鑽顱器
sentences: The surgeon used an abaptiston to carefully open the skull without damaging the underlying brain tissue. 外科醫生使用這種特殊鑽顱器小心地打開頭骨，而不損傷下方的腦組織。
The invention of the abaptiston improved the safety of ancient skull surgeries significantly. 這種安全鑽顱器的發明顯著提高了古代開顱手術的安全性。

meaning: 阿巴蘭博人（剛果東北部的一個民族）
sentences: The Abarambo territory lies near the Uele River. 阿巴蘭博人的領土位於韋萊河附近。
The Abarambo are skilled in local crafts and agriculture. 阿巴蘭博人精通當地的手工藝 and 農業。

meaning: 阿巴里斯（希臘神話中阿波羅的祭司）
sentences: Abaris was said to have flown on a golden arrow. 據說阿巴里斯騎著金箭飛行。
The legends of Abaris emphasize his wisdom and mystical powers. 阿巴里斯的傳說強調了他的智慧和神秘力量。

meaning: 可動關節；允許廣泛活動的關節（醫學術語）
sentences: The knee is an example of abarthrosis, allowing significant flexion and extension movements. 膝蓋是可動關節的例子，允許大幅度的屈伸運動。
Physical therapists focus on preserving abarthrosis function to maintain patients' mobility. 物理治療師專注於維持可動關節的功能，以保持患者的活動能力。

meaning: 不涉及關節的；關節外的（醫學術語）
sentences: The doctor confirmed that the pain was abarticular, meaning it did not originate from the joint itself. 醫生確認疼痛是關節外的，意味著它並非源自關節本身。
Abarticular disorders often affect the muscles and tendons surrounding a joint rather than the joint directly. 關節外疾患通常影響關節周圍的肌肉和肌腱，而非直接影響關節。

meaning: 可動關節；關節的廣泛活動（醫學術語）
sentences: Abarticulation of the shoulder joint allows the arm to rotate in nearly all directions. 肩關節的廣泛活動使手臂幾乎可以向各個方向旋轉。
Injury to the abarticulation can severely limit a person's range of motion and daily activities. 可動關節受傷可能嚴重限制一個人的活動範圍和日常活動。

meaning: 阿拉伯長袍的複數形式；多件寬鬆羊毛長袍
sentences: The merchants displayed their finest abas at the market, attracting buyers from distant lands. 商人們在市場展示最好的阿拉伯長袍，吸引來自遠方的買家。
The travelers wrapped themselves in warm abas to protect against the cold desert night. 旅行者們裹上溫暖的長袍，抵禦寒冷的沙漠夜晚。

meaning: 貶低；使降格；損害尊嚴或地位
sentences: He refused to abase himself by begging for forgiveness from someone who treated him so poorly. 他拒絕向那個對他如此惡劣的人卑躬屈膝地請求原諒。
Bullies often abase others to feel a false sense of power and superiority. 霸凌者常常貶低他人，以獲得一種虛假的權力感和優越感。

meaning: 被貶低的；降格的；喪失尊嚴的
sentences: He walked away feeling abased after being publicly criticized in front of his colleagues. 在同事面前公開受到批評後，他滿懷屈辱地走開了。
The abased servant bowed his head and silently accepted the unjust punishment. 這名被輕視的僕人低下頭，默默接受了不公正的懲罰。

meaning: 以屈辱或卑微的方式；帶著羞恥地
sentences: He abasedly apologized for the mistake, unable to meet anyone's eyes in the room. 他羞愧地道歉，無法與房間裡任何人的目光相對。
She spoke abasedly, fully aware that her actions had disappointed everyone around her. 她帶著屈辱地說話，完全意識到自己的行為讓周圍所有人失望了。

meaning: 屈辱的狀態；卑微或貶低的狀況
sentences: The abasedness she felt after the public humiliation took months to overcome. 她在公開羞辱後感受到的屈辱感花了幾個月才得以克服。
His abasedness was evident in his slumped posture and avoidance of eye contact. 他的屈辱感從他彎腰駝背的姿態和迴避目光接觸中清晰可見。

meaning: 貶低；羞辱；降低地位或尊嚴的行為
sentences: The public abasement of the official was seen as an act of political revenge by his opponents. 這名官員公開受到貶低被其對手視為政治報復的行為。
She endured years of abasement before finally finding the courage to leave the toxic environment. 她忍受了多年的貶辱，最終才鼓起勇氣離開那個有毒的環境。

meaning: 貶低者；羞辱他人或使人降格的人
sentences: The abaser used every opportunity to undermine his colleague's confidence and reputation. 這個貶低者利用每一個機會來削弱同事的信心和名譽。
History has not been kind to the abaser who humiliated the great artist during his lifetime. 歷史對那個在世時羞辱偉大藝術家的人並不寬容。

meaning: 阿巴斯吉人（古代高加索地區阿布哈茲人的先祖）
sentences: The Abasgi lived along the eastern coast of the Black Sea. 阿巴斯吉人居住在黑海東岸。
Historical records describe the Abasgi as a fierce tribe. 歷史記錄將阿巴斯吉人描述為一個兇猛的部落。
His unexpected question managed to abash even the most experienced debater in the room. 他出乎意料的問題甚至讓房間裡最有經驗的辯手感到尷尬。
Nothing could abash her once she had made up her mind to speak the truth. 一旦她下定決心說出真相，任何事都無法讓她感到羞愧。
He felt abashed by his sudden outburst of anger. 他對自己突然爆發的憤怒感到羞愧。
She looked abashed when she realized she had made a mistake. 當她意識到自己犯了錯時，看起來有些尷尬。

meaning: 以尷尬或羞愧的方式；帶著困窘地
sentences: He abashedly admitted that he had forgotten their anniversary, hoping she would forgive him. 他尷尬地承認忘記了他們的週年紀念日，希望她能原諒他。
She abashedly looked down at her shoes when the teacher read her poor test result aloud. 當老師大聲讀出她糟糕的考試成績時，她羞愧地低頭看著自己的鞋子。

meaning: 羞愧或尷尬的狀態；困窘
sentences: His abashedness was clear from the way he stammered and avoided answering the question directly. 他的羞愧從他結結巴巴、避免直接回答問題的方式中清晰可見。
A moment of abashedness passed over her face when she realized she had called him by the wrong name. 當她意識到叫錯了他的名字時，她臉上閃過一絲尷尬。

meaning: 不感到羞恥的；厚顏無恥的；不知羞愧的
sentences: The abashless politician continued to make bold claims despite being caught in several lies. 這個厚顏無恥的政治人物儘管多次被發現撒謊，仍繼續大膽地提出主張。
Her abashless confidence in the face of criticism inspired others who struggled with self-doubt. 她面對批評時毫不羞愧的自信激勵了那些在自我懷疑中掙扎的人。

meaning: 毫無羞恥地；厚顏無恥地
sentences: He abashlessly took credit for work that his teammates had spent weeks completing. 他毫無羞恥地為隊友花了數週完成的工作搶功。
She abashlessly wore the outrageous outfit to the conservative event, turning every head in the room. 她毫無顧忌地穿著那套誇張的服裝出席保守派活動，吸引了房間裡每個人的目光。

meaning: 羞愧；尷尬；因困窘而產生的不安感
sentences: A wave of abashment washed over him when he tripped on stage in front of the entire audience. 當他在全體觀眾面前在舞台上絆倒時，一陣羞愧感湧上心頭。
She hid her abashment behind a forced smile and quickly changed the subject. 她用勉強的微笑掩藏自己的尷尬，並迅速轉移了話題。

meaning: 步行不能症；因肌肉協調失調而無法正常行走的醫學狀況
sentences: The neurologist diagnosed the patient with abasia after observing his inability to walk steadily. 神經科醫師觀察到患者無法穩定行走後，診斷其患有步行不能症。
Abasia can result from damage to the cerebellum, which controls movement coordination. 步行不能症可能源於控制運動協調的小腦受損。

meaning: 與步行不能症相關的；患有步行不能症的
sentences: The abasic patient required a wheelchair to move around the hospital ward. 這名步行不能症患者需要輪椅在病房中移動。
Abasic symptoms often improve with targeted physical therapy and neurological treatment. 步行不能症的症狀通常可透過針對性的物理治療和神經科治療而改善。

meaning: 沐浴在溫暖或陽光中（古語，通常指曬太陽）
sentences: The cat lay abask in the warm afternoon sunlight streaming through the window. 貓咪躺在從窗戶透進來的溫暖午後陽光中享受日曬。
He sat abask on the porch, soaking in the gentle rays of the spring sun. 他坐在門廊上，沐浴在春日溫柔的陽光中。

meaning: 阿比西尼亞的；衣索比亞的
sentences: The Abassin empire was once a major power in the Horn of Africa. 阿比西尼亞帝國曾是非洲角的主要勢力。
The traveler admired the Abassin landscapes. 旅客欣賞了阿比西尼亞的風景。

meaning: 使墮落；使變質；使失去純正性（古語）
sentences: Critics argued that commercial pressures would abastardize the original artistic vision of the film. 批評者認為商業壓力會使這部電影最初的藝術願景變質。
Excessive foreign borrowing may abastardize a language's natural development over time. 過度的外來借詞可能使一種語言的自然發展逐漸失去純正性。

meaning: 可減輕的；可廢除的；可平息的（法律或一般用語）
sentences: The lawyer argued that the nuisance was abatable and proposed a settlement plan. 律師主張這項妨害行為是可以消除的，並提出了和解方案。
With proper medication, the patient's fever was abatable within a few hours. 透過適當用藥，患者的發燒可在幾小時內退去。

meaning: 減輕；減退；平息；降低強度
sentences: The storm began to abate in the early morning, allowing the rescue teams to move in. 暴風雨在清晨開始減弱，讓救援隊得以進入。
Her anger slowly abated as she listened to his sincere apology. 隨著她聆聽他真誠的道歉，她的憤怒慢慢平息了。

meaning: 減輕；降低；（法律上）廢除或減免
sentences: The city offered a tax abatement to businesses that relocated to the underdeveloped district. 市政府為遷移到欠發達地區的企業提供稅收減免。
Residents demanded abatement of the noise pollution coming from the nearby construction site. 居民要求減少附近施工現場造成的噪音污染。

meaning: 使事物減輕或平息的人或物
sentences: The new regulation served as an effective abater of industrial emissions in the region. 這項新法規有效地減少了該地區的工業排放。
Meditation is known to be a natural abater of stress and anxiety. 冥想被認為是減輕壓力和焦慮的天然方式。

meaning: 鹿砦；由砍倒的樹木組成的軍事障礙物，尖端朝向敵方
sentences: The soldiers built an abatis from fallen trees to slow the enemy's advance. 士兵們用倒下的樹木築起鹿砦，以阻緩敵人的推進。
The abatis proved effective in channeling the attacking force into a narrow corridor. 鹿砦有效地將攻擊部隊引導至一條狹窄的通道。

meaning: 設有鹿砦防禦的；以砍倒樹木加固的
sentences: The abatised perimeter of the fort made any direct assault extremely dangerous. 堡壘設有鹿砦的外圍使任何正面攻擊都極為危險。
The commander ordered the abatised defenses to be reinforced overnight. 指揮官下令連夜加強設有鹿砦的防禦工事。

meaning: 古希臘神廟中禁止一般人進入的聖所，供信徒在其中接受神諭或療癒
sentences: Pilgrims would sleep in the abaton of the healing shrine, hoping for a dream that would cure their illness. 朝聖者會在療癒聖所的禁區內入睡，希望做一個能治癒疾病的夢。
Only the priests were allowed to enter the abaton and interpret the divine visions received there. 只有祭司才被允許進入聖所，並解讀在那裡獲得的神聖異象。

meaning: （法律）非法侵佔他人遺產的人；擅自占用繼承財產者
sentences: The court ruled against the abator who had occupied the estate before the rightful heir could claim it. 法院裁定反對在合法繼承人認領之前就占據遺產的侵佔者。
An abator can be removed from the property through a legal writ issued by the court. 侵佔者可以透過法院發出的令狀被迫離開財產。

meaning: 屠宰場；供屠宰牲畜的場所
sentences: Animal welfare advocates pushed for stricter regulations at every abattoir in the country. 動物福利倡導者推動對全國每間屠宰場實施更嚴格的法規。
The abattoir was located on the outskirts of the city to minimize its impact on residents. 屠宰場位於城市外圍，以減少對居民的影響。

meaning: 阿巴圖亞人（南部非洲某些地區對卑格米人或布希曼人的舊稱）
sentences: Old accounts refer to the mountain dwellers as Abatua. 舊有的記述將山區居民稱為阿巴圖亞人。
The term Abatua is often found in ethnographic literature. 阿巴圖亞一詞經常出現在民族誌文獻中。

meaning: 獵物穿越灌木叢時踩踏留下的草跡或痕跡（獵術用語）
sentences: The experienced hunter tracked the deer by following the abature left in the undergrowth. 有經驗的獵人透過追蹤鹿在灌木叢中留下的痕跡來追趕獵物。
Fresh abature indicated that the quarry had passed through the area just hours before. 新鮮的草跡表明獵物就在幾小時前通過了這個區域。

meaning: 在上方；在……之上（古英語或方言用語，等同於 above）
sentences: The lantern hung abave the door. 那盞燈掛在門的上方。
Birds circled abave the hill at dusk. 黃昏時，鳥群在山丘上方盤旋。

meaning: 遠離軸心的；背軸的（植物學術語，指葉片背面朝外的那面）
sentences: The abaxial surface of the leaf is usually paler and contains more stomata than the upper side. 葉片的背軸面通常較淡，且含有比上面更多的氣孔。
Botanists carefully examined the abaxial side of the specimen under a microscope. 植物學家在顯微鏡下仔細檢查標本的背軸面。

meaning: 不在軸心上的；偏離中軸的（植物學術語）
sentences: The embryo was described as abaxile because it did not align with the central axis of the seed. 胚胎被描述為偏軸的，因為它與種子的中軸不對齊。
Abaxile growth patterns in certain plants create a distinctive asymmetrical appearance. 某些植物的偏軸生長模式產生了獨特的不對稱外觀。

meaning: 在燃燒中；火焰熊熊（古語，等同於 ablaze）
sentences: The old barn stood abaze against the dark night sky, visible from miles away. 舊穀倉在漆黑的夜空中火焰熊熊，數英里外都能看見。
His eyes were abaze with passion as he delivered his speech to the crowd. 他在向群眾演講時，眼中燃燒著熱情的火焰。

meaning: 織布用的緯紗；紡織中橫向穿過的絲線
sentences: The weaver carefully selected the abb to ensure the fabric's texture would be smooth and even. 織布師仔細選擇緯紗，以確保布料的質地光滑均勻。
The quality of the finished cloth depended greatly on the consistency of the abb used in weaving. 成品布料的品質在很大程度上取決於織造過程中所使用緯紗的一致性。

meaning: 父親；阿爸（對天父或修道院院長的尊稱）
sentences: The monk addressed the elder as Abba. 僧侶稱呼長者為阿爸。
Abba is an Aramaic word for father. Abba 是阿拉姆語中父親的意思。
In many religious contexts, 'Abba' is used as a term for God the Father. 在許多宗教語境中，「阿爸」被用作對天主父的稱呼。
The word 'Abba' translates to 'father' in Aramaic. 「Abba」這個詞在亞拉姆語中翻譯為「父親」。

meaning: 修道院院長（古老的教會用語）
sentences: The abbacomes oversaw the daily affairs and spiritual life of the monastery for over two decades. 這位修道院院長監督修道院的日常事務和靈性生活超過二十年。
Newly ordained monks were expected to show complete obedience to the abbacomes. 新受聖職的修士被要求對修道院院長表現出完全的服從。

meaning: 修道院院長的職位、任期或管轄範圍
sentences: During his abbacy, the monastery expanded its library and welcomed many new scholars. 在他擔任院長期間，修道院擴充了藏書館並迎接了許多新學者。
The abbacy lasted for fifteen years before he resigned due to poor health. 這段院長任期持續了十五年，直到他因健康不佳而辭職。

meaning: 阿巴德王朝（中世紀西班牙塞維亞的一個穆斯林王朝）
sentences: The Abbadide dynasty fostered a period of great cultural growth. 阿巴德王朝促進了一個偉大的文化增長期。
Seville flourished under Abbadide rule. 塞維亞在阿巴德王朝的統治下繁榮發展。

meaning: 阿巴斯（人名；常指先知穆罕默德的叔父）
sentences: Abbas was a prominent figure in early Islamic history. 阿巴斯是早期伊斯蘭歷史上的著名人物。
Many leaders claim descent from Abbas. 許多領導人聲稱自己是阿巴斯的後裔。

meaning: 父親（敘利亞語或阿拉姆語中的尊稱，也用作修道院院長的稱呼）
sentences: The abbas blessed the monks at dawn. 這位修道院院長在清晨祝福修士們。
The villagers called the old priest abbas with respect. 村民們尊敬地稱那位老神父為院長。

meaning: 舊波斯銀幣，歷史上在伊朗和鄰近地區流通
sentences: The merchant counted out several abbasi coins to pay for the silk he had purchased at the bazaar. 商人數出幾枚阿巴西銀幣，支付他在市集購買的絲綢費用。
The abbasi was named after Shah Abbas I and was widely used in the Safavid empire. 阿巴西銀幣以沙王阿拔斯一世命名，在薩法維帝國廣泛流通。

meaning: 舊波斯銀幣的另一種拼法（與 abbasi 同義）
sentences: Travelers exchanged their foreign currency for abbassi before entering the Persian market. 旅行者在進入波斯市場之前將外幣兌換成阿巴西銀幣。
Historical records show that one abbassi was equivalent to four shahi in the old monetary system. 歷史記錄顯示，在舊貨幣體系中，一枚阿巴西相當於四沙希。
The Abbasside Caliphate saw the golden age of Islam. 阿拔斯王朝見證了伊斯蘭教的黃金時代。
He is an expert on Abbasside history. 他是阿拔斯王朝歷史專家。

meaning: 與修道院院長或修道院相關的
sentences: The abbatial seal was used to authenticate all official documents issued by the monastery. 修道院院長的印章被用來驗證修道院發出的所有官方文件。
The abbatial quarters were simple but dignified, reflecting the monastic values of humility. 院長的住所簡樸但莊重，體現了修道院謙遜的價值觀。

meaning: 與修道院或修道院長相關的（abbatial 的另一種形式）
sentences: The abbatical duties included managing the monastery's finances and guiding the monks spiritually. 修道院長的職責包括管理修道院的財務和在靈性上引導修士。
His abbatical authority was recognized by all members of the religious community. 他的修道院長權威獲得宗教社群所有成員的認可。

meaning: 女修道院院長；管理女子修道院的女性領袖
sentences: The abbess led the convent with wisdom and compassion for more than thirty years. 這位女院長以智慧和慈悲領導修道院超過三十年。
All the nuns in the convent looked up to their abbess as a model of faith and dedication. 修道院裡所有修女都將她們的女院長視為信仰和奉獻的典範。

meaning: 修道院。通常指有悠久歷史、宗教功能明確的修道院建築或社群。
sentences: We visited a quiet abbey on the hill during our trip to the countryside. 我們到鄉間旅行時參觀了山丘上一座寧靜的修道院。
The old abbey library contains manuscripts that are hundreds of years old. 那座古老修道院的圖書館收藏了數百年歷史的手稿。

meaning: 修道院的遺址或所在地（古老英語用語）
sentences: Archaeologists excavated the abbeystede to uncover the foundations of the medieval monastery. 考古學家挖掘修道院遺址，以發現中世紀修道院的地基。
The village grew up around the abbeystede after the original monastery was dissolved. 原本的修道院解散後，村莊在修道院遺址周圍發展起來。
Abbie decided to go for a walk in the park. 艾比決定去公園散步。
Everyone likes Abbie because she is so kind. 每個人都喜歡艾比，因為她非常友善。

meaning: 修道院院長。通常指男性修道院的領導者。
sentences: The abbot welcomed the guests and invited them to join the evening prayer. 修道院院長歡迎來賓並邀請他們參加晚禱。
After years of study, he was chosen to become the abbot of the monastery. 經過多年研修後，他被選為那座修道院的院長。

meaning: 修道院院長的職位或任期（abbacy 的變體）
sentences: His abbotcy was marked by a period of great intellectual and spiritual renewal in the monastery. 他的院長任期以修道院一段偉大的知識和靈性復興時期為標誌。
The abbotcy passed to a younger monk after the senior abbot retired from his duties. 高級院長從職務退休後，院長職位傳給了一名年輕的修士。

meaning: 直屬教皇管轄、獨立於主教管轄的修道院長（教會法律術語）
sentences: As an abbotnullius, he held authority over both the monastery and the surrounding parishes without a bishop's oversight. 作為直屬教皇的修道院長，他在沒有主教監督的情況下對修道院和周邊教區擁有管轄權。
The title of abbotnullius granted certain abbots the same jurisdictional rights as diocesan bishops. 直屬教皇修道院長的頭銜賦予某些修道院院長與教區主教相同的管轄權。

meaning: 修道院院長的職位、地位或職務
sentences: He accepted the abbotship reluctantly, feeling unworthy of such a great responsibility. 他勉強接受了院長職位，覺得自己不配承擔如此重大的責任。
The abbotship carried both spiritual leadership and administrative responsibilities over the entire community. 院長職位承擔著整個宗教社群的靈性領導和行政責任。
We usually abbreviate the word 'International' to 'Intl' in reports. 我們在報告中通常將「International」縮寫為「Intl」。
The teacher asked the students to abbreviate the long story into a few sentences. 老師要求學生將長故事縮短（使簡短）為幾句話。
He gave an abbreviated version of the long story. 他講述了那個長篇故事的簡短版本。
Please use the abbreviated form of the month in the table. 請在表格中使用月份的縮寫形式。

meaning: 以縮寫或簡短的方式；簡略地
sentences: Please summarize the report abbreviately. 請簡略地摘要這份報告。
She wrote abbreviately because the form had little space. 因為表格空間很小，她寫得很簡略。
NASA is an abbreviation for National Aeronautics and Space Administration. NASA 是 National Aeronautics and Space Administration 的縮寫。
He used the abbreviation on the label to save space. 他在標籤上用縮寫來省空間。

meaning: 縮寫者；將文件或文字縮短的人；教廷中負責縮寫教皇詔書的官員
sentences: The papal abbreviator was responsible for drafting shortened versions of official church documents. 教皇縮書官負責起草官方教會文件的縮寫版本。
As a skilled abbreviator, she could condense a lengthy legal brief into a concise summary. 作為一名熟練的縮寫者，她能夠將冗長的法律摘要濃縮成簡潔的摘要。

meaning: 用於縮寫或簡短表達的；縮略性的
sentences: The abbreviatory notation used in the manuscript saved significant space on each page. 手稿中使用的縮略符號在每頁上節省了大量空間。
Medical professionals rely heavily on abbreviatory terminology to communicate quickly and efficiently. 醫療專業人員大量依賴縮略術語來快速有效地溝通。

meaning: 縮寫；簡寫；縮略形式（古老或正式用語）
sentences: The monk used a complex system of abbreviature to fit more text onto each vellum page. 修士使用一套複雜的縮寫系統，將更多文字容納到每張羊皮紙頁面上。
Understanding medieval abbreviature is essential for reading ancient manuscripts accurately. 理解中世紀縮寫對於準確閱讀古代手稿至關重要。
Abby is studying hard for her final exams. 艾比正在努力為期末考試做準備。
I saw Abby at the library yesterday. 我昨天在圖書館見到了艾比。

meaning: 庫侖（CGS電磁單位制中的電荷單位，等於十庫侖）
sentences: The abcoulomb is defined as the charge transferred by a current of one abampere in one second. 庫侖被定義為一秒內由一安培電流傳遞的電荷量。
In the CGS system, scientists used the abcoulomb before the SI unit of coulomb became standard. 在CGS單位制中，科學家在庫侖成為標準國際單位之前使用庫侖這個單位。

meaning: 伊斯蘭教中的聖人或神秘主義者；被視為精神力量支柱的隱士
sentences: According to Sufi tradition, the abdal are hidden saints whose prayers sustain the world. 根據蘇菲傳統，聖人是隱藏的聖者，他們的祈禱維繫著世界。
The people of the village believed the wandering abdal brought blessings wherever he traveled. 村裡的人們相信這位遊走的聖人走到哪裡就帶來祝福。

meaning: 印度廟宇中負責儀式清潔工作的僕役
sentences: The abdat ensured the temple floors were immaculate before each morning prayer ceremony. 寺廟僕役確保在每天早晨的祈禱儀式之前，寺廟地板一塵不染。
As an abdat, his role was sacred, maintaining the purity of the worship space. 作為寺廟僕役，他的角色是神聖的，負責維持禮拜空間的清潔。

meaning: 阿布德拉的；嘲弄的；愛笑的
sentences: The philosopher's Abderian laughter was well-known. 這位哲學家那種阿布德拉式的（嘲弄性）笑聲眾所周知。
He had an Abderian view of human folly. 他對人類的愚蠢持有嘲弄的看法。
Democritus was perhaps the most famous Abderite. 德謨克利特也許是最著名的阿布德拉人。
In classical literature, an Abderite was often a figure of fun. 在古典文學中，阿布德拉人經常是被取笑的對象。

meaning: 伊斯蘭教的洗禮儀式；禮拜前以水潔淨身體的行為
sentences: The worshipper performed abdest at the fountain before entering the mosque for prayer. 禮拜者在進入清真寺祈禱前，在噴泉旁進行潔淨禮。
Abdest is a ritual of purification required before performing the five daily prayers in Islam. 潔淨禮是伊斯蘭教每日五次禮拜前所需的淨化儀式。

meaning: 可被放棄或遜位的；能夠被放棄的
sentences: Philosophers debated whether the right to rule was abdicable or permanently binding once accepted. 哲學家們爭論統治權是否一旦接受就可以放棄或永久具有約束力。
The throne was considered abdicable only under extreme circumstances in that kingdom. 在那個王國中，王位只有在極端情況下才被認為可以讓位。

meaning: 遜位者；放棄職位或權力的人
sentences: The abdicant king issued a final declaration before handing power to his son. 遜位的國王在將權力移交給兒子之前發表了最後聲明。
History remembers the abdicant as someone who chose personal happiness over duty. 歷史將遜位者記憶為一個選擇個人幸福而非職責的人。

meaning: 退位；放棄；辭去（王位、職責或權力）
sentences: The king chose to abdicate the throne in favor of his younger brother. 國王選擇退位，將王位讓給他的弟弟。
A leader who abdicates responsibility during a crisis loses the trust of the people. 在危機中放棄責任的領導者會失去人民的信任。

meaning: 退位；放棄職責或權力的正式行為
sentences: The abdication of the monarch shocked the nation and triggered a constitutional crisis. 君主的退位震驚了全國，並引發了憲政危機。
His abdication of parental responsibility left his children struggling without support. 他放棄親職責任使他的孩子們在缺乏支持下艱難度日。

meaning: 涉及或傾向於退位或放棄的
sentences: The abdicative tendencies of the aging ruler worried his advisors and the court. 年邁統治者的退位傾向讓他的顧問和朝廷感到擔憂。
His abdicative attitude toward decision-making left the team without clear leadership. 他對決策的放棄態度使團隊失去了明確的領導。

meaning: 退位者；放棄職位或責任的人
sentences: The abdicator was given a generous pension and allowed to live in exile abroad. 退位者獲得了豐厚的退休金，並被允許在國外流亡生活。
As an abdicator of his duties, he was remembered more for what he gave up than what he achieved. 作為職責的放棄者，人們記住他更多的是他放棄了什麼，而不是他成就了什麼。

meaning: 阿比爾（人名；聖經中的忠誠天使）
sentences: In Milton's Paradise Lost, Abdiel remains faithful to God. 在彌爾頓的《失樂園》中，阿比爾對上帝保持忠誠。
Abdiel is often used as a symbol of unwavering loyalty. 阿比爾經常被用作堅定忠誠的象徵。

meaning: 有隱藏或保存特性的；傾向於隱藏的（罕見用語）
sentences: The abditive nature of the compound made it useful for long-term preservation of organic materials. 這種化合物的隱藏保存特性使其適用於有機材料的長期保存。
Her abditive personality made it difficult for others to truly understand her thoughts and feelings. 她傾向隱藏的個性使其他人難以真正理解她的想法和感受。

meaning: 隱藏財寶或重要物品的藏匿處；秘密倉庫
sentences: The monks used a hidden abditory beneath the chapel floor to protect their most sacred relics. 修士們在禮拜堂地板下方使用一個隱密的藏匿處來保護他們最神聖的聖物。
The detective discovered the criminal's abditory filled with stolen artwork and documents. 偵探發現了罪犯藏有被盜藝術品和文件的秘密藏匿處。
He felt a sharp pain in his abdomen after eating the spicy food. 吃完辛辣食物後，他感到腹部劇烈疼痛。
The exercises are designed to strengthen the muscles of the abdomen. 這些運動旨在增強腹部肌肉。
The patient underwent an abdominal ultrasound to check for issues. 病人接受了腹部超音波檢查以確認問題。
Doing crunches is a great way to improve abdominal strength. 做捲腹是增強腹部力量的好方法。
The Abdominales are an order of fishes characterized by the position of their fins. 腹鰭類是一類以魚鰭位置為特徵的魚類。
Biologists studied the skeletal structure of the Abdominales. 生物學家研究了腹鰭類魚類的骨骼結構。

meaning: 腹部動物；腹鰭位於腹部的魚類（分類學舊術語）
sentences: The salmon is classified as an abdominalian due to the position of its pelvic fins. 鮭魚因其腹鰭的位置而被歸類為腹部動物。
Early naturalists grouped many freshwater fish as abdominalians based on their fin placement. 早期博物學家根據鰭的位置，將許多淡水魚歸類為腹部動物。

meaning: 在腹部位置；涉及腹部地
sentences: The patient was breathing abdominally, which the doctor noted as a sign of diaphragmatic activity. 患者正在以腹式呼吸，醫生注意到這是橫膈膜活動的跡象。
Some yoga practices encourage breathing abdominally to engage the core muscles more effectively. 一些瑜伽練習鼓勵腹式呼吸，以更有效地鍛鍊核心肌肉。

meaning: （胎兒）腹部朝前的胎位（產科術語）
sentences: The obstetrician confirmed that the fetus was in an abdominoanterior position during the ultrasound. 產科醫師在超音波檢查中確認胎兒處於腹部朝前的胎位。
An abdominoanterior presentation is generally considered favorable for a normal vaginal delivery. 腹前位通常被認為有利於正常的陰道分娩。

meaning: 腹心的；與腹部和心臟同時相關的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abdominocardiac reflex can cause changes in heart rate when pressure is applied to the abdomen. 腹心反射在腹部受到壓力時可能引起心率變化。
Surgeons must monitor abdominocardiac responses closely during abdominal procedures. 外科醫師在腹部手術中必須密切監測腹心反應。

meaning: 腹腔穿刺術；以針穿刺腹部抽取液體的醫療程序
sentences: The doctor performed abdominocentesis to relieve the pressure caused by excess fluid in the abdomen. 醫生進行腹腔穿刺術，以緩解腹部積液引起的壓力。
Abdominocentesis is often used to diagnose the cause of ascites in patients with liver disease. 腹腔穿刺術常用於診斷肝病患者腹水的原因。

meaning: 與腹部和膀胱相關的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abdominocystic fistula was repaired during a complex surgical procedure. 腹膀胱瘻管在一次複雜的外科手術中被修復。
An abdominocystic injury can result from severe blunt trauma to the lower abdomen. 腹膀胱損傷可能由下腹部嚴重鈍傷引起。

meaning: 與腹部和生殖器官同時相關的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abdominogenital nerve supplies sensation to both the abdominal wall and the genital area. 腹生殖神經為腹壁和生殖區域提供感覺。
Surgeons in abdominogenital procedures must be familiar with the complex anatomy of both regions. 進行腹生殖手術的外科醫師必須熟悉兩個區域的複雜解剖結構。

meaning: 腹式子宮切除術；經腹部切除子宮的手術
sentences: The gynecologist recommended an abdominohysterectomy to treat the patient's advanced uterine cancer. 婦科醫師建議進行腹式子宮切除術以治療患者的晚期子宮癌。
Recovery from abdominohysterectomy typically takes several weeks and requires careful monitoring. 腹式子宮切除術後的恢復通常需要數週，並需要仔細監測。

meaning: 腹式子宮切開術；經腹部切開子宮的手術（如剖腹產）
sentences: Abdominohysterotomy is performed when a vaginal delivery is not possible or safe for the mother and baby. 當陰道分娩對母嬰不可能或不安全時，就會進行腹式子宮切開術。
The surgeon carefully sutured the uterine wall following the abdominohysterotomy. 外科醫師在腹式子宮切開術後仔細縫合子宮壁。

meaning: （胎兒）腹部朝後的胎位（產科術語）
sentences: The midwife noted that the fetus was in an abdominoposterior position, which required close monitoring during labor. 助產士注意到胎兒處於腹後位，需要在分娩過程中密切監測。
An abdominoposterior presentation may complicate delivery and require medical intervention. 腹後位可能使分娩複雜化，需要醫療介入。

meaning: 腹腔鏡；用於檢查腹腔內部的醫療器械
sentences: The surgeon inserted an abdominoscope through a small incision to examine the abdominal organs. 外科醫師通過一個小切口插入腹腔鏡以檢查腹部器官。
Modern abdominoscopes allow physicians to perform minimally invasive procedures with high precision. 現代腹腔鏡使醫師能夠以高精度進行微創手術。

meaning: 腹腔鏡檢查；使用腹腔鏡檢查腹腔的醫療程序
sentences: Abdominoscopy revealed a small cyst on the patient's ovary that had gone undetected in earlier scans. 腹腔鏡檢查發現患者卵巢上有一個小囊腫，在早期掃描中未被發現。
The doctor recommended abdominoscopy as a less invasive alternative to open surgery. 醫生建議腹腔鏡檢查作為開放手術的創傷較小的替代方案。

meaning: 與腹部和胸腔同時相關的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abdominothoracic surgeon specializes in conditions affecting both the chest and abdominal cavities. 腹胸外科醫師專門處理影響胸腔和腹腔的疾病。
Blunt trauma can cause abdominothoracic injuries that require urgent and coordinated medical care. 鈍傷可能導致腹胸損傷，需要緊急且協調的醫療護理。

meaning: 大腹便便的；腹部肥大的
sentences: The abdominous figure of the merchant suggested a life of comfort and excess. 這位商人大腹便便的身材暗示著一種舒適和過度放縱的生活。
His abdominous appearance had developed over years of a sedentary lifestyle and poor diet. 他大腹便便的外表是多年久坐的生活方式和不良飲食習慣造成的。

meaning: 與腹部和陰道同時相關的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abdominovaginal examination provided the physician with a comprehensive view of the pelvic structures. 腹陰道檢查為醫師提供了盆腔結構的全面視圖。
An abdominovaginal fistula is a rare but serious complication that requires surgical repair. 腹陰道瘻管是一種罕見但嚴重的併發症，需要外科手術修復。

meaning: 與腹部和膀胱同時相關的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abdominovesical fistula caused the patient significant discomfort and required immediate surgery. 腹膀胱瘻管使患者感到極大不適，需要立即手術。
Radiation therapy can sometimes lead to abdominovesical complications in cancer patients. 放射治療有時會在癌症患者中導致腹膀胱併發症。

meaning: 使外展；將肢體向外移動（解剖學術語）
sentences: The therapist instructed the patient to abduce the arm slowly to test the range of motion. 治療師指示患者慢慢外展手臂以測試活動範圍。
Certain muscles work together to abduce the leg away from the body's midline. 某些肌肉協同工作，將腿部從身體中線向外展。

meaning: 外展神經；控制眼球向外側轉動的第六對腦神經
sentences: Damage to the abducens nerve can result in an inability to move the eye outward. 外展神經受損可能導致眼球無法向外移動。
The neurologist tested the abducens function by asking the patient to follow a moving finger. 神經科醫師通過要求患者跟隨移動的手指來測試外展神經功能。

meaning: 使外展的；將身體部位向外拉離中線的（解剖學）
sentences: The abducent muscles of the eye pull it toward the outer corner of the socket. 眼球的外展肌將眼球拉向眼眶的外角。
Physical therapists use abducent exercises to strengthen the muscles around injured joints. 物理治療師使用外展練習來加強受傷關節周圍的肌肉。

meaning: 綁架、擄走。常用於犯罪、懸疑或新聞語境。
sentences: Police believe the gang planned to abduct the businessman for ransom. 警方認為該幫派計畫綁架那名商人以勒索贖金。
The movie tells the story of aliens who abduct a group of hikers. 那部電影講述外星人擄走一群登山客的故事。

meaning: 綁架、誘拐。指人被強行帶走的事件。
sentences: The police launched a citywide search after the child's abduction. 孩子遭到誘拐後，警方展開了全城搜索。
The novel centers on the abduction of a scientist with valuable research data. 那本小說以一名掌握重要研究資料的科學家遭綁架為主軸。

meaning: 外展肌；將肢體向外拉離身體的肌肉；（法律）綁架者
sentences: The hip abductor muscles are essential for walking, running, and maintaining balance. 髖部外展肌對於行走、跑步和保持平衡至關重要。
Police arrested the abductor within hours of the child's disappearance. 警方在孩子失蹤後數小時內逮捕了綁架者。
Abe Lincoln was a great president. 亞伯·林肯是一位偉大的總統。
I met a guy named Abe. 我遇到一個名叫亞伯的人。

meaning: 在船的正側方向；與船的龍骨成直角的方向
sentences: The lighthouse came abeam as the ship rounded the headland. 當船繞過海岬時，燈塔出現在船的正側方。
The captain ordered all hands on deck when a whale was spotted abeam of the vessel. 當在船的正側方發現一頭鯨魚時，船長命令所有人到甲板上。
He could no longer abear the constant noise from the construction site next door. 他再也無法忍受隔壁建築工地持續不斷的噪音。
She had always managed to abear his harsh criticism with quiet dignity. 她總是能以平靜的尊嚴忍受他尖刻的批評。
The knight's abearance in battle was described as both fearless and honorable. 騎士在戰場上的舉止被描述為既無畏又高尚。
Her polite abearance in difficult situations earned her great respect among her peers. 她在困難情況下的禮貌舉止贏得了同儕的極大尊重。

meaning: 初學者；學習字母的人；按字母順序排列的
sentences: The abecedarian practiced the alphabet with flashcards for an hour. 那名初學者用字卡練習字母一個小時。
The files were arranged in abecedarian order on the shelf. 那些檔案在架上按字母順序排好。

meaning: 字母書；教授字母的初級讀本或教材
sentences: The child's first school book was a beautifully illustrated abecedarium. 這個孩子的第一本學校書籍是一本插圖精美的字母書。
Medieval monks used an abecedarium to teach young novices to read Latin. 中世紀修士使用字母書教年輕的見習修士閱讀拉丁文。

meaning: 字母表的；與字母順序相關的；初步的
sentences: The abecedary inscription on the ancient tablet listed all the letters of the early alphabet. 古代石板上的字母表銘文列出了早期字母的所有字母。
His abecedary knowledge of the subject was not enough to impress the panel of experts. 他對這個主題的初步知識不足以給專家小組留下深刻印象。
He remained abed for three days after the fever took hold. 發燒後他臥床三天。
She was still abed at noon, exhausted from the previous night's long journey. 她在中午還躺在床上，因為前一晚的長途旅行而精疲力竭。

meaning: 害羞地；疏遠地；保持距離地（蘇格蘭方言）
sentences: The timid deer stood abeigh at the edge of the forest, watching the hikers with cautious eyes. 膽小的鹿站在樹林邊緣保持距離，用謹慎的眼睛注視著徒步旅行者。
He sat abeigh from the group at the party, not yet comfortable enough to join the conversation. 他在派對上與人群保持距離地坐著，還不夠自在加入對話。
Cain and Abel were brothers. 該隱和亞伯是兄弟。
Abel is a talented musician. 亞伯是一位才華橫溢的音樂家。

meaning: 白楊樹；一種樹幹白色、葉背銀色的楊樹
sentences: The abele trees lining the riverbank shimmered in the afternoon breeze. 沿河岸排列的白楊樹在下午的微風中閃閃發光。
Craftsmen valued abele wood for its lightness and smooth grain. 工匠因白楊木的輕盈和光滑木紋而珍視它。
The Abelia in the garden is blooming beautifully. 花園裡的六道木開得很漂亮。
She planted a row of Abelia bushes along the fence. 她沿著籬笆種了一排六道木灌木。

meaning: 阿貝爾的（數學用語，指交換性的）
sentences: In mathematics, an Abelian group is a group where the order of operations does not matter. 在數學中，阿貝爾群是一個運算順序不影響結果的群。
They studied Abelian varieties in their advanced algebra course. 他們在高級代數課程中研究了阿貝爾簇。

meaning: 櫸屬的一種（現常指 Zelkova）
sentences: The park planted an Abelicea by the path. 公園在小路旁種了一株櫸樹。
Its smooth bark made the Abelicea stand out. 它光滑的樹皮讓這株櫸樹特別醒目。

meaning: 阿貝爾派信徒（古代基督教的一派）
sentences: The Abelite sect was known for its unique views on marriage. 阿貝爾派因其對婚姻的獨特見解而聞名。
Historians research the daily lives of the Abelite community. 歷史學家研究阿貝爾派社區的日常生活。

meaning: 諾斯底教派的一支信徒，主張禁慾獨身（歷史宗教用語）
sentences: The abelites believed that abstaining from marriage was essential to their form of spiritual purity. 亞伯利特人認為禁止婚姻對其靈性純潔的形式至關重要。
Church historians recorded the abelites as a small sect that died out within a generation. 教會歷史學家記錄亞伯利特人是一個在一代之內消亡的小教派。
Abelmoschus bloomed in the hot garden bed. 秋葵屬在炎熱的花圃裡開花。
The seed packet listed Abelmoschus for the okra genus. 種子包上把秋葵屬列作秋葵的屬名。

meaning: 麝香秋葵；一種產自熱帶的植物，其種子具有麝香香氣，用於製造香水
sentences: Abelmosk seeds have been used in perfumery for centuries due to their distinctive musky fragrance. 麝香秋葵種子因其獨特的麝香香氣，數百年來一直被用於香水製造。
The botanical garden cultivated abelmosk alongside other aromatic tropical plants. 植物園栽培麝香秋葵以及其他芳香熱帶植物。

meaning: 阿貝爾派的；阿貝爾信徒的
sentences: The article discussed Abelonian doctrines from the 4th century. 文章討論了 4 世紀的阿貝爾派教義。
They explored the origins of Abelonian asceticism. 他們探索了阿貝爾派禁欲主義的起源。

meaning: 白楊樹（abele 的另一種稱呼）
sentences: The abeltree provided dense shade along the garden path during the hot summer months. 白楊樹在炎熱的夏季沿著花園小徑提供濃密的陰涼。
Farmers planted rows of abeltree as windbreaks along the edges of their fields. 農民在田地邊緣種植了一排排白楊樹作為防風林。

meaning: 阿本塞拉赫家族（格拉納達王國的一個著名家族）
sentences: The legend of the Abencerrages is famous in Spanish history. 阿本塞拉赫家族的傳說是西班牙歷史上的著名故事。
A hall in the Alhambra is named after the Abencerrages. 阿爾罕布拉宮的一個大廳是以阿本塞拉赫家族命名的。

meaning: 腸外的；位於腸道之外的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abenteric infection spread to surrounding tissues and required aggressive antibiotic treatment. 腸外感染擴散到周圍組織，需要積極的抗生素治療。
Abenteric complications can arise when intestinal bacteria migrate outside the gut wall. 當腸道細菌遷移到腸壁外部時，可能出現腸外併發症。

meaning: 對感官享樂的異常渴望；無法控制的慾望（古醫學術語）
sentences: Ancient physicians used abepithymia to describe an uncontrollable desire for bodily pleasure. 古代醫師用這個詞來描述對肉體享樂無法控制的欲望。
The philosopher warned that abepithymia could distract people from higher goals. 那位哲學家警告說，對感官享樂的異常渴望可能會讓人偏離更高的目標。
Aberdeen is known as the Granite City. 阿伯丁被稱為花崗岩城。
She spent three years studying at the University of Aberdeen. 她在阿伯丁大學學習了三年。

meaning: 西斯金鳥；一種黃綠色的小型雀鳥（歐洲俗名）
sentences: The bright plumage of the aberdevine made it a popular caged songbird in Victorian England. 西斯金鳥鮮艷的羽毛使其成為維多利亞時代英格蘭流行的籠養鳴鳥。
Birdwatchers gathered at the woodland edge hoping to spot an aberdevine feeding on alder seeds. 賞鳥者聚集在林地邊緣，希望發現西斯金鳥在進食赤楊種子。
The Aberdonian spoke with a distinct accent. 那個阿伯丁人說話帶著明顯的口音。
He is proud of his Aberdonian heritage. 他為自己的阿伯丁血統感到自豪。

meaning: 阿貝利亞屬（植物，現多歸入 Dovyalis）
sentences: Aberia caffra is commonly known as the Kei apple. Aberia caffra 通常被稱為凱阿普爾果。
The fruit of the Aberia is often used for making jelly. Aberia 的果實常用於製作果凍。

meaning: 偏離正常；異常行為或狀態；偏差
sentences: The scientist noted an aberrance in the data that suggested an error in the experiment. 科學家注意到數據中的異常，暗示實驗中存在錯誤。
His sudden aberrance in behavior alarmed his family and friends. 他行為的突然異常讓他的家人和朋友感到震驚。

meaning: 偏離正軌的狀態或性質；不正常
sentences: The aberrancy of the results prompted researchers to repeat the entire experiment from scratch. 結果的異常性促使研究人員從頭重複整個實驗。
Therapists work to address the root causes of behavioral aberrancy in their patients. 治療師致力於解決患者行為異常的根本原因。

meaning: 偏離正常的；異常的；不符合標準的
sentences: The aberrant cell growth detected in the scan turned out to be benign. 掃描中發現的異常細胞生長結果是良性的。
His aberrant behavior during the meeting confused his colleagues and disrupted the discussion. 他在會議中的異常行為讓同事困惑，並打亂了討論。

meaning: 偏離正道；偏離正常路線
sentences: The spacecraft began to aberrate from its planned course due to unexpected gravitational forces. 由於意外的引力，太空船開始偏離其計劃路線。
Without a strong moral compass, individuals may aberrate from the values they were raised with. 沒有強烈的道德指南針，個人可能會偏離他們成長中所持的價值觀。

meaning: 任何具有超自然力量的生物，在給定環境中的有組織的生物類別中找不到。
sentences: Only by submitting to the aberration could the human traders travel safely through the territory of Zularn. 只有屈服於畸變，人類商人才能安全地穿越祖拉恩的領地。
The term aberration refers to Any creature with supernatural powers not found in the organized classes of beings in a given setting. 畸變一詞是指在給定環境中的有組織的生物類別中未發現的具有超自然力量的任何生物。

meaning: 偏差的；與異常或偏離相關的
sentences: The commission investigated the aberrational financial transactions flagged by the auditors. 委員會調查了審計員標記的異常財務交易。
Aberrational weather patterns in the region were linked to the long-term effects of climate change. 該地區的異常天氣模式與氣候變化的長期影響有關。

meaning: 導致偏差的人或物；引起光學像差的透鏡缺陷
sentences: The lens aberrator in the telescope was corrected with a secondary optical element. 望遠鏡中的透鏡像差通過次級光學元件得到了校正。
The manager was seen as an aberrator within the team, constantly pushing the group off its planned goals. 這位主管被視為團隊中的干擾者，不斷使團隊偏離既定目標。

meaning: 像差計；測量眼睛或光學系統光學缺陷的儀器
sentences: The ophthalmologist used an aberrometer to precisely measure the patient's visual aberrations before surgery. 眼科醫師使用像差計在手術前精確測量患者的視覺像差。
Advances in aberrometer technology have greatly improved the accuracy of laser eye correction procedures. 像差計技術的進步大大提高了雷射眼部矯正手術的精確度。

meaning: 像差鏡；用於觀察或測量光學像差的儀器
sentences: Researchers used the aberroscope to identify distortions in the experimental lens system. 研究人員使用像差鏡識別實驗透鏡系統中的失真。
The aberroscope revealed subtle optical imperfections invisible to the naked eye. 像差鏡揭示了肉眼看不見的細微光學缺陷。

meaning: 除草工具；長柄高枝剪（用於修剪高樹的工具）
sentences: The gardener used an aberuncator to trim the highest branches of the old oak tree. 園丁使用長柄高枝剪修剪老橡樹的最高枝條。
An aberuncator is an essential tool for orchard workers who need to prune tall fruit trees safely. 長柄高枝剪對於需要安全修剪高大果樹的果園工人來說是一種必不可少的工具。
It is a crime to aid and abet a fugitive. 協助和教唆逃犯是犯罪行為。
His silence was seen as an attempt to abet the illegal activity. 他的沈默被視為企圖助長非法活動。

meaning: 教唆；煽動；協助他人犯罪的行為
sentences: He was charged with abetment of fraud for helping the criminal cover his tracks. 他因幫助罪犯掩蓋蹤跡而被指控教唆詐騙。
Abetment is a serious criminal offense that can carry penalties similar to the crime itself. 教唆是嚴重的刑事罪行，可能承擔與犯罪本身相似的懲罰。

meaning: 教唆；煽動行為（abetment 的同義詞）
sentences: The court found him guilty of abettal after evidence showed he had encouraged the robbery. 法院在證據顯示他曾鼓勵搶劫後認定他犯有教唆罪。
Abettal of illegal activities is punishable even if the abettor did not directly participate. 即使教唆者沒有直接參與，教唆非法活動也是可懲罰的。

meaning: 教唆犯；協助或鼓勵他人犯罪的人
sentences: The abettor was sentenced to two years in prison for encouraging the theft. 教唆犯因鼓勵盜竊而被判處兩年監禁。
An abettor may face the same legal consequences as the person who committed the crime. 教唆犯可能面臨與實施犯罪者相同的法律後果。

meaning: 異常或不完全的排空；（醫學）不正常排出體液
sentences: The patient's abevacuation of the bowel suggested an underlying digestive disorder. 患者腸道的不完全排空暗示存在潛在的消化系統疾病。
Abevacuation was documented as a symptom of the intestinal blockage discovered during the examination. 在檢查中發現的腸道阻塞以不完全排空作為症狀記錄。

meaning: 持觀望態度；暫時擱置（古語，等同於 abeyance 的動詞形式）
sentences: He decided to abey his judgment until all the facts were presented to the committee. 他決定暫緩判斷，直到所有事實都呈現給委員會。
The project was forced to abey when the primary investor withdrew his funding. 當主要投資者撤回資金時，這個專案被迫擱置。

meaning: 暫時擱置；中止；懸而未決的狀態
sentences: The new regulation was held in abeyance pending a final review by the legal team. 新法規在法律團隊進行最終審查期間暫時擱置。
Plans for the expansion were kept in abeyance until the economic situation improved. 擴張計劃在經濟形勢改善之前保持擱置狀態。

meaning: 暫時中止或擱置的狀態（abeyance 的同義詞）
sentences: The legal claim remained in a state of abeyancy for over a decade before being resolved. 這項法律主張在解決之前保持了十多年的懸置狀態。
The committee voted to extend the abeyancy of the proposed changes until a new study was completed. 委員會投票決定延長提議變更的擱置狀態，直到新研究完成。

meaning: 暫時擱置的；中止的；懸而未決的
sentences: The abeyant policy was finally enacted after years of political debate. 這項懸而未決的政策在多年政治辯論後終於得以頒布。
His abeyant feelings for her resurfaced when they unexpectedly met again years later. 他對她懸而未決的感情在多年後他們意外重逢時重新浮現。

meaning: 法拉（CGS電磁單位制中的電容單位，等於十億法拉）
sentences: The abfarad is an extremely large unit rarely used in practical electrical engineering. 法拉是一個極大的單位，在實際電氣工程中很少使用。
Scientists studying theoretical electromagnetic systems sometimes work with values expressed in abfarads. 研究理論電磁系統的科學家有時使用以法拉表示的數值。

meaning: 亨利（CGS電磁單位制中的電感單位，等於十億分之一亨利）
sentences: The abhenry is an extremely small unit used in CGS-based electromagnetic calculations. 亨利是CGS電磁計算中使用的極小單位。
Converting from abhenry to the SI henry requires multiplying by a factor of one billion. 從亨利轉換為國際單位制亨利需要乘以十億的係數。

meaning: 灌頂儀式；印度教或佛教中以聖水灑在神像或信徒頭上的神聖儀式
sentences: The abhiseka ceremony marked the consecration of the new temple idol with sacred water and prayers. 灌頂儀式用聖水和祈禱標誌著新廟宇神像的開光。
Devotees waited patiently in long lines to receive the abhiseka blessing from the high priest. 信徒們耐心地排長隊，等待從大祭司那裡接受灌頂祝福。

meaning: 令人厭惡的；可憎的（abhominable 為 abominable 的舊式拼法）
sentences: The chronicle described the tyrant's crimes as abhominable acts against his own people. 編年史將暴君的罪行描述為針對其人民的令人憎惡的行為。
Medieval scholars considered pride one of the most abhominable of sins. 中世紀學者認為傲慢是最令人厭惡的罪行之一。

meaning: 厭惡、痛恨。比 dislike 更強烈，帶有道德或情感上的反感。
sentences: She abhors cruelty to animals and supports several rescue groups. 她痛恨虐待動物，並支持好幾個救援團體。
I abhor the idea of cheating just to get ahead. 我非常厭惡靠作弊來取得優勢的做法。
She expressed her abhorrence for cruelty to animals at every opportunity. 她在每個機會表達對虐待動物的極度厭惡。
His abhorrence of dishonesty made it impossible for him to work in a corrupt environment. 他對不誠實的強烈憎恨使他不可能在腐敗的環境中工作。

meaning: 極度厭惡的狀態或性質（abhorrence 的古老形式）
sentences: The philosopher wrote at length about the abhorrency of violence as a means of political change. 哲學家大篇幅地寫了關於以暴力作為政治變革手段的極度厭惡。
Her abhorrency toward injustice drove her to dedicate her life to humanitarian work. 她對不公正的極度厭惡驅使她將一生奉獻給人道主義工作。

meaning: 令人憎惡的；使人極度反感的
sentences: The conditions in the prison were described as abhorrent and in violation of human rights. 監獄的條件被描述為令人憎惡且違反人權。
She found the idea of abandoning her principles to be utterly abhorrent. 她認為放棄自己原則的想法是完全令人憎惡的。

meaning: 以令人憎惡的方式；極其令人反感地
sentences: The suspect behaved abhorrently during the trial, showing no remorse for his actions. 嫌疑人在審判期間表現得極為令人憎惡，對自己的行為毫無悔恨。
The living conditions in the refugee camp were abhorrently inadequate and unsafe. 難民營的生活條件令人憎惡地不足且不安全。

meaning: 極度厭惡某人或某事的人
sentences: As a lifelong abhorrer of injustice, she devoted her career to legal reform. 作為一個終身厭惡不公正的人，她將職業生涯奉獻給了法律改革。
The poet was known as an abhorrer of war, and his verses reflected deep pacifist convictions. 這位詩人以厭惡戰爭而聞名，他的詩句反映了深刻的和平主義信念。

meaning: 值得憎惡的；令人厭惡的（古老形容詞）
sentences: The historian described the massacre as an abhorrible chapter in the nation's past. 歷史學家將這場大屠殺描述為這個國家過去中令人憎惡的一章。
Such abhorrible treatment of prisoners was condemned by international observers. 對囚犯如此令人憎惡的待遇受到國際觀察員的譴責。

meaning: 極度厭惡；強烈反感（動名詞或現在分詞形式）
sentences: Her abhorring of deception was well known to everyone who worked with her. 她對欺騙的極度厭惡是所有與她共事的人都知道的。
His abhorring of social injustice inspired him to write some of the most powerful essays of his generation. 他對社會不公正的強烈反感激勵他寫下了他那一代最有力量的一些文章。
The abhorson prepared the execution. 死刑執行人準備了處決。
He worked as an abhorson in the past. 他過去曾擔任死刑執行人。

meaning: 居住的；與停留或遵守相關的（古老形容詞）
sentences: The abidal requirements of the contract stipulated that the tenant must remain on the property for at least one year. 合約的居住要求規定租戶必須在房產上居住至少一年。
His abidal commitment to the community lasted long after others had moved away. 他對社區的居住承諾在其他人搬走後仍持續了很長時間。
The judge emphasized the importance of abidance with the terms of the restraining order. 法官強調遵守禁制令條款的重要性。
Her abidance in the remote village for decades made her a respected elder of the community. 她在偏遠村莊居住了幾十年，使她成為社區受尊敬的長者。
All employees must abide by the company's safety rules and regulations. 所有員工都必須遵守公司的安全規則和條例。
I cannot abide his constant complaining and negative attitude. 我受不了（無法容忍）他不斷的抱怨和消極的態度。

meaning: 遵守規則的人；長期居住者；能夠忍受的人
sentences: He was known as an abider of the law, always following the rules even when they were inconvenient. 他以遵守法律著稱，即使在不方便的情況下也始終遵守規則。
As a lifelong abider in the valley, she knew every family and every path through the hills. 作為山谷中的終身居民，她認識每個家庭和山中的每條小路。

meaning: 一種非洲小羚羊（舊式拼法或地區俗名）
sentences: The abidi was spotted grazing near the watering hole just before sunrise. 在日出前不久，一隻小羚羊被發現在水坑附近吃草。
The naturalist photographed the rare abidi during an expedition to the East African savanna. 博物學家在東非大草原探險期間拍攝了這種罕見的小羚羊。

meaning: 持久的、長久不變的。常形容興趣、信念、感情或影響。
sentences: He has an abiding interest in local history and culture. 他對地方歷史與文化一直抱持長久的興趣。
Her abiding trust in her team helped everyone through the crisis. 她對團隊持久不變的信任幫助大家度過了危機。

meaning: 持久地；永久地；以不變的方式
sentences: She remained abidingly loyal to her friends throughout every hardship in her life. 在生活中的每一次艱辛中，她對朋友始終保持持久的忠誠。
The beauty of the mountain landscape was abidingly etched into his memory. 山景之美永久地銘刻在他的記憶中。

meaning: 持久性；永恆性；長久不變的品質
sentences: The abidingness of her commitment to education earned her recognition from the government. 她對教育承諾的持久性贏得了政府的認可。
Critics praised the abidingness of the novel's themes, which remained relevant across generations. 評論家稱讚了小說主題的持久性，這些主題在幾代人中仍然具有現實意義。
Abie is my best friend. 艾比是我最好的朋友。
I saw Abie at the park today. 我今天在公園看到了艾比。
Abies is a genus of about 50 species of evergreen conifers. 冷杉屬是包含約 50 種常綠針葉樹的一個屬。
The mountains are covered with Abies trees that stay green all year. 山上長滿了全年常綠的冷杉。

meaning: 松香酸鹽；松香酸的鹽類或酯類（化學術語）
sentences: Abietate compounds are used as emulsifiers in certain industrial processes. 松香酸鹽化合物在某些工業過程中用作乳化劑。
The chemist isolated the abietate from pine resin during the purification process. 化學家在純化過程中從松脂中分離出松香酸鹽。

meaning: 從松脂中提取的萜烯類碳氫化合物（化學術語）
sentences: Abietene is one of the hydrocarbon components found in pine resin and turpentine. 松香烯是松脂和松節油中發現的碳氫化合物成分之一。
The laboratory tested abietene as a potential solvent for various industrial applications. 實驗室測試了松香烯作為各種工業應用的潛在溶劑。

meaning: 松香酸的；來自松脂的（化學形容詞）
sentences: Abietic acid is the primary component of rosin and is widely used in adhesives and varnishes. 松香酸是松香的主要成分，廣泛用於黏合劑和清漆。
Researchers studied abietic derivatives as environmentally friendly alternatives to petroleum-based chemicals. 研究人員研究了松香酸衍生物作為石油基化學品的環保替代品。

meaning: 松香素；從松脂中提取的一種天然樹脂物質
sentences: Abietin was historically used as a binding agent in early printing inks. 松香素在歷史上被用作早期印刷墨水的黏合劑。
The pharmacist prepared a tincture containing abietin for its reported antiseptic properties. 藥劑師製備了含有松香素的酊劑，以利用其據報導的防腐特性。
Abietineae is a subfamily of coniferous trees. 松科是針葉樹的一個亞科。
Pine trees belong to Abietineae. 松樹屬於松科。

meaning: 松科的；與松樹或其近緣植物相關的（植物學術語）
sentences: The forest was predominantly abietineous, filled with pine, fir, and spruce trees. 這片森林主要是松科的，充滿了松樹、冷杉和雲杉。
Abietineous plants produce resins that have been valued for thousands of years in medicine and industry. 松科植物產生的樹脂在醫學和工業中已被珍視了數千年。

meaning: 含有或來自松香酸的（化學術語）
sentences: The abietinic compound was extracted from the bark and tested for its anti-inflammatory properties. 松香酸化合物從樹皮中提取並測試其抗炎特性。
Industrial chemists explored abietinic derivatives as biodegradable coating materials. 工業化學家探索了松香酸衍生物作為可生物降解塗層材料。
Abiezer is a biblical name. 亞比以謝是一個聖經中的名字。
The descendants of Abiezer settled there. 亞比以謝的後裔定居在那裡。

meaning: 女僕；侍女（源自聖經，常用於文學中）
sentences: In the novel, the young abigail attended to every need of the noblewoman with quiet efficiency. 在小說中，年輕的侍女以安靜的效率照料貴婦人的每一個需求。
The term abigail was commonly used in eighteenth-century literature to refer to a personal maidservant. 侍女這個詞在十八世紀的文學中常用來指代私人女僕。

meaning: 女僕或侍女的職位或身份
sentences: She accepted the abigailship with humility, grateful for the chance to serve in such a fine household. 她謙遜地接受了侍女的職位，感激有機會在如此高尚的家庭中服務。
The abigailship carried with it a set of strict duties and unwavering expectations of discretion. 侍女的職位帶有一套嚴格的職責和對謹慎一貫的期望。

meaning: 牲畜盜竊罪（古羅馬法律術語）
sentences: Abigeat was treated as a major crime in Roman law and could result in severe punishment. 在羅馬法律中，牲畜盜竊罪被視為重罪，可能導致嚴厲的懲罰。
The historian described abigeat as a persistent problem in the frontier provinces of the empire. 歷史學家將牲畜盜竊罪描述為帝國邊境行省中一個持續存在的問題。

meaning: 牲畜竊賊（古羅馬法律術語，等同於 abactor）
sentences: The abigeus was caught red-handed driving a stolen herd of cattle across the river. 牲畜竊賊在渡河時被當場抓獲，正在驅趕偷來的牛群。
Roman law prescribed harsh penalties for any abigeus convicted of large-scale livestock theft. 羅馬法律對任何被判定犯有大規模牲畜盜竊罪的竊賊規定了嚴厲的懲罰。

meaning: 菲律賓產的一種硬木樹（學名 Pinanga），用於建築和家具
sentences: Abilao timber is prized for its durability and is commonly used in Philippine construction. 菲律賓硬木因其耐用性而受到珍視，常用於菲律賓的建築。
The craftsman fashioned a sturdy table from locally harvested abilao wood. 工匠用當地採伐的菲律賓硬木製作了一張堅固的桌子。
Her ability to solve complex problems is truly impressive. 她解決複雜問題的能力確實令人印象深刻。
Music has the ability to bring people together from different cultures. 音樂有能力將來自不同文化的人聚集在一起。

meaning: 非洲一種產生紅色染料的植物
sentences: The women of the village used abilla berries to dye their ceremonial cloth a deep red. 村裡的婦女使用植物漿果將她們的儀式布料染成深紅色。
Abilla was an important trade commodity along ancient African caravan routes. 這種染料植物是古代非洲商隊路線上重要的貿易商品。

meaning: 菲律賓一種食用果實的植物（地區俗名）
sentences: Villagers collected ripe abilo fruits from the forest to supplement their diet during the dry season. 村民們在旱季從森林中採集成熟的植物果實，以補充飲食。
The abilo plant grows along riverbanks and is recognized by its glossy oval leaves. 這種植物沿河岸生長，以其光澤的橢圓形葉子為特徵。

meaning: 未立遺囑死亡的；在沒有有效遺囑的情況下死亡的（法律術語）
sentences: When the property owner died abintestate, the estate was divided according to the laws of intestacy. 當財產所有人在未立遺囑的情況下去世時，遺產根據無遺囑法分配。
Dying abintestate can lead to lengthy legal disputes among family members over the distribution of assets. 未立遺囑死亡可能導致家庭成員之間就資產分配展開漫長的法律糾紛。

meaning: 自然發生說；生命從無機物質中自然產生的理論（已被現代科學否定）
sentences: Abiogenesis was once widely accepted as an explanation for how small creatures like flies could spontaneously appear. 自然發生說曾被廣泛接受，作為解釋蒼蠅等小生物如何能夠自發出現的理論。
Louis Pasteur's experiments in the 19th century disproved the theory of abiogenesis. 路易·巴斯德在19世紀的實驗推翻了自然發生說。

meaning: 相信或研究自然發生說的人
sentences: Early abiogenesists believed that rotting meat could give rise to maggots without any parent fly. 早期自然發生說的信奉者認為腐肉可以在沒有親代蒼蠅的情況下產生蛆。
As an abiogenesist, he spent his career challenging the prevailing views on the origins of life. 作為自然發生說的支持者，他花了整個職業生涯挑戰關於生命起源的主流觀點。

meaning: 與自然發生說相關的；涉及無中生有的生命產生
sentences: The abiogenetic hypothesis was eventually replaced by the germ theory of disease. 自然發生說假說最終被疾病細菌理論所取代。
Scientists continue to debate abiogenetic processes that may have led to the first living cells on Earth. 科學家繼續辯論可能導致地球上第一個活細胞產生的自然發生過程。

meaning: 與自然發生說相關的（abiogenetic 的另一種形式）
sentences: The professor discussed abiogenetical theories during his lecture on the history of biology. 教授在其生物學歷史講座中討論了自然發生說理論。
Her research examined abiogenetical claims made by scientists before the advent of modern microbiology. 她的研究考察了現代微生物學出現之前科學家提出的自然發生說主張。

meaning: 以自然發生的方式；按照自然發生說的原則
sentences: Early scientists believed that some organisms could arise abiogenetically from nonliving matter. 早期科學家認為某些生物可以從無生命物質中自然發生。
The claim that life could be produced abiogenetically was thoroughly debunked in the nineteenth century. 生命可以自然發生的說法在十九世紀被徹底推翻。

meaning: 自然發生說的支持者（abiogenesist 的同義詞）
sentences: The famous debate between Pasteur and the abiogenist Pouchet helped settle the question of spontaneous generation. 巴斯德與自然發生說支持者普歇之間著名的辯論幫助解決了自然發生的問題。
An abiogenist would argue that life does not necessarily require a biological parent to exist. 自然發生說支持者會認為生命不一定需要生物親代才能存在。

meaning: 由自然發生產生的；無親代生物而自然出現的
sentences: Proponents of abiogenous life argued that certain creatures appeared spontaneously in decaying organic matter. 自然發生生命的支持者認為某些生物在腐爛的有機物中自發出現。
The concept of abiogenous organisms was ultimately disproven through controlled scientific experiments. 自然發生生物的概念最終通過受控科學實驗被推翻。

meaning: 自然發生；生命從無生命物質中自發產生（abiogenesis 的同義詞）
sentences: Abiogeny was once considered a plausible explanation for the origin of insects and rodents. 自然發生說曾被認為是昆蟲和嚙齒動物起源的合理解釋。
The rejection of abiogeny was a turning point in the history of modern biology. 否定自然發生說是現代生物學歷史上的一個轉折點。

meaning: 非生物的；與生命過程無關的
sentences: The abiological factors affecting the ecosystem include temperature, rainfall, and soil composition. 影響生態系統的非生物因素包括溫度、降雨量和土壤成分。
Scientists studied abiological processes to understand how chemical reactions precede the emergence of life. 科學家研究非生物過程，以了解化學反應如何先於生命的出現。

meaning: 以非生物的方式；與生命活動無關地
sentences: The teacher gave one simple sentence with abiologically. 老師用這個副詞舉了一個簡單句子。
She marked abiologically in her notebook after class. 她下課後把這個副詞記在筆記本裡。

meaning: 研究非生命物質的科學；與生命科學相對的無機物質研究
sentences: Abiology encompasses the study of mineral processes and chemical reactions that occur without living organisms. 無機物質研究涵蓋了在沒有活生物體的情況下發生的礦物過程和化學反應的研究。
Understanding abiology is important for scientists studying the potential for life on other planets. 理解非生命物質研究對於研究其他行星上生命潛力的科學家來說很重要。

meaning: 無生命；生命活動的缺失（醫學或生物學術語）
sentences: The extreme conditions of the deep ocean once led scientists to assume a state of abiosis in those regions. 深海的極端條件曾導致科學家假設那些地區存在無生命狀態。
Abiosis can result from toxic environmental conditions that make it impossible for organisms to survive. 無生命狀態可能由使生物無法生存的有毒環境條件引起。

meaning: 非生物的；與無生命的環境因素相關的
sentences: Abiotic factors such as light, temperature, and water are essential to the health of any ecosystem. 光線、溫度和水等非生物因素對任何生態系統的健康至關重要。
The researchers measured both biotic and abiotic components of the river system. 研究人員測量了河流系統的生物和非生物成分。

meaning: 與生命力或生存能力逐漸喪失相關的（醫學術語）
sentences: The abiotrophic degeneration of the retinal cells led to gradual and irreversible vision loss. 視網膜細胞的生命力衰退性退化導致逐漸且不可逆的視力喪失。
Abiotrophic conditions are characterized by the premature failure of tissues without any obvious external cause. 生命力衰退性疾病的特徵是組織在沒有明顯外部原因的情況下過早衰竭。

meaning: 生命力或生存能力的逐漸衰退和喪失（醫學術語）
sentences: Abiotrophy of the cerebellum results in a progressive loss of coordination and balance. 小腦的生命力衰退導致協調和平衡能力逐漸喪失。
Veterinarians diagnose abiotrophy in certain dog breeds that show early signs of neurological degeneration. 獸醫在某些表現出早期神經退化跡象的犬種中診斷生命力衰退。
The Abipon were an indigenous group in South America. 阿比彭人是南美洲的一個原住民族群。
They studied the Abipon culture extensively. 他們廣泛研究了阿比彭文化。

meaning: 印度節慶（胡里節）中撒在人身上的彩色粉末
sentences: Children laughed and ran through the streets, throwing abir at each other during the Holi celebration. 孩子們在胡里節慶典期間笑著奔跑在街道上，互相拋灑彩色粉末。
The market stalls were piled high with bags of abir in every color of the rainbow. 市場攤位上堆滿了各種彩虹顏色的彩色粉末袋。

meaning: 能減輕刺激或炎症的物質；鎮靜劑
sentences: The pharmacist recommended an abirritant cream to soothe the patient's inflamed skin. 藥劑師推薦了一種鎮靜乳霜來緩解患者發炎的皮膚。
Certain herbal extracts are used as natural abirritants in traditional medicine. 某些草本提取物在傳統醫學中作為天然鎮靜劑使用。

meaning: 減輕刺激或炎症；使安撫（醫學古語）
sentences: The physician applied a cool compress to abirritate the inflamed tissue around the wound. 醫師施用冷敷布以緩解傷口周圍發炎組織的刺激。
Certain herbal preparations were believed to abirritate irritated mucous membranes in early medicine. 在早期醫學中，某些草本製劑被認為能夠緩解受刺激的黏膜。

meaning: 刺激或炎症的減輕；組織活動性降低的狀態
sentences: The treatment aimed at abirritation of the nerve endings to relieve the patient's chronic pain. 該治療旨在減輕神經末梢的刺激，以緩解患者的慢性疼痛。
Abirritation of the gastrointestinal tract was achieved through a carefully controlled diet. 通過嚴格控制的飲食實現了胃腸道刺激的減輕。

meaning: 具有減輕刺激性質的；具有鎮靜作用的
sentences: The abirritative properties of the herb made it a popular remedy for skin rashes. 這種草藥的鎮靜特性使其成為皮疹的流行療法。
Physicians prescribed abirritative treatments to calm the overactive immune response. 醫師開具了鎮靜治療以平息過度活躍的免疫反應。

meaning: 一種古代用於傷口的止血草藥（古老醫學術語）
sentences: The field medic applied abiston to the wound to slow the bleeding before the surgeon arrived. 野戰醫療兵在外科醫生到達之前將止血草藥敷在傷口上以減緩出血。
Ancient texts mention abiston as a valued plant in early battlefield medicine. 古代文獻提到這種止血草藥是早期戰場醫學中一種有價值的植物。
Abitibi is a region in Canada. 阿比蒂比是加拿大的一個地區。
He visited Lake Abitibi last summer. 去年夏天他參觀了阿比蒂比湖。

meaning: 一種由縮二脲衍生的化學化合物（化學術語）
sentences: The abiuret compound was identified during the spectroscopic analysis of the protein sample. 在蛋白質樣品的光譜分析過程中，識別出了縮二脲衍生化合物。
Researchers used abiuret reagents to detect the presence of proteins in the solution. 研究人員使用縮二脲試劑檢測溶液中蛋白質的存在。

meaning: 淒慘的、極度卑微的。常用來形容困境、失敗或低聲下氣的狀態。
sentences: The report described the refugees' abject living conditions. 報告描述了難民極其淒慘的生活條件。
He offered an abject apology after realizing the harm he had caused. 當他意識到自己造成的傷害後，做出了非常低聲下氣的道歉。

meaning: 極度卑賤或可憐的狀態；極端的貧乏或悲慘
sentences: The refugees' abjectedness moved volunteers to donate their time and resources without hesitation. 難民的極端悲慘狀況感動了志願者毫不猶豫地捐獻他們的時間和資源。
The abjectedness of the conditions in the slums shocked the visiting journalist from abroad. 貧民窟條件的極端惡劣讓來訪的外國記者感到震驚。

meaning: 卑賤；悲慘；極度低落的狀態
sentences: The novel explored the abjection of those living on the margins of society. 這部小說探索了生活在社會邊緣的人們的卑賤處境。
Despite years of abjection, she never lost hope that her situation would improve. 儘管多年處於悲慘境況，她從未失去對情況會改善的希望。

meaning: 卑賤的；令人鄙視的（形容詞，較罕見）
sentences: The critic described the politician's behavior as abjective and unworthy of public office. 評論家將這位政治人物的行為描述為卑賤且不配擔任公職。
Living under abjective conditions shaped her fierce determination to fight for change. 在卑劣的條件下生活塑造了她為爭取變革而堅定的決心。

meaning: 卑賤地；悲慘地；以極度低落的方式
sentences: He abjectly apologized to the board, admitting full responsibility for the financial loss. 他卑微地向董事會道歉，承認對財務損失負全責。
The defeated army abjectly surrendered, laying down its arms without conditions. 戰敗的軍隊卑微地投降，無條件放下武器。

meaning: 卑賤的性質或狀態；悲慘
sentences: The abjectness of his poverty was evident in the tattered clothes he wore. 他的貧困卑微從他穿著的破舊衣物中顯而易見。
Reformers worked tirelessly to lift communities out of the abjectness caused by systemic inequality. 改革者不知疲倦地工作，將社區從系統性不平等造成的卑賤狀態中解救出來。

meaning: （真菌學）通過橫膈膜分離出孢子（植物學術語）
sentences: The fungus uses a specialized mechanism to abjoint spores from the hyphae for dispersal. 這種真菌使用特殊機制從菌絲中分離孢子以進行擴散。
Under the microscope, one can observe how the organism abjoints spores during reproduction. 在顯微鏡下，可以觀察到生物在繁殖過程中如何分離孢子。

meaning: 通過法律判決剝奪；裁定剝奪（古老法律術語）
sentences: The court moved to abjudge the disputed property from the claimant based on lack of evidence. 法院以缺乏證據為由，裁定剝奪申請人的爭議財產。
To abjudge someone of their rights requires a formal legal proceeding and clear justification. 剝奪某人的權利需要正式的法律程序和明確的理由。

meaning: 通過司法裁決剝奪或判定（古老法律術語）
sentences: The tribunal was convened to abjudicate the land claims of the rival noble families. 法庭召開以裁決競爭貴族家庭的土地主張。
It is rarely used today, but to abjudicate once meant to formally settle a legal dispute through judgment. 現在很少使用，但過去的意思是通過判決正式解決法律糾紛。

meaning: 通過司法裁決剝奪的行為（古老法律術語）
sentences: The abjudication of the estate was completed after months of legal proceedings. 在數月的法律程序後，對遺產的司法裁奪完成了。
Abjudication was a formal legal process used in medieval courts to settle property disputes. 司法裁奪是中世紀法庭用於解決財產糾紛的正式法律程序。

meaning: （真菌）通過橫膈膜分離孢子的過程
sentences: Abjunction is the process by which spores are cut off from the parent hypha in certain fungi. 孢子分離是某些真菌中孢子從親代菌絲切離的過程。
The biologist photographed each stage of abjunction to document the reproductive cycle of the mold. 生物學家拍攝了孢子分離的每個階段，以記錄黴菌的繁殖週期。

meaning: 涉及分離或切斷的；用於從整體中切除的
sentences: The abjunctive mechanism of the fungus allows it to release spores rapidly under favorable conditions. 這種真菌的分離機制使其能夠在有利條件下迅速釋放孢子。
Biologists use the term abjunctive to describe the cutting process observed during spore formation. 生物學家使用「分離的」這個術語描述孢子形成過程中觀察到的切割過程。

meaning: 公開放棄；正式宣誓放棄某種信仰、忠誠或主張
sentences: The prisoner's abjuration of his former beliefs was required before he could be released. 囚犯必須公開放棄他以前的信仰才能獲釋。
The abjuration of heresy was a solemn ceremony in the medieval Catholic Church. 放棄異端是中世紀天主教會的莊嚴儀式。

meaning: 涉及或包含正式放棄的；與宣誓放棄相關的
sentences: The defendant signed an abjuratory statement before the court renouncing all claims to the property. 被告在法庭前簽署了一份放棄聲明，放棄對財產的所有主張。
The abjuratory oath required by the inquisitors was considered both a legal and spiritual act. 審訊者要求的放棄誓詞被認為既是法律行為也是靈性行為。

sentences: The ablastous seeds were discarded as they would not germinate under any conditions. 這些無發芽能力的種子被丟棄，因為它們在任何條件下都不會發芽。
Ablastous cells found in the sample indicated that the tissue had lost its regenerative capacity. 樣品中發現的無繁殖能力細胞表明組織已失去其再生能力。

meaning: 消融；切除；通過熱或蒸發去除

meaning: 奪格的；（語法）拉丁語中的奪格；（火箭）隔熱消融材料

meaning: 放棄；克制；否認自我或需求

The team reported a new method for synthesizing acetylcarbazole. (團隊報告了一種合成乙醯咔唑的新方法。)

Acetylcholine is a neurotransmitter that plays a role in muscle movement. (乙醯膽鹼是一種在肌肉運動中起作用的神經遞質。)
Certain drugs work by inhibiting the breakdown of acetylcholine. (某些藥物通過抑制乙醯膽鹼的分解來發揮作用。)
Acetylcyanide is a highly reactive chemical used in synthesis. (乙醯氰是一種用於合成的高反應性化學物質。)
Extreme caution is required when working with acetylcyanide due to its toxicity. (由於乙醯氰具有毒性，使用時需要極其小心。)

The industrial acetylenation of various alcohols was improved. (各種醇的工業乙炔化得到了改進。)

Calcium carbide reacts with water to produce acetylene gas. (碳化鈣與水反應產生乙炔氣。)
Acetylenediurein is also known by its trade name Glycoluril. (乙炔二脲也以其貿易名稱甘脲而聞名。)

Acetylenic compounds contain at least one carbon-carbon triple bond. (乙炔系化合物至少含有一個碳碳三鍵。)
The chemist studied the reactivity of acetylenic ethers. (化學家研究了乙炔醚的反應活性。)
The acetylenyl radical is a highly unstable species. (乙炔基自由基是一種高度不穩定的物種。)
Substitution with an acetylenyl group changes the electronic properties. (用乙炔基取代會改變電子特性。)
Acetylfluoride is a volatile liquid used in fluorination reactions. (乙醯氟是用於氟化反應的揮發性液體。)
The synthesis of acetylfluoride must be carried out in a fume hood. (乙醯氟的合成必須在通風櫥中進行。)
Acetylglycine is an N-acetylated form of the amino acid glycine. (乙醯甘氨酸是氨基酸甘氨酸的 N-乙醯化形式。)
He used acetylglycine as a starting material in his research. (他在研究中使用乙醯甘氨酸作為起始原料。)
Acetylhydrazine is a metabolite of the anti-tuberculosis drug isoniazid. (乙醯肼是抗結核藥物異煙肼的代謝產物。)
Toxicological studies on acetylhydrazine were conducted on rats. (對大鼠進行了乙醯肼的毒理學研究。)
The acetylic character of the substance was confirmed by analysis. (通過分析證實了該物質的乙醯特性。)

Copper acetylide is a sensitive explosive. (乙炔化銅是一種敏感的爆炸物。)
Sodium acetylide is used as a reagent in organic synthesis. (乙炔化鈉在有機合成中用作試劑。)
Acetyliodide is used as an acetylating agent in certain reactions. (乙醯碘在某些反應中用作乙醯化劑。)
The decomposition of acetyliodide was observed upon exposure to light. (觀察到乙醯碘在光照下會發生分解。)
The hydroxyl groups in the molecule are easily acetylizable. (分子中的羥基很容易被乙醯化。)
He tested whether the unknown compound was acetylizable. (他測試了該未知化合物是否可以乙醯化。)
Acetylization is used to protect functional groups during synthesis. (乙醯化作用用於在合成過程中保護官能團。)
The degree of acetylization affects the properties of the polymer. (乙醯化程度會影響聚合物的性能。)
You can acetylize salicylic acid to make aspirin. (你可以使水楊酸乙醯化來製造阿司匹林。)
The technician was instructed to acetylize the sample for testing. (技術人員接到指示要將樣品乙醯化以便測試。)
The laboratory purchased a new acetylizer for their experiments. (實驗室為他們的實驗購買了一個新的乙醯化裝置。)
Acetyl chloride is a common acetylizer used in chemistry. (乙醯氯是化學中常用的乙醯化劑。)

meaning: 乙醯甲基甲醇；乙醯丙醇
sentences: Acetylmethylcarbinol is another name for acetoin. (乙醯甲基甲醇是 acetoin 的另一個名稱。)
It is an important flavor compound in dairy products. (它是乳製品中重要的風味化合物。)
Acetylperoxide is a powerful oxidizing agent. (過氧化乙醯是一種強氧化劑。)
Handle acetylperoxide with extreme care as it is explosive when pure. (處理過氧化乙醯時要極其小心，因為純品具有爆炸性。)
Acetylphenol is also known as phenyl acetate. (乙醯苯酚也被稱為乙酸苯酯。)
The chemist synthesized acetylphenol from phenol and acetic anhydride. (化學家由苯酚和乙酸酐合成了乙醯苯酚。)
Acetylphenylhydrazine is used in biomedical research to induce hemolytic anemia in lab animals. (乙醯苯肼在生物醫學研究中用於誘導實驗動物發生溶血性貧血。)
Careful dosage of acetylphenylhydrazine is required for the experiment. (實驗需要仔細控制乙醯苯肼的劑量。)
Acetylrosaniline is a derivative of the dye rosaniline. (乙醯玫瑰苯胺是染料玫瑰苯胺的衍生物。)
The coloring properties of acetylrosaniline were tested on silk fibers. (測試了乙醯玫瑰苯胺在絲綢纖維上的著色性能。)
Sodium acetylsalicylate is a water-soluble form of aspirin. (乙醯水楊酸鈉是阿司匹林的一種水溶性形式。)
The doctor prescribed an acetylsalicylate for the patient's pain. (醫生為患者的疼痛開了乙醯水楊酸鹽藥物。)
Acetylsalol is a chemical compound used in historical medicine. (乙醯薩羅是歷史醫學中使用的一種化合物。)
Researchers studied the metabolic breakdown of acetylsalol. (研究人員研究了乙醯薩羅的代謝分解。)
Acetyltannin is used as an astringent in some pharmaceutical applications. (乙醯單寧在某些藥物應用中用作收斂劑。)
The patient was treated with a solution containing acetyltannin. (患者接受了含有乙醯單寧溶液的治療。)
Acetylthymol is an ester derived from thymol. (乙醯百里酚是衍生自百里酚的酯。)
It has been investigated for its potential antiseptic properties. (已對其潛在的防腐性能進行了研究。)
Acetyltropeine is an alkaloid derivative with physiological effects. (乙醯托品鹼是具有生理作用的生物鹼衍生物。)
The scientist isolated acetyltropeine from the plant extract. (科學家從植物提取物中分離出了乙醯托品鹼。)
Acetylurea is an organic compound that can be synthesized from urea. (乙醯脲是可以由尿素合成的有機化合物。)
The melting point of acetylurea was measured accurately. (準確測量了乙醯脲的熔點。)

meaning: （表示痛苦、驚訝、悔恨等的感嘆詞）啊！哎呀！
sentences: "Ach, I forgot my keys again!" he exclaimed. (“哎呀，我又忘帶鑰匙了！”他大喊道。)
Ach, what a pity that you cannot come with us. (唉，你不能和我們一起去真可惜。)
The Achaean League was a significant political entity in ancient Greece. (亞該亞同盟是古希臘一個重要的政治實體。)
Homer often referred to the Greeks as Achaeans in the Iliad. (荷馬在《伊利亞特》中經常稱希臘人為亞該亞人。)
The Achaemenian Empire was the first Persian Empire. (阿契美尼德帝國是第一個波斯帝國。)
Many magnificent ruins remain from the Achaemenian period. (阿契美尼德時期留下了許多宏偉的遺跡。)

meaning: 阿契美尼德王朝的；阿契美尼德人
sentences: Cyrus the Great was the founder of the Achaemenid dynasty. (居魯士大帝是阿契美尼德王朝的創始人。)
Achaemenid art is known for its intricate metalwork and reliefs. (阿契美尼德藝術以其複雜的金屬工藝和浮雕而聞名。)
The Achaemenidae ruled Persia for over two centuries. (阿契美尼德家族統治波斯超過兩個世紀。)
Historians study the genealogy of the Achaemenidae. (歷史學家研究阿契美尼德家族的族譜。)
The Achaemenidian kings built Persepolis as their ceremonial capital. (阿契美尼德王朝的國王們建造了波斯波利斯作為他們的儀式之都。)
Scholars translate Achaemenidian inscriptions found in ancient sites. (學者們翻譯在古代遺跡中發現的阿契美尼德銘文。)

meaning: 溝齒獸（一種已滅絕的哺乳動物）
sentences: Achaenodon was a large, pig-like animal that lived during the Eocene. (溝齒獸是一種生活在始新世的大型類豬動物。)
Fossils of Achaenodon have been discovered in North America. (在北美發現了溝齒獸的化石。)
Achaeta slide through the soil without bristles. 無毛類會不帶剛毛地鑽進土裡。
The biologist studied an Achaeta in a wet jar. 那位生物學家在濕潤的罐子裡研究一條無毛類生物。
The larvae are described as achaetous during this stage of development. (在發育的這個階段，幼蟲被描述為無剛毛的。)
An achaetous worm is distinct from those with many bristles. (無剛毛蠕蟲與那些有很多剛毛的蠕蟲截然不同。)

meaning: 疼痛（ache 的舊稱或變體）
sentences: The word achage appears in some Middle English texts. (achage 這個詞出現在一些中古英語文本中。)
He felt a constant achage in his joints. (他感到關節持續疼痛。)

meaning: 阿查瓜人（哥倫比亞和委內瑞拉的原住民）
sentences: The Achagua people traditionally lived in the Orinoco basin. (阿查瓜人傳統上生活在奧里諾科河流域。)
Linguists study the language spoken by the Achagua. (語言學家研究阿查瓜人所說的語言。)

meaning: 阿查克扎伊（普什圖人的一個部落）
sentences: The Achakzai tribe is primarily located in Pakistan and Afghanistan. (阿查克扎伊部落主要位於巴基斯坦和阿富汗。)

Achalasia is a disorder that makes it difficult for food to enter the stomach. (賁門失弛緩症是一種使食物難以進入胃部的疾病。)
Symptoms of achalasia include difficulty swallowing and chest pain. (賁門失弛緩症的症狀包括吞嚥困難和胸痛。)

meaning: 阿查莫思（諾斯底教用語）
sentences: In Gnosticism, Achamoth is a personification of wisdom outside the Pleroma. (在諾斯底教中，阿查莫思是普樂滿之外智慧的化身。)
The myths involving Achamoth are complex and symbolic. (涉及阿查莫思的神話複雜且具有象徵意義。)

meaning: 阿昌戈人（非洲的一個部落）
sentences: The Achango are known for their unique cultural traditions. (阿昌戈人以其獨特的文化傳統而聞名。)

Achariaceae is a family of flowering plants. (大風子科是一個開花植物科。)

The specimen displays typical Achariaceous features. (該標本顯示了典型的大風子科特徵。)

Achate was a term used for agate in archaic English. (Achate 是古英語中對瑪瑙的稱呼。)

meaning: 亞琛（德國城市 Aachen 的變體）
sentences: The historical city of Achen is famous for its cathedral. (歷史名城亞琛以其大教堂而聞名。)
Charlemagne often resided in Achen. (查理曼大帝經常居住在亞琛。)
A strawberry's surface is covered with many small achenes. (草莓的表面覆蓋著許多小瘦果。)
The dandelion seed is technically an achene. (蒲公英種子在技術上是一個瘦果。)
The achenial fruits are dispersed by the wind. (這些瘦果由風散播。)
He examined the achenial structure under a microscope. (他在顯微鏡下檢查了瘦果結構。)

An achenium contains a single seed that does not adhere to the pericarp. (瘦果包含一個不粘附於果皮的單一種子。)

Achernar is a very hot, blue-white star. (水委一是一顆非常熱的藍白色恆星。)

meaning: 阿格隆河的；陰暗的；地獄般的
sentences: The Acheronian darkness was terrifying to the explorers. (阿格隆河般的黑暗讓探險者們感到恐懼。)

The Acherontic gloom of the cavern suppressed their spirits. (洞穴中陰森的憂鬱壓抑了他們的情緒。)
Acherontic myths are often explored in classical literature. (古典文學中經常探討與阿格隆河相關的神話。)
The poet used Acherontical imagery to describe the scene of despair. (詩人使用地獄般的意象來描述絕望的場景。)
The atmosphere felt Acherontical and ominous. (氣氛感覺陰森且不祥。)

meaning: 蟋蟀（achetidae 的單數形式或舊稱）
sentences: The achete chirps loudly during the summer nights. (蟋蟀在夏夜大聲鳴叫。)
Naturalists observed the behavior of the achete in the meadow. (博物學家在草地觀察蟋蟀的行為。)

meaning: 蟋蟀科（現通常稱為 Gryllidae）
sentences: Achetidae is an older family name for what we now call crickets. (Achetidae 是我們現在所說的蟋蟀的一個較舊的科名。)
The collection includes various specimens from the Achetidae family. (該收藏品包括來自蟋蟀科的各種標本。)
Acheulean hand axes are characteristic tools of the Lower Paleolithic. (阿舍利手斧是舊石器時代早期的特徵工具。)
The Acheulean culture is named after the site of Saint-Acheul in France. (阿舍利文化以法國的聖阿舍利遺址命名。)
The herb garden still kept a patch of acheweed by the wall. 這座藥草園的牆邊還留著一小片古稱芹菜的草本植物。

We need to set realistic and achievable goals for the new project. 我們需要為新專案設定現實且可達成的目標。

The team achieved a remarkable victory in the championship. 該隊在錦標賽中取得了一次顯著的勝利。
You can achieve anything you want if you work hard enough. 只要妳足夠努力，妳可以實現任何目標。
Winning the gold medal was his greatest professional achievement. 贏得金牌是他最大的職業成就。

The achigan is a popular game fish in North America. (黑鱸是北美洲受歡迎的游釣魚。)
He caught a large achigan during his fishing trip to the lake. (他在湖邊釣魚時釣到了一條大黑鱸。)
Achilary flowers lack the specialized labellum found in many orchids. (無唇瓣花缺乏許多蘭花中常見的專門唇瓣。)
The botanist described the mutant orchid as being achilary. (植物學家將這株變異蘭花描述為無唇瓣的。)

meaning: 阿基爾島（愛爾蘭最大的島嶼）
sentences: Achill Island is known for its rugged landscape and beautiful beaches. (阿基爾島以其崎嶇的地形和美麗的海灘而聞名。)
