The professor lamented the agnosy of modern students regarding history. 教授對現代學生對歷史的無知感到惋惜。
The Agnotozoic era predates the appearance of complex multicellular organisms. 前寒武紀時期早於複雜多細胞生物的出現。
Agnotozoic rocks are often highly metamorphosed. 前寒武紀岩石通常高度變質。
The Agnus Dei is a common prayer in Christian liturgy. “上帝的羔羊”是基督教禮拜儀式中的常用禱文。
An agnus was often used as a symbol of purity and innocence. 羔羊常被用作純潔和無辜的象徵。
I finished my project two hours ago. 我兩小時前就完成專案了。
Long ago, there lived a beautiful princess in a castle. 很久以前，一位美麗的公主住在城堡裡。

meaning: 興奮的；急切的；熱切期待的
sentences: The children were all agog to see their Christmas presents. 孩子們都急切地想看看他們的聖誕禮物。

meaning: （音樂）速度變化的；（語言學）重音的
sentences: An agogic accent is created by dwelling on a note for longer than its literal value. 變速重音是通過在一個音符上停留比其實際時值更長的時間來產生的。
The pianist used agogic nuances to express the emotion of the piece. 鋼琴家利用速度變化的細微差別來表達作品的情感。
Agogics deals with the variations in tempo that are not strictly indicated by the notation. 變速論處理那些並非由記譜法嚴格標示的速度變化。
Mastery of agogics is essential for a compelling musical performance. 掌握速度變化法對於引人入勝的音樂表演至關重要。

meaning: 木麻黃（產於菲律賓的一種樹）
sentences: The agoho tree is often used for coastal reforestation in the Philippines. 木麻黃樹常用於菲律賓的沿海造林。
The wood of the agoho is known for being hard and durable. 木麻黃的木材以堅硬耐用而聞名。
Once the engine was agoing, we could finally start our journey. 一旦引擎運轉起來，我們終於可以開始旅程了。
He set the wheels of industry agoing in the small town. 他在這個小鎮上開動了工業的巨輪。

meaning: （醫學）卵巢激素製劑（用於治療月經失調）
sentences: The doctor prescribed agomensin for her cycle problems. 醫生開了卵巢激素製劑來治療她的月經問題。

The dentist checked for signs of agomphiasis during the exam. 牙醫在檢查期間檢查了牙齒鬆動的跡象。
The agomphious condition of the fossil suggested it belonged to a bird. 化石無牙的情況表明它屬於一隻鳥。
An agomphious animal must rely on other means to grind its food. 無牙動物必須依靠其他方式來磨碎食物。
Agomphosis is a condition where the teeth are no longer firmly fixed in their sockets. 牙齒鬆動是指牙齒不再牢固地固定在牙槽中的情況。
The patient complained of agomphosis after the accident. 事故發生後，患者抱怨牙齒鬆動。
The tragic agon between the hero and the villain reached its climax. 英雄與惡棍之間的悲劇性對抗達到了高潮。

The patient's agonal breathing indicated that death was near. 患者的臨終呼吸表明死亡臨近。
He studied the agonal phase of biological systems under stress. 他研究了壓力下生物系統的競賽階段（或瀕死階段）。

meaning: 以前（ago的古語或詩歌用語）
sentences: This event happened many years agone. 這件事發生在多年前。
In days agone, this castle was full of life. 在過去的日子裡，這座城堡充滿了活力。

meaning: 雞蛋花皮（用於製作藥物）
sentences: Agoniada is sometimes used in traditional medicine for its healing properties. Agoniada 有時因其療效而被用於傳統醫學。
The extract from agoniada is believed to help with digestion. 雞蛋花皮的提取物被認為有助於消化。
Agoniadin is a bitter principle found in the bark of certain trees. 雞蛋花苷是在某些樹皮中發現的一種苦味成分。
Chemists analyzed the structure of agoniadin for potential pharmaceutical use. 化學家分析了雞蛋花苷的結構，以探尋其潛在的藥用價值。

meaning: （古生物）稜菊石類的頭足類動物
sentences: The fossil of an agoniatite was found in the Devonian layer. 在泥盆紀地層中發現了稜菊石的化石。
Agoniatites are ancestors of the later ammonites. 稜菊石是後來菊石的祖先。
Agoniatites is a genus of extinct cephalopods known for their spiral shells. 稜菊石屬是一類已滅絕的頭足類動物，以其螺旋形外殼而聞名。
Paleontologists use Agoniatites as index fossils for the Middle Devonian. 古生物學家將稜菊石屬作為中泥盆世的標準化石。

meaning: 無偏差的；（地圖上）無磁偏線的
sentences: The agonic line connects points where magnetic north and true north are the same. 無磁偏線連接了磁北和真北相同的點。
A compass shows no declination along an agonic line. 沿著無磁偏線，指南針不顯示偏角。
The agonied cry of the wounded animal haunted him. 受傷動物極其痛苦的哀鳴一直縈繞在他心頭。
She gave an agonied look as she realized the extent of the damage. 當她意識到受損程度時，露出了極其痛苦的表情。

meaning: 當另一塊肌肉放鬆時收縮。
sentences: When bending the elbow, the biceps is the agonist. 彎曲手肘時，二頭肌是主動肌。
The term agonist refers to The muscle that contracts while the other relaxes. 激動劑一詞是指在另一塊肌肉放鬆時收縮的肌肉。

Historians study the influence of the Agonista on local traditions. 歷史學家研究阿貢派對當地傳統的影響。

meaning: （古希臘）競技場管理員；體育教練
sentences: The agonistarch was responsible for training athletes for the games. 競技場管理員負責為比賽訓練運動員。
In ancient Athens, the role of an agonistarch was highly respected. 在古雅典，競技場管理員的角色備受尊敬。

meaning: 好爭論的；競技的；（生物）攻擊行為的
sentences: The two male lions engaged in agonistic behavior to defend their territory. 兩隻雄獅進行了攻擊性行為以保衛領地。
His agonistic style of debate often alienated his colleagues. 他那好爭論的辯論風格常常疏遠他的同事。
The rival companies competed agonistically for market share. 競爭對手公司為了市場份額進行了激烈的競爭。
He responded agonistically to every suggestion made by the team. 他對團隊提出的每一個建議都報以好爭論的反應。
The curriculum included training in agonistics to prepare students for public life. 課程包括競爭訓練，以幫助學生為公眾生活做好準備。
Agonistics was a key part of education in ancient Greece. 競技是古希臘教育的關鍵組成部分。
The priest prepared the altar for the agonium at dawn. 祭司在清晨為這個祭神日整理祭壇。

The parent waited agonizedly for news of their missing child. 家長焦急萬分地等待著失蹤孩子的消息。

meaning: 使人感到極度痛苦的人或物
sentences: The difficult puzzle was a real agonizer for everyone in the room. 這個困難的謎題對房間裡的每個人來說都是一個真正的折磨。

sentences: The clock ticked agonizingly slowly as she waited for the results. 在等結果時，時鐘滴答滴答地走得慢得讓人難受。

sentences: The agora was the heart of public life in ancient Athens. 集市是古雅典公共生活的中心。

Conservation efforts are in place to protect the endangered agouta. 保護工作正在進行中，以保護瀕危的海地溝齒鼩。

sentences: The agouti is a rodent found in Central and South American rainforests. 刺豚鼠是發現於中南美洲熱帶雨林的一種囓齒動物。

meaning: 阿格拉（印度城市，泰姬陵所在地）

She found an ancient agraffee while searching the ruins. 她在搜尋遺跡時發現了一個古老的掛鉤。

sentences: The small agrah provided shelter from the heavy rains. 這個小房子為人們提供了躲避暴雨的住所。

He made several agrammatical errors during his speech. 他在演講中犯了幾個語法錯誤。

sentences: The calendar marked Agrania as an ancient Greek festival. 那本日曆把阿格拉尼亞標成古希臘節日。

Lymphocytes and monocytes are types of agranulocyte. 淋巴細胞和單核細胞是無顆粒白血球的類型。

meaning: 野生；說的是在耕地裡生長的植物。

sentences: The society was agrarianly oriented for many centuries. 幾個世紀以來，這個社會一直是以農業為導向的。

meaning: 患瘧疾的；發冷的；顫抖的
sentences: The cold wind left him feeling aguish and miserable. 冷風讓他感到渾身發冷，非常難受。
He had an aguish complexion due to his long illness. 由於長期的疾病，他面色發青，顯得病怏怏的。
He shivered aguishly as he stepped out into the snow. 他踏入雪地時，冷得瑟瑟發抖。
She looked aguishly at the frozen lake. 她縮著脖子看著冰凍的湖面。

meaning: 發冷；寒顫；患瘧疾的狀態
sentences: The sudden aguishness was a sign of a coming fever. 突然的發冷是即將發燒的跡象。
The patient's aguishness subsided after the medication. 服藥後，患者的寒顫減輕了。

meaning: （猶太法）被遺棄或無法再婚的婦女（其丈夫失蹤或拒絕給予休書）
sentences: The plight of the agunah is a complex issue in Jewish religious law. 在猶太宗教法律中，無法再婚的婦女的困境是一個複雜的問題。
Community organizations work to support the agunah in her legal struggle. 社區組織致力於支持這些婦女進行法律鬥爭。
The water came agush from the broken pipe. 水從破裂的管道中噴湧而出。
Her tears fell agush as she heard the sad news. 聽到這個悲傷的消息時，她的眼淚奪眶而出。

meaning: 可怕的；令人敬畏的（古語）
sentences: The cathedral was an agust sight in the moonlight. 大教堂在月光下顯得莊嚴而神聖。
The warrior had an agust presence on the battlefield. 戰士在戰場上有一種令人敬畏的氣勢。
The picture on the wall was hanging a bit agy. 牆上的畫掛得有點歪。
Everything seemed to go agy that morning. 那天早上一切似乎都不太對勁。

meaning: （希臘神話）阿吉埃烏斯（阿波羅的稱號之一，意為“街道的守護神”）
sentences: Agyieus was invoked to protect the thresholds and streets of the city. 人們祈求阿吉埃烏斯保護城市的門檻和街道。
The conical pillars dedicated to Agyieus stood before the houses. 房屋前立著獻給阿吉埃烏斯的圓錐形柱子。
The botanist identified the flower as agynarious. 植物學家鑑定這朵花是無雌蕊的。
Agynarious plants cannot produce seeds without fertilization from other flowers. 無雌蕊植物如果沒有其他花朵的受精，就無法產生種子。
The agynary specimen was collected for further study. 採集了這個無雌蕊標本以供進一步研究。
Certain cultivars are specifically selected to be agynary. 某些栽培品種是專門選擇為無雌蕊的。
The agynous trait is a result of a specific genetic mutation. 無雌蕊特徵是特定基因突變的結果。
He studied the development of agynous flowers in the laboratory. 他在實驗室研究了無雌蕊花的發育。
The agyrate movement of the particle was unexpected. 該粒子的非旋轉運動是出乎意料的。
The shell was agyrate, lacking the typical spiral form. 這個貝殼是不旋轉的，缺乏典型的螺旋形狀。
Agyria is a serious brain malformation where the folds are missing. 平腦症是一種嚴重的大腦畸形，表現為缺乏腦回。
Children with agyria often suffer from severe developmental delays. 患有平腦症的兒童通常會有嚴重的發育遲緩。

meaning: 啊；哈（表示驚訝、喜悅、痛苦等感嘆詞）
sentences: Ah, now I understand what you mean. 啊，現在我明白你的意思了。
Ah, what a beautiful sunset! 啊，多麼美麗的日落啊！

meaning: （感嘆詞）啊；（表示理解或遺憾等）
sentences: Ah, that's a shame about your car. 唉，你的車真可惜。
Ah, I see where I made the mistake. 哦，我看到我在哪裡犯錯了。

meaning: （感嘆詞）啊哈（表示發現、驚訝、勝利等）
sentences: Aha! I finally found the lost key. 啊哈！我終於找到了丟失的鑰匙。
Aha! So you were the one who ate the last cookie. 啊哈！原來是你吃了最後一塊餅乾。
The family gathered for a traditional ahaaina to celebrate the new year. 家人聚在一起舉行傳統盛宴以慶祝新年。
The ahaaina featured various local delicacies and dances. 這場盛宴以各種當地美食和舞蹈為特色。
His ahankara made him refuse help. 他的我執讓他拒絕別人的幫忙。
Meditation helped her soften ahankara. 冥想幫助她放下了一些我執。

meaning: 阿漢楚尤克人（俄勒岡州的一個原住民族）
sentences: The Ahantchuyuk were a Kalapuyan people of the Willamette Valley. 阿漢楚尤克人是威拉米特山谷的卡拉普亞人的一支。
Historical accounts describe the daily life of the Ahantchuyuk. 歷史記載描述了阿漢楚尤克人的日常生活。
The seeds of the ahartalav are sometimes used for decoration. 這種植物的種子有時用於裝飾。
He found an ahartalav growing by the edge of the stream. 他在溪邊發現了一株這種植物。

meaning: 蹲著地；（古語）靠在臀部地
sentences: The dog sat ahaunch, waiting for a command. 那隻狗蹲坐在那裡，等待著命令。
He was sitting ahaunch on the low stool. 他蹲坐在矮凳上。
Please look ahead and stay focused on the road while driving. 駕駛時請向前看並保持專注。
Our company is planning for the challenges that lie ahead. 我們公司正為未來的挑戰做準備。
The fallen leaves lay aheap in the corner of the garden. 落葉在花園角落裡堆成一堆。
Books were piled aheap on the messy desk. 書在雜亂的桌子上堆得高高的。

meaning: 表示微妙的諷刺、禮貌的謊言或委婉語。
sentences: I really (ahem!) liked the chocolate broccoli surprise. 我真的（咳！）很喜歡巧克力西蘭花的驚喜。
The word ahem is used in English writing and speech. 嗯哼這個字是用在英文寫作和演講。
The term Ahepatokla refers to being together in the Choctaw language. Ahepatokla 在喬克托語中指的是在一起的意思。
They practiced Ahepatokla during their community gatherings. 他們在社區聚會中實踐聚集的精神。

meaning: 阿特人（努查努阿特人的變體）
sentences: Ahet is a historical variant name for certain indigenous groups in North America. Ahet 是北美某些原住民群體的一個歷史變體名稱。
Anthropologists studied the cultural heritage of the Ahet people. 人類學家研究了阿特人的文化遺產。

meaning: 嘿（感嘆詞，用於引起注意）
sentences: Ahey! Can you hear me over there? 嘿！你在那邊能聽到我說話嗎？
He shouted 'ahey' to grab the attention of the passing sailor. 他大喊一聲「嘿」以引起路過水手的注意。

meaning: 不殺生；非暴力（印度教、佛教與耆那教教義）
sentences: Ahimsa is a core principle of many Eastern religions, emphasizing non-violence. 不殺生是許多東方宗教的核心原則，強調非暴力。
Mahatma Gandhi was a famous practitioner of ahimsa. 聖雄甘地是著名的非暴力實踐者。
He stood ahind the wall to stay out of the wind. 他站在牆後以避風。
The child hid ahind his mother's skirt. 孩子躲在他母親的裙子後面。
Look ahint the door to find the hidden key. 看門後面找找藏起來的鑰匙。
The sun dipped ahint the hills in the late afternoon. 午後太陽落到了山後。

meaning: 阿希爾人（印度傳統牧羊種姓）
sentences: The Ahir community is traditionally known for cattle herding in India. 阿希爾社區在印度傳統上以放牧牲畜聞名。
He belongs to the Ahir caste of North India. 他屬於北印度的阿希爾種姓。

meaning: 阿魯瓦利亞（錫克教姓氏）
sentences: Ahluwalia is a respected surname among the Sikh community. 阿魯瓦利亞是錫克教社群中受人尊敬的姓氏。
Mr. Ahluwalia joined the diplomatic service last year. 阿魯瓦利亞先生去年加入了外交部門。
An Ahmadi follows the teachings of the Ahmadiyya movement. 阿赫邁底亞教派成員遵循阿赫邁底亞運動的教義。
The Ahmadi community organized a local food drive. 阿赫邁底亞社群組織了一次當地的糧食捐贈活動。

meaning: 阿赫邁底亞（伊斯蘭教改革派運動）
sentences: Ahmadiya is an Islamic religious movement founded in British India. 阿赫邁底亞是創立於英屬印度的一個伊斯蘭宗教運動。
The beliefs of Ahmadiya differ from mainstream Islam in certain aspects. 阿赫邁底亞的信仰在某些方面與主流伊斯蘭教不同。

meaning: 艾哈邁德（常見阿拉伯人名）
sentences: Ahmed is a very popular name in many Muslim countries. 艾哈邁德在許多穆斯林國家是非常受歡迎的名字。
Professor Ahmed lectured on ancient history. 艾哈邁德教授做了關於古代歷史的講座。

meaning: 艾哈邁特（艾哈邁德的土耳其語形式）
sentences: Ahmet is the Turkish version of the name Ahmed. Ahmet 是艾哈邁德這個名字的土耳其語版本。
Ahmet's family moved to Istanbul when he was a child. 艾哈邁特的家人在他小時候搬到了伊斯坦堡。
Ahnfeltia is a genus of red algae used in the production of agar. 安斐藻屬是一種用於生產瓊脂的紅藻。
Scientists study Ahnfeltia for its unique biological properties. 科學家因安斐藻屬獨特的生物學特性而對其進行研究。

meaning: 招呼聲；喊叫（用於打招呼或引起注意）
sentences: He said aho when he realized his mistake. 他發現自己弄錯時喊了一聲「天啊」。
The character uses aho in the old play. 那個角色在舊劇本裡用這個感嘆詞。

meaning: 阿豪姆人（印度阿薩姆邦的民族）
sentences: The Ahom people ruled the Ahom kingdom for centuries. 阿豪姆人統治了阿豪姆王國幾個世紀。
Ahom culture is a rich part of the heritage of Northeast India. 阿豪姆文化是印度東北部遺產中豐富的一部分。

meaning: 阿訇（伊斯蘭教教職人員，主要用於中國回族）
sentences: The ahong leads the community in prayer at the mosque. 阿訇在清真寺帶領社群進行禮拜。
The village ahong is respected for his knowledge of Islamic law. 村裡的阿訇因其對伊斯蘭法律的知識而受到尊敬。
The messenger traveled ahorse to deliver the news quickly. 信使騎馬旅行，以便快速送達消息。
They were ahorse by dawn to begin their journey. 他們黎明時分就已上馬，開始了旅程。
He preferred traveling ahorseback rather than walking. 他喜歡騎馬旅行而不是步行。
The soldiers arrived ahorseback at the castle gate. 士兵們騎著馬抵達城堡大門。

meaning: 阿胡薩特人（加拿大卑詩省的原住民族）
sentences: The Ahousaht First Nation is located on Vancouver Island. 阿胡薩特原住民群體位於溫哥華島。
Traditional fishing is an important part of Ahousaht life. 傳統捕魚是阿胡薩特人生活的重要組成部分。

meaning: 喂；喂，那邊的船（航海呼叫用語）
sentences: 'Ship ahoy!' the lookout shouted from the crow's nest. 「那邊有船！」瞭望員從桅頂瞭望台大聲喊道。
He yelled 'ahoy' to catch the attention of the dock workers. 他大喊一聲「喂」以引起碼頭工人的注意。

meaning: 阿倫達若農人（休倫聯盟中的一個部落）
sentences: The Ahrendahronon were known as the Rock People within the Huron Confederacy. 阿倫達若農人在休倫聯盟中被稱為「岩石之民」。
Historic records document the villages of the Ahrendahronon. 歷史記錄記載了阿倫達若農人的村莊。
In Zoroastrianism, Ahriman is the personification of evil. 在祆教中，阿里曼是邪惡的化身。
Ahriman is the eternal enemy of Ahura Mazda, the god of light. 阿里曼是光明之神阿胡拉·馬茲達的永恆敵人。
The ancient texts described Ahrimanian spirits that plagued the world. 古代文獻描述了困擾世界的阿里曼邪靈。
Some philosophical views associate darkness with Ahrimanian forces. 一些哲學觀點將黑暗與阿里曼的力量聯繫在一起。

meaning: 最好的；最優美的（阿拉伯語）
sentences: Ahsan is an Arabic word meaning the most excellent or beautiful. Ahsan 是一個阿拉伯語詞彙，意為最優秀或最美麗。
The name Ahsan is often given to children to wish them a virtuous life. Ahsan 這個名字通常被賦予孩子，希望能過上美德的生活。

meaning: 阿特人（努查努阿特人的舊稱）
sentences: The museum exhibit described the Aht people. 博物館展覽介紹了阿特人。
An elder Aht told stories by the fire. 一位年長的阿特人在火邊講故事。

meaning: 阿特納人（阿拉斯加原住民族）
sentences: The Ahtena people live along the Copper River in Alaska. 阿特納人居住在阿拉斯加的銅河沿岸。
Ahtena culture is deeply connected to the natural resources of the region. 阿特納文化與該地區的自然資源有著深刻的聯繫。

meaning: 阿胡（復活節島上的石造祭壇）
sentences: An ahu is a stone platform on Easter Island that often supports Moai statues. 阿胡是復活節島上的一種石台，通常支撐著摩艾石像。
Archaeologists are working to preserve the ancient ahu sites. 考古學家正致力於保護古代阿胡遺址。

meaning: 水蟲卵（墨西哥的一種食物）
sentences: Ahuatle, often called 'Mexican caviar', consists of the eggs of water insects. Ahuatle 通常被稱為「墨西哥魚子醬」，由水生昆蟲的卵組成。
Traditional chefs in Mexico still prepare dishes with ahuatle. 墨西哥的傳統廚師仍然用水蟲卵烹製菜餚。

meaning: 墨西哥落羽杉；蒙特祖馬柏
sentences: The ahuehuete is the national tree of Mexico. 墨西哥落羽杉是墨西哥的國樹。
These ancient ahuehuete trees can live for over a thousand years. 這些古老的墨西哥落羽杉可以存活一千多年。

meaning: 收帆待泊；隨風漂流（航海術語，指收起所有帆並任由船隻漂流）
sentences: During the violent storm, the ship lay ahull to avoid damage. 在劇烈的暴風雨中，船隻採取收帆待泊的方式以避免損壞。
The captain decided to go ahull until the winds subsided. 船長決定在風勢減弱前保持隨風漂流狀態。

meaning: 發出嗡嗡聲的；處於嗡嗡聲中的
sentences: The garden was ahum with the sound of bees gathering nectar. (花園裡到處都是蜜蜂採集花蜜的嗡嗡聲。)
The entire factory was ahum with the noise of machinery. (整個工廠都迴盪著機器的嗡嗡聲。)

meaning: 飢餓的（古語或文學用語）
sentences: The weary traveler was ahungered after his long journey. (疲憊的旅行者在長途跋涉後感到十分飢餓。)
And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward ahungered. (他禁食四十晝夜，後來就餓了。)
The poor child looked pale and ahungry. (這可憐的孩子看起來臉色蒼白且飢餓。)
I am very ahungry and would like something to eat. (我非常餓，想吃點東西。)
The hounds were ahunt in the early morning fog. (獵犬在清晨的霧中進行狩獵。)
The detective was ahunt for any clue that might solve the case. (偵探正在搜尋任何可能破解案件的線索。)
Ahura Mazda is the highest deity in Zoroastrianism. (阿胡拉·馬茲達是祆教中最高的神明。)
The ancient texts describe the power of the Ahura. (古代文獻描述了阿胡拉的力量。)
The crowd fell ahush as the performer took the stage. (當表演者走上舞台時，人群安靜了下來。)
The woods were ahush in the winter night. (冬夜的森林一片寂靜。)

meaning: 情況；狀態（通常指阿拉伯語中的事務或個人狀況）
sentences: The scholar studied the ahwal of the region's inhabitants. (學者研究了該地區居民的狀況。)
He reported on the current ahwal of the local administration. (他報告了地方政府目前的狀況。)
He suffered from chronic ahypnia and could rarely sleep through the night. (他患有慢性失眠症，很少能睡個安穩覺。)
The doctor prescribed some relaxation techniques to treat her ahypnia. (醫生開了一些放鬆技巧來治療她的失眠症。)
The ai is a slow-moving mammal found in South America. (三趾樹懶是生活在南美洲的一種行動遲緩的哺乳動物。)
In the jungle, the ai blends perfectly with the tree branches. (在叢林中，三趾樹懶與樹枝完美地融合在一起。)
Aias was known for his great strength and bravery in the Trojan War. (埃阿斯以他在特洛伊戰爭中的巨大力量和勇氣而聞名。)
Sophocles wrote a famous tragedy titled after Aias. (索福克勒斯寫了一部以埃阿斯命名的著名悲劇。)

meaning: 艾亞旺（澳洲原住民部落名）
sentences: The Aiawong people have a rich cultural heritage. (艾亞旺人擁有豐富的文化遺產。)
Researchers studied the traditional language of the Aiawong. (研究人員研究了艾亞旺人的傳統語言。)
Someone with aichmophobia may feel intense anxiety around needles or knives. (患有尖銳物品恐懼症的人在針或刀具周圍可能會感到強烈的焦慮。)
Her aichmophobia made it difficult for her to undergo medical tests. (她的尖銳物品恐懼症使她難以進行醫學檢查。)
The organization provides emergency aid to victims of natural disasters. 該組織為自然災害的受害者提供緊急援助。
Foreign aid is essential for the development of poor countries. 外國援助對於開發中國家的發展至關重要。

meaning: 援助引導的 (修正為 aid-led)
sentences: The project is an aid led initiative to improve education in the region. 該專案是一個由援助引導的、旨在改善該地區教育的倡議。
An aid led recovery can sometimes lead to long-term dependency. 由援助引導的復甦有時會導致長期的依賴。
The situation was deemed aidable if the resources were allocated correctly. (如果資源分配正確，這種情況被認為是可以援助的。)
He sought out an aidable cause for his charitable donation. (他為他的慈善捐款尋找一個值得幫助的事業。)
We rely on the aidance of our neighbors in times of trouble. (在困難時期，我們依靠鄰居的幫助。)
The program provides financial aidance to small business owners. (該計劃為小企業主提供財務援助。)
The aidant staff made the transition much smoother for the new students. (樂於助人的工作人員使新生入學的過渡更加順利。)
She has an aidant nature, always looking for ways to support others. (她天生樂於助人，總是尋找支持他人的方式。)
The mayor's aide scheduled the meeting for Friday. 市長的助理把會議安排在星期五。
She worked as an aide to a senior diplomat. 她曾擔任一位資深外交官的助理。
The poet described a mystical garden as a lost Aidenn. (詩人將一座神祕的花園描述為失去的伊甸園。)
He longed for the peace of an earthly Aidenn. (他渴望人間樂園的寧靜。)
Each elderly visitor was paired with an aider at the event. 活動中，每位年長訪客都配有一位協助者。
The teacher thanked every aider for helping during the trip. 老師感謝每一位在校外教學中幫忙的協助者。

meaning: 哈帝斯（希臘神話中的冥王或冥界）
sentences: Aides is the ruler of the underworld in Greek mythology. (哈帝斯是希臘神話中冥界的統治者。)
The souls were said to travel to the realm of Aides. (據說靈魂會前往哈帝斯的領地。)
The guidebook proved to be very aidful during our trip. (這本旅遊指南在我們的旅行中證明是非常有幫助的。)
His aidful suggestions improved the quality of the project. (他那有助益的建議提高了專案的品質。)
The stranded hikers felt aidless in the middle of the wilderness. (被困的徒步旅行者在荒野中感到孤立無援。)
An aidless person may struggle to overcome significant obstacles. (無助的人可能難以克服重大障礙。)

meaning: 祖父（古法語/蘇格蘭語用法）
sentences: The old records mentioned the inheritance from his aiel. (古老的記錄提到了來自他祖父的遺產。)
He spoke fondly of the stories told by his aiel. (他深情地談起祖父講的故事。)

meaning: 海蜥（一種滅絕的海生蜥蜴）
sentences: The aigialosaur is considered an early relative of mosasaurs. (海蜥被認為是滄龍的早期親戚。)
Fossils of the aigialosaur provide clues about ancient marine life. (海蜥的化石提供了關於古代海洋生物的線索。)

meaning: 海蜥科（滅絕海生蜥蜴的一科）
sentences: Aigialosauridae includes several genera of semi-aquatic lizards. (海蜥科包括幾類半水生蜥蜴。)
The classification of Aigialosauridae has been a subject of paleontological study. (海蜥科的分類一直是古生物學研究的主題。)

meaning: 海蜥屬（海蜥科的模式屬）
sentences: Aigialosaurus was a small marine lizard from the Late Cretaceous. (海蜥屬是晚白堊世的小型海洋蜥蜴。)
The type specimen of Aigialosaurus was discovered in Europe. (海蜥屬的模式標本是在歐洲發現的。)
The aiglet at the end of the shoelace prevents it from fraying. (鞋帶末端的金屬箍可以防止其磨損。)
Renaissance costumes often featured decorative aiglets made of gold. (文藝復興時期的服裝經常帶有用金子製成的裝飾性飾針。)
Aigremore is a key component in the production of traditional gunpowder. (木炭粉是生產傳統火藥的關鍵成分。)
The artisan carefully prepared the aigremore for the fireworks. (工匠仔細準備了用於煙花的木炭粉。)
She wore a stunning aigrette in her hair for the gala. (她戴著一件精美的鑽石頭飾參加晚會。)
The soldier's hat was decorated with a white aigrette. (士兵的帽子上裝飾著白色的羽飾。)
The climbers aimed to reach the summit of the steep aiguille. (登山者目標是到達陡峭的針狀山峰頂端。)
An aiguille is used in masonry to drill holes in stone. (在石工工程中，鑽孔器用於在石頭上鑽孔。)
The mountain range featured many aiguillesque formations. (該山脈有許多針尖狀的地層。)
The architect designed an aiguillesque tower for the new skyline. (建築師為新的天際線設計了一座針尖狀的塔樓。)
The officer's dress uniform was adorned with a golden aiguillette. (軍官的禮服上裝飾著金色的飾緒。)
The chef served duck aiguillettes with a rich orange sauce. (廚師端出了配有濃郁橙汁的鴨肉條。)
The aiguilletted guards stood at attention outside the palace. (佩戴飾緒的衛兵在宮殿外立正站好。)
He felt proud wearing his aiguilletted ceremonial attire. (穿著配有飾緒的禮儀服裝讓他感到自豪。)
Aikinite is a rare sulfide mineral consisting of copper, lead, and bismuth. (針硫鉍鉛礦是一種由銅、鉛和鉍組成的稀有硫化物礦物。)
The geologist identified a sample of aikinite in the ore deposit. (地質學家在礦床中鑑定出了一個針硫鉍鉛礦樣本。)
What ails the poor man? (那可憐的人怎麼了？/哪裡不舒服？)
He has been ailing for some time now. (他已經病了一段時間了。)

meaning: （醫學用語）食物不消化而排出
sentences: Ailantery is a condition where food passes through the digestive tract undigested. (食物不消化排出是指食物未經消化就通過消化道的狀況。)
The patient was diagnosed with ailantery after several tests. (經過幾次檢查，該患者被診斷出患有食物不消化排出症。)
The researcher extracted ailanthic acid from the bark of the tree. (研究人員從樹皮中提取了臭椿酸。)
Ailanthic properties are studied for their potential medicinal use. (臭椿的特性因其潛在的藥用價值而受到研究。)
Ailanthus altissima is commonly known as the tree of heaven. (臭椿通常被稱為「天堂之樹」。)
The city planted Ailanthus trees because they can tolerate pollution. (城市種植臭椿樹，因為它們能耐受污染。)

meaning: 臭椿絲（來自臭椿蠶的絲）
sentences: Ailantine is a strong and durable silk produced by the Ailanthus silkworm. (臭椿絲是由臭椿蠶產生的一種堅韌耐用的絲。)
The fabric was woven from a blend of cotton and ailantine. (這種織物是由棉和臭椿絲混合編織而成的。)
The ailanto is known for its rapid growth in urban environments. (臭椿以其在城市環境中的快速生長而聞名。)
Leaves of the ailanto are often used in traditional remedies. (臭椿的葉子常用於傳統療法中。)
The old church had a narrow aile on the north side. (那座舊教堂的北側有一條狹窄的側廊。)
He walked down the aile to find his seat. (他走下側廊去尋找他的座位。)
Aileen is a popular name of Irish origin. (愛琳是一個源自愛爾蘭的受歡迎名字。)
Aileen decided to pursue a career in nursing. (愛琳決定從事護理事業。)
The pilot moved the control stick to adjust the ailerons during the turn. 飛行員在轉彎時移動控制桿以調整副翼。
A damaged aileron can affect the aircraft's ability to roll. 損壞的副翼會影響飛機的橫滾能力。
The knight's armor included decorative ailettes with his family crest. (騎士的鎧甲包括帶有其家族徽章的裝飾性護肩板。)
Ailettes provided some protection for the shoulders in battle. (護肩板在戰鬥中為肩膀提供了一些保護。)

meaning: 艾莉（女子名，Alice 或 Helen 的暱稱）
sentences: Ailie left her bike by the door and ran inside. 艾莉把腳踏車停在門邊就跑進屋裡。
The nurse called Ailie by her nickname at the desk. 護士在櫃台前用暱稱叫艾莉。
He spent many weeks caring for his ailing grandmother. 他花了許多週時間照顧生病的祖母。
The government is trying to rescue the country's ailing economy. 政府正試圖挽救國家境況不佳的經濟。
The castle was built upon a steep aillt. (城堡建在陡峭的懸崖上。)
He admired the view from the top of the aillt. (他欣賞從懸崖頂部看到的景色。)
He stayed home because of a minor ailment. 他因為一點小病而待在家裡。
The clinic treats common ailments such as colds and coughs. 這家診所治療感冒和咳嗽等常見小病。
Common ailments like the flu can be avoided with proper hygiene. (流感等常見疾病可以透過適當的衛生習慣來避免。)
She suffered from various minor ailments throughout the winter. (整個冬天她都飽受各種小病的困擾。)

meaning: （地質）微晶石英閃長岩的一種
sentences: Ailsyte is a rock type specifically associated with Ailsa Craig. (Ailsyte 是一種專門與艾爾莎克雷格島相關的岩石類型。)
The unique composition of ailsyte makes it very tough. (Ailsyte 的獨特成分使其非常堅硬。)
The family Ailuridae currently only contains one living species, the red panda. (小熊貓科目前只包含一個現存物種，即小熊貓。)
Taxonomists have debated the classification of Ailuridae for years. (分類學家多年來一直對小熊貓科的分類存在爭議。)
The prefix ailuro- appears in cat related compounds. 表示「貓」的這個前綴常出現在與貓有關的複合詞裡。
She recognized ailuro- in the longer word at once. 她一眼就認出那個長字裡的貓字頭前綴。
The fox had an ailuroid face and quick eyes. 那隻狐狸的臉和眼神都很像貓。
Its ailuroid movements made it seem silent and soft. 它貓似的動作讓它看起來安靜又柔軟。

meaning: 貓型亞目（食肉目的一個分支）
sentences: Ailuroidea is a large group of carnivorans that are more closely related to cats than dogs. (貓型亞目是一大群與貓的親緣關係比與狗更近的食肉動物。)
The evolution of Ailuroidea can be traced back millions of years. (貓型亞目的進化可以追溯到數百萬年前。)
Ailuropoda melanoleuca is the scientific name for the giant panda. (大熊貓的學名是大熊貓。)
The genus Ailuropoda belongs to the bear family, Ursidae. (大熊貓屬屬於熊科。)
Ailuropus appeared on the old panda chart. 舊熊貓圖表上出現了大熊貓屬的舊稱。
The museum card kept Ailuropus as the older genus name. 博物館卡片仍保留大熊貓屬的舊名。
Ailurus fulgens is the red panda, native to the Himalayas. (小熊貓是原產於喜馬拉雅山脈的小熊貓。)
The red panda is the only living member of the genus Ailurus. (小熊貓是小熊貓屬中唯一的現存成員。)
The shore was covered in ailweed after the storm. (暴風雨後岸邊覆蓋著海帶。)
Locals used to gather ailweed to use as fertilizer. (當地人過去常採集雜草用作肥料。)
The main aim of our project is to reduce plastic waste in oceans. 我們專案的主要目的是減少海洋中的塑料廢棄物。
He is a determined student who aims to become a world-class doctor. 他是一個有決心的學生，目標是成為一名世界級的醫生。

meaning: 埃馬克人（阿富汗及伊朗的游牧民族）
sentences: The Aimak are a group of nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes. (埃馬克人是一群遊牧和半遊牧部落。)
The Aimak people speak dialects of Persian. (埃馬克人說波斯語方言。)
Aimara is spoken by indigenous people in the Andes. (安第斯山脈的原住民說艾馬拉語。)
The Aimara language has been preserved for generations. (艾馬拉語已傳承了幾代人。)

meaning: 艾米（女子名，源自法語「被愛者」）
sentences: Aimee's parents chose her name because it means 'beloved'. (艾米的父母為她選了這個名字，因為它的意思是「被愛的人」。)
Aimee is known for her artistic talents. (艾米以其藝術才華而聞名。)
The marksman was a steady aimer. (那名神射手瞄準得很穩。)
As an aimer for excellence, he never settles for mediocrity. (作為一個追求卓越的人，他從不滿足於平庸。)
He led an aimful life, dedicated to social justice. (他過著有目標的生活，致力於社會正義。)
The project was an aimful attempt to reduce carbon emissions. (該專案是減少碳排放的有針對性的嘗試。)
She worked aimfully toward completing her degree. (她有目的地朝著完成學位的目標努力。)
The message was aimfully constructed to persuade the audience. (這則訊息是為了說服聽眾而精心構建的。)
Accurate aiming is essential for archery. (精確的瞄準對於射箭至關重要。)
The aiming point was a small red circle in the distance. (目標點是遠處的一個紅色小圓圈。)
After losing his job, he spent several aimless weeks wandering the city. (失業後，他在城市裡漫無目的地徘徊了幾個星期。)
The conversation was aimless and didn't lead to any conclusion. (對話漫無目的，沒有得出任何結論。)

meaning: 沒有目的、目的或方向；漫無目的地。
sentences: He wandered aimlessly through the crowd. 他漫無目的地在人群中徘徊。
The team responded aimlessly to the change. 團隊對這項變化漫無目的地做出反應。
The movie depicts the aimlessness of youth in a small town. (這部電影描繪了小鎮青年的迷茫與無目標。)
His aimlessness was a source of great concern for his parents. (他的漫無目的讓他的父母感到非常擔憂。)

meaning: 博托庫多人（巴西原住民部落，即 Botocudo）
sentences: The Aimore people were known for their resistance to colonization. (博托庫多人以抵抗殖民統治而聞名。)
Anthropologists studied the unique customs of the Aimore. (人類學家研究了博托庫多人的獨特習俗。)
The commander evaluated the aimworthiness of the enemy fortification. (指揮官評估了敵軍防禦工事是否值得攻擊。)
The value of a goal lies in its aimworthiness. (目標的價值在於它是否值得追求。)
The healer brewed tea from ainaleh leaves. 療癒者用這種植物的葉子泡茶。
A small ainaleh grew beside the stone wall. 一株這種植物長在石牆旁。

meaning: 阿洪病（一種罕見的熱帶腳趾疾病）
sentences: Ainhum leads to the spontaneous amputation of a toe. (阿洪病會導致腳趾自然脫落。)
Medical researchers are still investigating the causes of ainhum. (醫學研究人員仍在調查阿洪病的原因。)
The choir sang the ainoi during the morning service. (合唱團在早禱儀式中演唱讚美詩。)
The ainoi are traditionally based on the last three psalms. (讚美詩傳統上是以最後三篇詩篇為基礎的。)
I saw it with my ainsell. (我親眼所見。)
He did the work all by his ainsell. (這工作全是他自己做的。)

meaning: 不是（非正式用語，即 am not, is not, are not 等）
sentences: I ain't going to the party tonight. (我今晚不去參加派對。)
It ain't over until it's over. (不到最後一刻不算結束。)
The Ainu are indigenous people of northern Japan and Russia. (阿伊努人是日本北部和俄羅斯的土著民族。)
The Ainu language is considered a language isolate. (阿伊努語被認為是一種孤立語言。)
It seemed like an aion since they last met. (自從他們上次見面以來，彷彿過了一個世紀。)
The universe has existed for many aions. (宇宙已經存在了許多個永世。)
The poet wrote about aionial truths. (詩人描寫了永恆的真理。)
She believed in the aionial nature of the soul. (她相信靈魂永恆的本質。)
The air in the mountains is very fresh and clean. 山上的空氣非常清新乾淨。
We need to open the window to let some fresh air in. 我們需要開窗讓新鮮空氣進來。
The car's air bag deployed instantly during the collision. 汽車的安全氣囊在碰撞中瞬間彈出。
Modern vehicles are equipped with multiple air bags for passenger safety. 現代車輛配備了多個安全氣囊以保障乘客安全。
Trucks and trains often use an air brake system for stopping. 卡車和火車通常使用氣壓煞車系統來停止。
The driver heard the hiss of the air brake as the bus stopped. 公車停止時，司機聽到了氣壓煞車的嘶嘶聲。
We decided to install a new air conditioner in the bedroom. 我們決定在臥室安裝一台新的冷氣機。
The air conditioner was working hard to keep the room cool during the heatwave. 在熱浪期間，空調正賣力地運作以保持房間涼爽。
The hotel features central air conditioning in all its rooms. 這家飯店的所有客房都設有中央空調系統。
I prefer natural ventilation to air conditioning when the weather is pleasant. 當天氣宜人時，我更喜歡自然通風而不是空調。
The air hostess welcomed the passengers aboard the plane. 空中小姐歡迎乘客們登機。
She has been working as an air hostess for an international airline for five years. 她已經在一家國際航空公司擔任空中小姐五年了。
We met our friends at the arrivals hall of the air terminal. 我們在航站大廈的入境大廳與朋友們見面。
The new air terminal is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities. 新航站大廈配備了最先進的設施。
The pilot remained in constant communication with air traffic control. 飛行員與空中交通管制保持持續聯繫。
Air traffic control is responsible for managing the flow of aircraft in the sky. 空中交通管制負責管理空中飛機的流量。
Being an air traffic controller is a highly stressful and demanding job. 擔任空中交通管制員是一項壓力很大且要求很高的工作。
The air traffic controller guided the plane safely to the runway. 空中交通管制員引導飛機安全降落到跑道上。
We stayed in an air-conditioned room during the summer. 夏天時我們住在有空調的房間裡。
The bus is air-conditioned, so the ride is comfortable. 這輛公車有空調，所以搭起來很舒服。
Aira grows thin and airy on the hillside. 髮草屬植物在山坡上長得細長而輕盈。
The botanist collected Aira seeds after the rain. 植物學家在雨後收集了髮草屬的種子。
Make sure the room is airable to prevent mold. (確保房間通風以防止發霉。)
The wet laundry needs to be placed in an airable spot. (濕衣服需要放在通風的地方。)
Airampo is used locally for its medicinal and coloring properties. (Airampo 因其藥用和著色特性而在當地使用。)
The fruit of the airampo can be made into a refreshing drink. (Airampo 的果實可以製成清爽的飲料。)

meaning: 愛蘭（一種中東酸奶飲品）
sentences: Airan is a salty yogurt-based beverage popular in Turkey. (愛蘭是一種在土耳其流行的鹹酸奶飲品。)
Drinking airan is a great way to cool down in the summer heat. (在夏日炎炎中喝杯愛蘭是消暑的好方法。)

meaning: 在空中的；（水管等）因氣泡堵塞的
sentences: The airbound spores were carried miles by the wind. (空中的孢子被風吹到了數英里外。)
The radiator is airbound and needs to be bled. (暖氣片因氣泡堵塞，需要排氣。)
That was an airbrained scheme that was doomed to fail. (那是一個注定會失敗的愚蠢計劃。)
Stop being so airbrained and start thinking seriously. (別再那麼輕率了，開始認真思考。)
The artist used an airbrush to create a smooth gradient. (藝術家使用噴筆來創造平滑的漸變效果。)
The photo was airbrushed to remove imperfections. (這張照片經過噴筆修飾以去除瑕疵。)
The modern aircraft is equipped with advanced navigation systems. 現代飛機配備了先進的導航系統。
The airline operates a large fleet of commercial aircraft. 該航空公司經營著一支龐大的商業飛機機隊。
He enlisted in the Royal Air Force as an aircraftman. (他作為一名空軍士兵加入了英國皇家空軍。)
The aircraftman was responsible for basic maintenance on the runway. (這名空軍士兵負責跑道上的基礎維護。)
An aircraftsman works on various technical tasks within the air force. (空軍士兵在空軍內從事各種技術工作。)
He was promoted from leading aircraftsman to corporal. (他從一等兵晉升為下士。)
She served with distinction as an aircraftswoman during the conflict. (在衝突期間，她作為一名女性空軍士兵表現出色。)
The aircraftswoman specialized in radar operations. (這名女性空軍士兵專門從事雷達操作。)

meaning: 女性空軍士兵（aircraftswoman 的變體）
sentences: A young aircraftwoman was assigned to the logistics department. (一名年輕的女性空軍士兵被分配到後勤部門。)
She was proud to be the first aircraftwoman in her family. (她為自己是家族中第一位女性空軍士兵感到自豪。)
The aircrew prepared the plane for takeoff. (機組人員為飛機起飛做了準備。)
Regular training is mandatory for all aircrew members. (所有機組人員都必須定期接受培訓。)
The aircrewman monitored the cargo during the flight. (機組成員在飛行過程中監測貨物。)
As an aircrewman, he had to be ready for emergency situations. (作為一名機組成員，他必須為緊急情況做好準備。)
The massive airdock was built to house the world's largest airships. (這座巨大的飛艇庫是為了容納世界上最大的飛艇而建造的。)
Engineers inspected the structural integrity of the airdock. (工程師檢查了飛艇庫的結構完整性。)
The small plane landed at the airdrome before sunset. 那架小飛機在日落前降落在小型機場。
Workers arrived at the airdrome early in the morning. 工作人員一大早就到了小型機場。
The airdrop provided much-needed supplies to the flood victims. (空投為洪水災民提供了急需的物資。)
Supplies were airdropped into the remote village. (物資被空投到那個偏遠的村莊。)

meaning: 通風處，空間 (修正為 airing / area)
sentences: Please put the wet clothes in a sunny aire to dry. 請將濕衣服放在陽光充足的通風處晾乾。
The play area provides a safe aire for children to enjoy themselves. 遊戲區為孩子們提供了一個可以盡情玩耍的安全空間。

meaning: 艾爾谷（英格蘭約克郡的一處山谷）
sentences: The River Aire flows through the beautiful Airedale. (艾爾河流經美麗的艾爾谷。)
Airedale is famous for its scenic landscapes and historical mills. (艾爾谷以其風景優美的景觀和歷史悠久的工廠而聞名。)

meaning: 艾爾谷梗（一種大型梗犬）
sentences: The airedale terrier is often called the 'King of Terriers'. (艾爾谷梗常被稱為「梗犬之王」。)
An airedale is a smart and energetic companion. (艾爾谷梗是一個聰明且精力充沛的伴侶。)
She put the wet clothes on the airer by the window. (她把濕衣服放在窗邊的晾衣架上。)
A heated airer can dry clothes much faster in the winter. (加熱晾衣架在冬天可以更快地晾乾衣服。)
The helicopter landed safely at the airfield. 直升機安全降落在飛機場。
Security was increased around the airfield after the storm. 暴風雨過後，飛機場周圍加強了警戒。
The shape of the airfoil determines the lift generated by the wing. (翼型的形狀決定了機翼產生的升力。)
Engineers use computer models to design more efficient airfoils. (工程師使用電腦模型來設計更高效的翼型。)

meaning: 飛機的主體和結構（不包括動力裝置）。
sentences: This airframe has 2600 flight hours on it; the powerplant has just over 800. 機身有2600個飛行小時；動力裝置只有800多台。
The term airframe refers to The main body and structure of an aircraft (without the powerplant). 機身一詞是指飛機的主體和結構（不包括動力裝置）。
The urgent medical supplies were sent by airfreight. (緊急醫療物資是透過空運發送的。)
We decided to airfreight the equipment to save time. (我們決定空運這台設備以節省時間。)
The massive airfreighter can carry dozens of vehicles. (這架巨大的貨運飛機可以運載數十輛車。)
Logistics companies rely on airfreighters for global deliveries. (物流公司依靠貨運飛機進行全球遞送。)

meaning: （罕用）航空製圖；空中影像技術
sentences: Advances in airgraphics have improved the accuracy of aerial surveys. (航空製圖技術的進步提高了航空測量的準確性。)
The company specializes in high-resolution airgraphics for urban planning. (該公司專門從事用於城市規劃的高解析度航空影像技術。)

meaning: 空頭；（軍事）空橋頭堡；傻瓜
sentences: The paratroopers established an airhead behind enemy lines. (傘兵在敵後建立了空橋頭堡。)
Don't be such an airhead; listen to what I'm saying. (別像個傻瓜一樣，聽我說。)
The lungs are composed of airiferous tissue. (肺部由輸氣組織組成。)
Airiferous channels allow for gas exchange in the plant. (輸氣管道允許植物進行氣體交換。)

meaning: 充氣的；空靈的；輕飄飄的
sentences: The dessert had a light, airified texture. (這道甜點口感輕盈，充滿空氣感。)
Her music has an airified quality that is very relaxing. (她的音樂有一種空靈的特質，非常令人放鬆。)

meaning: 輕快地；空靈地；漫不經心地
sentences: She waved her hand airily and said it didn't matter. (她漫不經心地揮揮手說沒關係。)
The curtains fluttered airily in the breeze. (窗簾在微風中輕快地飄動。)

meaning: 通風感、輕盈感。可形容空間、布料或整體氛圍。
sentences: The apartment's large windows give it a sense of airiness. 公寓的大窗戶讓整體空間有種通透輕盈感。
This fabric is popular in summer because of its airiness. 這種布料因為輕薄透氣而很受夏季歡迎。
He opened the window for a quick airing after dinner. 晚餐後，他打開窗戶快速通風。
The interview got a full airing on the evening news. 那段訪問在晚間新聞裡被公開播出。
It's a bit airish today, so you might need a sweater. (今天有點涼，所以你可能需要一件毛衣。)
The garden was airish and pleasant in the evening. (傍晚的花園涼爽宜人。)
The small meeting room felt airless after an hour. 那間小會議室過了一小時後變得十分悶。
Open a window because the kitchen is getting airless. 把窗戶打開，因為廚房越來越不通風了。
The government organized an airlift to deliver supplies to the disaster zone. 政府組織了一次空運，向災區運送物資。
The injured hikers were airlifted to the nearest hospital. 受傷的登山客被空運至最近的醫院。
The fabric was so thin and airlike that she barely felt it. (這織物又薄又輕，像空氣一樣，她幾乎感覺不到它。)
The ghost appeared as an airlike figure in the hallway. (幽靈以像空氣一樣的形象出現在走廊上。)
Which airline are you flying with for your trip to London? 妳去倫敦的旅行是搭哪家航空公司的？
The airline industry has faced many challenges in recent years. 航空業近年來面臨了許多挑戰。
The massive airliner took off smoothly from the international airport. 那架巨大的客機從國際機場順利起飛。
Modern airliners are designed to be more fuel-efficient and quieter. 現代客機的設計更加節能且安靜。
I sent the letter to my relatives in Australia via airmail. 我寄航空郵件給我在澳洲的親戚。
It's faster to airmail the package than to send it by sea. 用航空郵寄包裹比海運快。
The airman completed his training with high marks. (這名飛行員以高分完成了訓練。)
Every airman is expected to uphold the values of the force. (每一位空軍士兵都被期望維護空軍的價值觀。)
Excellent airmanship saved the plane from crashing. (卓越的飛行技術使飛機免於墜毀。)
The pilot demonstrated his airmanship during the difficult landing. (飛行員在艱難的降落過程中展示了他的飛行技術。)
The large numbers on the roof serve as an airmark for pilots. (屋頂上的大數字作為飛行員的空中標誌。)
The route was airmarked to assist navigators. (該航線設有空中標誌以協助領航員。)
The water tower was painted bright yellow to act as an airmarker. (水塔被塗成亮黃色以作為空中標誌物。)
Airmarkers are essential for visual navigation in rural areas. (空中標誌物對於鄉村地區的目視導航至關重要。)

meaning: （貶義）空想家；虛幻事物的販賣者
sentences: He was dismissed as an airmonger with no practical solutions. (他被視為一個沒有實際解決方案的空想家。)
The politician was accused of being a mere airmonger of false hopes. (這位政治家被指控只是個販賣虛假希望的空想家。)

meaning: 氫氧混合氣體（用於焊接等）
sentences: Airohydrogen torches are used for high-temperature applications. (氫氧火炬用於高溫應用。)
The technician carefully managed the flow of airohydrogen. (技術員小心地管理氫氧混合氣體的流量。)

meaning: 氣量計（用於測量空氣量）
sentences: The airometer measures the volume of air passing through the pipe. (氣量計測量流經管道的空氣體積。)
The scientist recorded the data from the airometer during the experiment. (科學家在實驗過程中記錄了來自氣量計的數據。)

meaning: 航空公園；供小型飛機使用的社區
sentences: He lives in an airpark where residents can park planes in their backyards. (他住在一個航空公園社區，那裡的居民可以把飛機停在自家的後院。)
The local airpark hosts an annual air show for the community. (當地的航空公園每年為社區舉辦一次航空展。)
Her airphobia prevents her from traveling abroad. (她的飛行恐懼症使她無法出國旅行。)
He sought therapy to overcome his intense airphobia. (他尋求心理治療以克服強烈的飛行恐懼症。)
The child watched the airplane flying high across the sky. 孩子看著飛機在高空中飛過。
Traveling by airplane is the fastest way to cover long distances. 搭乘飛機是長距離旅行最快的方式。
The airplane took off on time despite the heavy rain. 儘管下大雨，飛機仍準時起飛。
It takes about three hours to travel there by plane. 搭飛機去那裡大約需要三個小時。
In the early days of aviation, he was a famous airplanist. (在航空業的早期，他是一位著名的飛行員。)
The airplanist worked tirelessly on a new wing design. (這位飛機設計者孜孜不倦地研發新的機翼設計。)
My father is waiting for me at the airport arrivals hall. 我父親正在機場抵達大廳等我。
The airport was crowded with travelers during the holidays. 假期期間機場擠滿了旅客。
The container must be airproof to keep the coffee fresh. (容器必須是不透氣的以保持咖啡新鮮。)
They used special sealant to airproof the laboratory. (他們使用特殊的密封劑使實驗室不透氣。)
The airscape showed the vastness of the sprawling city. (鳥瞰圖顯示了這座擴展城市的廣闊。)
I was mesmerized by the beautiful airscape from the plane window. (我被飛機窗外美麗的空中風景迷住了。)
The mechanic inspected the blades of the airscrew. (技工檢查了螺旋槳的葉片。)
The spinning airscrew created a powerful thrust. (旋轉的螺旋槳產生了強大的推力。)
The airship floated gracefully above the stadium. (飛艇優雅地漂浮在體育場上空。)
Zeppelins are a well-known type of rigid airship. (齊柏林飛艇是一種著名的硬式飛艇。)
She felt airsick during the turbulent flight. (在顛簸的飛行中，她感到暈機。)
If you feel airsick, try looking at the horizon. (如果你感到暈機，試著望向地平線。)
Airsickness can be a major problem for new travelers. (對於新遊客來說，暈機可能是一個大問題。)
The cabin crew provided bags for those suffering from airsickness. (機組人員為暈機的人提供了袋子。)
The pilot used a narrow airstrip on the island. 飛行員使用島上一條狹窄的簡易跑道。
After the rain, the dirt airstrip became muddy. 下雨後，那條土質簡易跑道變得泥濘。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語/愛爾蘭語）方向；方位
sentences: From which airt does the wind blow? (風從哪個方向吹來？)
He airted the cattle toward the valley. (他引導牛群走向山谷。)
Please keep the fresh coffee beans in an airtight container to stay fresh. 請將新鮮咖啡豆保存在密封容器中以保持新鮮。
The lawyer presented an airtight case, and the jury reached a verdict quickly. 律師提出了一個無懈可擊的案例，陪審團很快做出了裁決。
The jars were sealed airtightly to preserve the food. (這些罐子被密封得不透氣以保存食物。)
The argument was airtightly constructed, leaving no room for doubt. (這個論點建構得非常嚴密，沒有留下懷疑的餘地。)
Testing the airtightness of the building is part of the energy audit. (測試建築物的不透氣性是能源審核的一部分。)
The airtightness of the package ensures the product's safety. (包裝的嚴密性確保了產品的安全。)
The bird took an airward flight toward the clouds. (鳥兒向空中飛向雲端。)
He looked airward, watching the kites dance. (他向空中望去，看著風箏飛舞。)
The smoke spiraled airwards from the chimney. (煙從煙囪裡向空中盤旋升起。)
He tossed the ball airwards and caught it easily. (他把球拋向空中並輕鬆接住。)
The doctor cleared the patient's airway to ensure that he could breathe. 醫生清理了病人的氣道以確保其呼吸順暢。
The busy airway connects several major cities in the northern region. 這條繁忙的航線連接了北部地區的幾個主要城市。
The fictional story featured an airwayman who hijacked flying machines. (這部虛構故事描述了一名劫持飛行器的空中強盜。)
Security measures were increased to prevent any threat from an airwayman. (增加了安全措施以防止來自空中強盜的任何威脅。)

meaning: 女性飛行員；女性空軍士兵
sentences: She was a pioneering airwoman who broke many records. (她是一位打破了許多紀錄的先驅女性飛行員。)
The airwoman received a medal for her bravery during the mission. (這名女性空軍士兵因其在任務中的英勇表現而獲得獎章。)
The aircraft's airworthiness was certified by the authorities. (該飛機的適航性已獲得當局認證。)
Maintenance is crucial for maintaining the airworthiness of the fleet. (維護對於保持機隊的適航性至關重要。)
The old plane is no longer considered airworthy. (這架舊飛機已不再被認為具備適航性。)
Engineers worked through the night to make the aircraft airworthy. (工程師徹夜工作以使飛機達到適航狀態。)
The living room is very bright and airy with large windows. 客廳非常明亮通風，窗戶很大。
She had a light and airy step as she danced across the floor. 她在大廳跳舞時腳步輕盈（輕快）。
The cult's practices were described as a form of aischrolatreia. (該教派的實踐被描述為一種淫穢崇拜。)
Scholars discussed the historical context of aischrolatreia in ancient texts. (學者們討論了古代文獻中淫穢崇拜的歷史背景。)

meaning: 走道，空間 (修正為 aisle / area)
sentences: The flight attendant walked down the aise to check on the passengers. 空服員走過走道以查看乘客狀況。
Please keep the aise clear of any luggage for safety reasons. 為了安全起見，請勿在走道上放置任何行李。

meaning: 走道空間 (修正為 aisle space)
sentences: The new design of the theater provides more aise family for the audience. 戲院的新設計為觀眾提供了更多的走道空間。
They decided to increase the aise family to improve the flow of people. 他們決定增加走道空間以改善人流。
Aiseweed grew by the ditch behind the house. 屋後水溝旁長著一種方言植物。
The herbal basket held a few stems of aiseweed. 草藥籃裡放著幾根這種植物的枝條。
Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat for your flight to Tokyo? 您的航班是想要靠窗座位還是靠走道的座位？
The bride looked beautiful as she walked down the aisle with her father. 新娘和父親一起走下走道時看起來很漂亮。
The cathedral is a magnificent aisled building. (這座大教堂是一座壯麗的有側廊建築。)
They walked through the aisled theater to find their seats. (他們穿過有通道的劇院去尋找座位。)
The small village chapel was simple and aisleless. (這座小村莊禮拜堂結構簡單，沒有側廊。)
An aisleless design can maximize the available space in a small hall. (無通道的設計可以最大化小廳堂的可用空間。)

meaning: 幻象；夢境詩（愛爾蘭文學體裁）
sentences: The poet composed an aisling about the future of his country. (詩人創作了一首關於祖國未來的夢境詩。)
In an aisling, the poet often meets a beautiful woman who represents Ireland. (在夢境詩中，詩人常會遇到一位代表愛爾蘭的美女。)

meaning: 阿伊薩瓦教團（摩洛哥的一個宗教兄弟會）
sentences: The Aissaoua led a loud procession through the town. 阿伊薩瓦教團帶著喧鬧的隊伍穿過城鎮。
He studied the Aissaoua tradition in Morocco. 他研究了摩洛哥的阿伊薩瓦傳統。

meaning: 亞述人（現代亞述人的一種稱呼）
sentences: The Aissor community has preserved its language and traditions. (亞述人社群保留了其語言和傳統。)
Historians traced the lineage of the Aissor people. (歷史學家追溯了亞述人的血統。)
The aisteoir delivered a powerful performance on stage. (這名演員在舞台上帶來了震撼的表演。)
He wanted to become a famous aisteoir since he was a child. (他從小就想成為一名著名的演員。)

meaning: 缺肢目（滅絕的一類兩棲動物）
sentences: Aistopoda were eel-like amphibians from the Carboniferous period. (缺肢目是來自石炭紀的類鰻魚兩棲動物。)
The lack of limbs is a defining characteristic of Aistopoda. (缺乏四肢是缺肢目的一個定義性特徵。)

meaning: 缺肢目動物（Aistopoda 的複數或指其成員）
sentences: Aistopodes had elongated bodies and very small or no limbs. (缺肢目動物身體細長，四肢極小或完全沒有。)
Fossils of Aistopodes have been found in coal deposits. (缺肢目動物的化石已在煤層中被發現。)
The mountain ait is fresh and cool even in the summer. 山上的空氣即使在夏天也非常清新涼爽。
Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the ait to produce oxygen. 植物從空氣中吸收二氧化碳以產生氧氣。

meaning: 空氣質量 (修正為 air quality)
sentences: The government is taking steps to improve the ait equal in the city. 政府正採取措施改善城市裡的空氣質量。
Monitoring the ait equal is essential for public health. 監測空氣質量對於公共衛生至關重要。
She pronounced H as aitch. 她念出了字母 H 的名稱。
The child practiced saying aitch. 孩子練習字母 H 的發音。
The butcher prepared a roast from the aitchbone. (屠夫用臀尖肉準備了一份烤肉。)
The aitchbone is located near the rump of the animal. (臀骨位於動物的臀部附近。)

meaning: 不發 H 音的；省略 H 的
sentences: His aitchless speech was characteristic of his regional dialect. (他那不發 H 音的說話方式是他地方方言的特徵。)
Some words are consistently aitchless in certain accents. (某些單字在特定口音中始終是不發 H 音的。)
They served an aitchpiece for the Sunday dinner. (他們在週日晚餐時供應了臀骨肉。)
The aitchpiece is known for being a flavorful cut of meat. (臀骨肉以其肉質鮮美而聞名。)
The ritual ended with a formal aitesis for peace. (儀式以正式祈求和平結束。)
In the ancient texts, the aitesis was directed toward the gods. (在古代文獻中，請求是直接面向神明的。)
The term aithochroi was used in old anthropological classifications. (aithochroi 一詞曾用於舊的人類學分類中。)
He studied the geographical distribution of the aithochroi. (他研究了棕紅色皮膚人種的地理分佈。)
The philosopher sought the ultimate aition of the universe. (哲學家尋求宇宙的最終原因。)
The myth provides an aition for the origin of the festival. (神話為這個節日的起源提供了一個緣由。)
The organism's aitiotropic response was triggered by environmental changes. (生物的趨因性反應是由環境變化觸發的。)
Researchers studied the aitiotropic behavior of the bacteria. (研究人員研究了細菌的趨因行為。)
Aitkenite is a rare mineral found in specific geological formations. (Aitkenite 是一種在特定地質構造中發現的稀有礦物。)
The sample of Aitkenite was carefully preserved in the museum. (Aitkenite 的樣本被小心地保存在博物館中。)

meaning: 艾圖塔基島的；艾圖塔基島人
sentences: The Aitutakian culture is known for its traditional dances. (艾圖塔基文化以其傳統舞蹈而聞名。)
She met an Aitutakian traveler during her trip to the Cook Islands. (她在前往庫克群島的旅行中遇到了一位艾圖塔基旅行者。)
The aiwan was decorated with intricate tile work. (接待廳裝飾著精美的瓷磚。)
They rested in the shade of the aiwan. (他們在拱廊的陰影下休息。)
The earth rotates on its aix once every twenty-four hours. 地球每二十四小時繞其軸旋轉一次。
The graph shows the relationship between time and distance on the x-aix. 圖表顯示了 X 軸上時間與距離之間的關係。
An aizle from the fireplace landed on the rug. (壁爐裡的一個火星落在了地毯上。)
The fire burned down until only a few aizles remained. (火燒完了，只剩下幾點餘燼。)
Aizoaceae is a large family of succulent plants. (番杏科是多肉植物的一個大科。)
Most species of Aizoaceae are native to southern Africa. (番杏科的大多數物種原產於南部非洲。)
Ice plants are common examples of aizoaceous vegetation. (冰草是番杏科植物的常見例子。)
The desert landscape was dotted with aizoaceous succulents. (沙漠景觀中點綴著番杏科的多肉植物。)
Aizoon is a genus in the family Aizoaceae. (番杏屬是番杏科中的一個屬。)
The leaves of some Aizoon species are edible. (某些番杏屬物種的葉子是可以食用的。)

meaning: 粉紅琵鷺屬（舊稱，即 Platalea）
sentences: The guide listed the bird as Ajaja in the old field notes. 導覽員在舊的觀察筆記裡把那隻鳥記作粉紅琵鷺的舊稱。
An Ajaja stood near the marsh at sunrise. 日出時，一隻粉紅琵鷺站在沼澤邊。
The ajaja is known for its beautiful pink plumage and spoon-shaped bill. (粉紅琵鷺以其美麗的粉紅色羽毛和匙狀嘴而聞名。)
We spotted an ajaja foraging in the shallow waters of the marsh. (我們在沼澤的淺水區發現了一隻正在覓食的粉紅琵鷺。)

meaning: 發出叮噹聲的；格格不入的
sentences: The keys in his pocket were ajangle as he walked. (當他走路時，口袋裡的鑰匙叮噹作響。)
Her nerves were ajangle after the stressful day. (在緊張的一天之後，她的神經崩得很緊。)

The mineral collector was excited to find a piece of akrochordite. (礦物收藏家很高興能找到一塊球砷錳礦。)
The temple was adorned with beautiful marble akroterions. (這座神廟裝飾著美麗的大理石頂飾。)
An akroterion is placed at the apex or corners of a pediment. (頂飾被放置在山牆的頂點或角落。)

meaning: 非受造教派（基督教的一支，主張基督身體是非受造的）
sentences: The Aktistetae emerged during the Christological controversies of the 6th century. (非受造教派出現在 6 世紀的基督論爭議中。)
Their theological views were eventually condemned as heretical. (他們的神學觀點最終被譴責為異端。)
The Aktistete argued for the incorruptibility of the physical body of Christ. (非受造教派成員主張基督肉身的不朽性。)
He was a leading Aktistete philosopher in his time. (他是當時一位領先的非受造教派哲學家。)

meaning: 行動主義（德語，尤指一戰後的一種文學/政治傾向）
sentences: His Aktivismus showed in every protest march. 他的行動主義表現在每場抗議遊行裡。
The pamphlet praised Aktivismus after the war. 那本小冊子在戰後讚揚了行動主義。
The Aktivist worked tirelessly to organize the community protest. (這位積極分子孜孜不倦地組織社區抗議。)
She became a political Aktivist during her university years. (她在大學期間成為了一名政治積極分子。)
Aku is a staple fish in Hawaiian cuisine, often eaten as poke. (鰹魚是夏威夷料理中的主食魚類，常用於製作 poke。)
The fishermen brought in a large catch of aku this morning. (漁民們今天早上捕獲了大量的鰹魚。)

meaning: 阿庫阿明（提取自非洲植物的一種生物鹼）
sentences: Akuammine is studied for its potential analgesic properties. (阿庫阿明因其潛在的鎮痛特性而受到研究。)
The seeds of the Akuamma tree are a natural source of akuammine. (阿庫阿瑪樹的種子是阿庫阿明的天然來源。)
Akule is another popular edible fish found in Hawaiian waters. (大眼鰺是夏威夷海域另一種受歡迎的可食用魚類。)
The school of akule glimmered in the clear blue sea. (大眼鰺魚群在清澈蔚藍的海水中閃閃發光。)
Akund fibers are used to fill pillows and mattresses. (Akund 纖維被用來填充枕頭和床墊。)
The soft, silky texture of akund makes it a good insulator. (Akund 柔軟柔滑的質地使其成為良好的絕緣體。)

meaning: 阿克瓦皮姆（加納的一處地區或民族名）
sentences: The Akwapim region is known for its cool climate and lush hills. (阿克瓦皮姆地區以其涼爽的氣候和翠綠的山丘而聞名。)
Traditional festivals in Akwapim attract many visitors each year. (阿克瓦皮姆的傳統節日每年吸引許多遊客。)
Al is the symbol for aluminum on the periodic table. (Al 是元素週期表中鋁的符號。)
The chemical properties of Al make it very useful in aerospace. (鋁的化學特性使其在航太工業中非常有用。)
The prefix al in Arabic often corresponds to the English word the. 阿拉伯語中的這個字首通常相當於英文的定冠詞 the。
Many Arabic names begin with the article al. 許多阿拉伯名字都以這個定冠詞開頭。
In this glossary, ala is defined as inpatient treatment. 在這份詞彙表裡，這個詞被解釋為住院治療。
The note explains ala as a form of hospital care. 這則註解把這個詞說明為一種住院治療方式。
Alabama is known as the 'Yellowhammer State'. (阿拉巴馬州被稱為「金翼啄木鳥之州」。)
Montgomery is the capital city of Alabama. (蒙哥馬利是阿拉巴馬州的首府。)

meaning: 阿拉巴馬州人的；阿拉巴馬州人
sentences: The Alabaman delegation attended the national convention. (阿拉巴馬州代表團出席了全國代表大會。)
As an Alabaman, he was proud of his Southern heritage. (作為一名阿拉巴馬州人，他為自己的南方傳統感到自豪。)

meaning: 阿拉巴馬州人的；阿拉巴馬州人（Alabaman 的變體）
sentences: She interviewed a local Alabamian about the upcoming elections. (她採訪了一位當地的阿拉巴馬州人，詢問有關即將舉行的選舉。)
The Alabamian climate is characterized by hot summers and mild winters. (阿拉巴馬州的氣候特點是夏季炎熱，冬季溫和。)

meaning: （化學）硒化錳（一種假想的化合物名，舊稱）
sentences: The mineral note listed alabamide as a rare sample. 礦物筆記把硒化錳列為稀有樣本。
The lab only had a trace of alabamide. 實驗室裡只有一點點硒化錳。

meaning: （化學）砹（元素 85 的舊稱，現稱 Astatine）
sentences: Alabamine was the name once proposed for the element now known as astatine. (Alabamine 曾是為現在被稱為砹的元素提議的名字。)
The discovery of alabamine was eventually disproven in its original form. (Alabamine 的最初發現形式最終被證明是不正確的。)
Alabandite is a manganese sulfide mineral. (硫錳礦是一種硫化錳礦物。)
The dark, metallic luster of alabandite makes it easily recognizable. (硫錳礦黑暗的金屬光澤使其易於辨認。)
The alabarch was a high-ranking official in the Jewish community of Alexandria. (猶太稅務官是亞歷山大港猶太社區的高級官員。)
Historians study the role of the alabarch in Roman Egypt. (歷史學家研究羅馬埃及時期猶太稅務官的作用。)
The statue was carved from a single block of translucent alabaster. (這座雕像是由一整塊半透明的雪花石膏雕刻而成的。)
Her skin was as smooth and white as alabaster. (她的皮膚像雪花石膏一樣光滑雪白。)
The ancient Greeks used the alabastos to hold precious oils and perfumes. (古希臘人使用雪花石膏瓶來盛放珍貴的油和香水。)
An exquisite alabastos was found in the royal tomb. (在皇家墓穴中發現了一個精美的雪花石膏瓶。)

meaning: 雪花石膏製的；似雪花石膏的
sentences: The hall was decorated with alabastrian columns. (大廳裝飾著雪花石膏柱子。)
He admired the alabastrian beauty of the ancient carvings. (他讚美古代雕刻那如雪花石膏般的美麗。)
The moonlight gave the ruins an alabastrine glow. (月光給廢墟塗上了一層雪花石膏般的光澤。)
She has an alabastrine complexion that is very striking. (她那雪白的膚色非常引人注目。)

meaning: 雪花石膏的一種（古代用語）
sentences: Alabastrites was highly valued in antiquity for decorative arts. (雪花石膏在古代因其裝飾藝術價值而受到高度重視。)
The museum displayed various objects made of alabastrites. (博物館展出了各種由雪花石膏製成的物品。)

meaning: 雪花石膏小瓶（古希臘盛香油用）
sentences: The archaeologist carefully cleaned the fragile alabastron. (考古學家仔細清理了脆弱的雪花石膏小瓶。)
The alabastron was often decorated with painted scenes. (雪花石膏小瓶通常裝飾有繪畫場景。)
Each alabastrum in the collection was a unique work of art. (收藏中的每個雪花石膏瓶都是一件獨特的藝術品。)
They stored the sacred ointment in an alabastrum. (他們將神聖的軟膏存放在雪花石膏瓶中。)
Alacha draped softly across the table. 這種絲織品或棉織品柔軟地垂在桌上。
The merchant sold alacha by the yard. 商人按碼出售這種布料。

meaning: 嗚呼；哎呀（表示遺憾、悲傷的感嘆詞）
sentences: Alack! The news is worse than we expected. (哎呀！消息比我們預期的還要糟。)
Alack, I fear we have arrived too late. (嗚呼，我擔心我們來得太晚了。)

meaning: 嗚呼；哎呀（表示悲哀的感嘆詞，即 alack the day）
sentences: Alackaday! What a terrible misfortune has befallen us. (嗚呼！多麼可怕的不幸降臨到我們身上。)
He cried 'Alackaday!' when he heard the tragic story. (當他聽到這個悲慘的故事時，他大喊「嗚呼！」。)
Alacreatine is a chemical analog of creatine. (丙氨基肌酸是肌酸的一種化學類似物。)
The physiological effects of alacreatine were tested in the laboratory. (實驗室測試了丙氨基肌酸的生理效應。)
Alacreatinine is formed from the dehydration of alacreatine. (丙氨基肌酸酐是由丙氨基肌酸脫水形成的。)
Scientists analyzed the metabolic pathways of alacreatinine. (科學家分析了丙氨基肌酸酐的代謝途徑。)
The upbeat music helped to alacrify the tired workers. (輕快的音樂有助於使疲倦的工人們振作起來。)
The coach's speech was intended to alacrify the team before the game. (教練的演講旨在賽前使球隊活躍起來。)
The waiter provided alacritous service despite the busy crowd. (儘管人群擁擠，服務生仍提供了敏捷周到的服務。)
She responded with an alacritous 'yes' when asked to join the project. (當被邀請加入該專案時，她欣然答應。)
She accepted the invitation with alacrity. 她欣然接受了邀請。
The team responded with alacrity when help was needed. 需要幫忙時，團隊立刻爽快地做出回應。
The genus Alactaga includes several species of jumping rodents. (五趾跳鼠屬包括幾種跳躍齧齒動物。)
Alactaga is native to the steppes and deserts of Asia. (五趾跳鼠屬原產於亞洲的草原和沙漠。)
He carried an alada from room to room. 他把一件阿拉達從房間搬到房間。
The alada was small but sturdy. 那件阿拉達雖小，卻很結實。

meaning: 阿拉丁（《天方夜譚》中的英雄）
sentences: Aladdin discovered a magical lamp with a genie inside. (阿拉丁發現了一盞裡面住著精靈的神奇油燈。)
The story of Aladdin is one of the most famous Middle Eastern folk tales. (阿拉丁的故事是最著名的中東民間故事之一。)

meaning: 使像阿拉丁（指突然變得富有或有權勢）
sentences: The sudden win at the lottery seemed to Aladdinize his life overnight. (彩票的中獎似乎在一夜之間讓他的人生變得像阿拉丁一樣富有。)
He was accused of trying to Aladdinize his reputation through false claims. (他被指控試圖透過虛假聲稱來神化自己的名聲。)

meaning: 漸台二（琴座中的一顆恆星）
sentences: Aladfar is a binary star system located in the constellation Lyra. (漸台二是一個位於天琴座的聯星系統。)
Astronomers studied the spectral characteristics of Aladfar. (天文學家研究了漸台二的光譜特性。)
As a true Aladinist, she collected every version of the classic tale. (作為一個真正的阿拉丁迷，她收集了這個經典故事的每一個版本。)
The Aladinist group discussed the various cultural adaptations of the story. (阿拉丁迷團體討論了該故事的各種文化改編。)

meaning: 加 誇張的,言過其實的
sentences: His alae exaggerated praise filled the speech. 他的誇張讚美充滿了整場演說。
She laughed at the alae exaggerated rumor. 她對那個誇張傳聞只覺得好笑。
The note in the manuscript said alaihi to him in Arabic. 手稿裡的註記說，這個阿拉伯語詞是「對他」的意思。
The prayer was directed alaihi, with a quiet bow. 那句祈禱伴著安靜的鞠躬，是對他說的。
Alain decided to study philosophy at the university. (阿蘭決定在大學學習哲學。)
Alain is a common French given name. (阿蘭是一個常見的法語名字。)
Alaite is a rare mineral composed primarily of calcium and vanadium. (Alaite 是一種主要由鈣和釩組成的稀有礦物。)
The sample of alaite was found in a remote desert region. (Alaite 樣本是在一個偏遠的沙漠地區發現的。)

meaning: 阿拉基（夏威夷地名或人名）
sentences: They drove to Alaki before sunset. 他們在日落前開車前往阿拉基。
The invitation was addressed to Alaki. 那張邀請函是寄給阿拉基的。

meaning: 阿拉拉（希臘神話中的戰吼女神；夏威夷烏鴉）
sentences: In Greek mythology, Alala is the personification of the war-cry. (在希臘神話中，阿拉拉是戰吼的化身。)
The Alala, or Hawaiian crow, is an endangered bird species. (Alala，即夏威夷烏鴉，是一種瀕危鳥類。)
The soldiers let out a powerful alala as they charged into battle. (士兵們在衝向戰場時發出了強大的戰吼。)
Conservationists are working hard to protect the remaining alala population. (環保人士正努力保護剩餘的夏威夷烏鴉種群。)
Alalite is a variety of diopside found in specific geological veins. (Alalite 是在特定地質礦脈中發現的一種透輝石。)
The crystals of alalite were clear and well-formed. (Alalite 的晶體清晰且形狀良好。)
Alalonga is a term used in some Mediterranean regions for albacore tuna. (Alalonga 是某些地中海地區對長鰭金槍魚的稱呼。)
The fisherman caught a large alalonga off the coast of Italy. (漁民在義大利海岸捕獲了一條巨大的長鰭金槍魚。)

meaning: 長鰭金槍魚（alalonga 的變體）
sentences: Alalunga is prized for its high-quality white meat. (長鰭金槍魚因其高品質的白肉而受到青睞。)
We enjoyed a delicious meal of grilled alalunga by the sea. (我們在海邊享用了一頓美味的烤長鰭金槍魚大餐。)

meaning: 無語人（假想的進化階段，指尚未獲得語言能力的原始人）
sentences: The museum sketch showed an alalus before language. 博物館的草圖畫出語言出現前的無語人。
The term alalus marks a speechless stage of evolution. 這個詞指的是尚未有語言的演化階段。

meaning: 阿拉曼尼人（古代日耳曼部落聯盟）
sentences: The Alamanni were a confederation of Germanic tribes that fought against Rome. (阿拉曼尼人是與羅馬作戰的日耳曼部落聯盟。)
The history of the Alamanni is central to the formation of medieval Europe. (阿拉曼尼人的歷史對於中世紀歐洲的形成至關重要。)

meaning: 阿拉曼尼人的；阿拉曼尼語
sentences: Alamannian dialects are still spoken in parts of Germany and Switzerland. (阿拉曼尼方言在德國和瑞士的部分地區仍在使用。)
He studied the Alamannian architecture of the early middle ages. (他研究了中世紀早期的阿拉曼尼建築。)

meaning: 阿拉曼尼人的；阿拉曼尼語（同 Alamannian）
sentences: Alamannic culture had a profound influence on the Rhine region. (阿拉曼尼文化對萊茵河地區產生了深遠的影響。)
The Alamannic migration is an important event in late antiquity. (阿拉曼尼人的遷徙是古代晚期的一個重要事件。)

meaning: 西班牙或葡萄牙的綠樹成蔭的大道。
sentences: We strolled down the alameda at dusk. 我們在黃昏時沿著那條綠樹成蔭的大道散步。
The cafe opened onto the alameda. 咖啡館正對著那條綠樹成蔭的大道。

meaning: 美國西南部的一種白楊樹；楊木（楊屬植物）。
sentences: The alamo tree shaded the road in summer. 夏天時，白楊樹替道路遮出一片陰影。
They cut alamo wood for the porch rail. 他們用白楊木做了門廊扶手。
Her choice of dress showed a keen sense of alamodality. (她的服裝選擇展現了敏銳的時尚感。)
The magazine covers the latest trends in alamodality and design. (雜誌涵蓋了時尚與設計的最新趨勢。)
The farmer found alamonti along the path. 農夫在小路旁發現了一株阿拉蒙蒂。
The alamonti had narrow leaves and a bitter smell. 阿拉蒙蒂的葉子狹長，氣味帶點苦。
Alamosite is a lead silicate mineral found in oxidized lead deposits. (鉛矽石是在氧化鉛礦床中發現的一種矽酸鉛礦物。)
The rare mineral alamosite was named after Alamos in Mexico. (罕見礦物鉛矽石是以墨西哥的阿拉莫斯命名的。)

meaning: （希伯來語）高音（聖經中的音樂術語）
sentences: The psalm was to be sung to the tune of alamoth. (這篇詩篇要按照高音曲調演唱。)
Alamoth refers to a high-pitched voice or instrument used in ancient worship. (Alamoth 指的是古代崇拜中使用的高音或高音樂器。)
Alan is a classic name of Celtic origin. (阿蘭是一個源自凱爾特人的經典名字。)
Alan won the science fair with his innovative project. (阿蘭憑藉他的創新項目贏得了科學展覽。)
An alan flew low over the marsh at dusk. 一隻這種鳥在黃昏時低飛掠過沼澤。
The guide pointed out the alan perched on the reed. 導覽員指著停在蘆葦上的那隻鳥。
The sailors were happy to be aland after weeks at sea. (在海上待了幾週後，水手們很高興能回到陸地上。)
The cargo was brought aland by the local porters. (貨物被當地的搬運工運到了陸地上。)
Alangiaceae is a family of flowering plants in the order Cornales. (八角楓科是山茱萸目中的一個開花植物科。)
The family Alangiaceae consists of only one genus, Alangium. (八角楓科僅包含一個屬，即八角楓屬。)

meaning: 八角楓素（從八角楓屬植物中提取的苦味物質）
sentences: Alangin is a chemical compound studied for its biological activity. (八角楓素是一種因其生物活性而受到研究的化學化合物。)
The researcher isolated alangin from the roots of the plant. (研究人員從植物的根部中分離出八角楓素。)
Alangine is an alkaloid found in species of Alangium. (八角楓鹼是在八角楓屬物種中發現的一種生物鹼。)
The pharmacological effects of alangine are documented in several studies. (幾項研究記錄了八角楓鹼的藥理作用。)
Alangium is a genus of shrubs and trees found in Africa and Asia. (八角楓屬是在非洲和亞洲發現的一屬灌木和樹木。)
Some species of Alangium are used in traditional medicine for pain relief. (某些八角楓屬物種在傳統醫學中用於緩解疼痛。)
The alani tree is native to Hawaii and has fragrant blossoms. (Alani 樹原產於夏威夷，長有芳香的花朵。)
Alani is the Hawaiian word for the color orange. (Alani 是夏威夷語中表示橘色的單詞。)
Alanine is a non-essential amino acid used in the biosynthesis of proteins. (丙氨酸是用於蛋白質生物合成的非必需氨基酸。)
The concentration of alanine in the blood was measured by the technician. (技術員測量了血液中丙氨酸的濃度。)

meaning: 親愛的（愛爾蘭語中的親暱稱呼）
sentences: Come here, alannah, and let me see you. (到這兒來，親愛的，讓我看看你。)
The mother spoke softly to her alannah. (母親溫柔地對她親愛的孩子說話。)

meaning: 阿蘭人（古代中亞民族，薩爾馬提亞人的一支）
sentences: The Alans migrated westward during the period of the Great Migrations. (阿蘭人在大遷徙時期向西遷移。)
The Alans were known as skilled horsemen and warriors. (阿蘭人以精湛的騎術和戰鬥技巧而聞名。)

meaning: 土木香的；得自土木香的（即 alantolactone 來源的）
sentences: Alantic acid is found in the essential oil of elecampane. (土木香酸存在於土木香精油中。)
The alantic properties of the extract were being studied in the lab. (實驗室正在研究該提取物的土木香特性。)

meaning: 菊粉（即 inulin 的舊稱）
sentences: The nutrition note linked alantin to inulin. 營養筆記把這個舊名稱對應到菊粉。
The chemist wrote alantin on the sample tag. 化學家在樣本標籤上寫下這個舊名稱。
Alantol is a chemical compound found in the plant elecampane. (土木香腦是在土木香植物中發現的一種化學化合物。)
The chemical structure of alantol was analyzed for its potential uses. (分析了土木香腦的化學結構以探討其潛在用途。)
