The aperea is a common rodent in South America. 巴西豚鼠是南美洲常見的囓齒動物。
Apereas are closely related to the domestic guinea pig. 巴西豚鼠與家養豚鼠密切相關。
The doctor suggested a mild aperient for the constipation. 醫生建議使用輕微的瀉藥來治療便秘。
Prunes are known for their aperient properties. 西梅以其輕瀉特性而聞名。
The sensor detected an aperiodic signal. 感測器檢測到一個非週期信號。
Aperiodic events occur at irregular intervals. 非週期性事件以不規則的間隔發生。
The data was collected aperiodically throughout the day. 數據在一天中非週期地收集。
The updates arrive aperiodically, so check often. 更新是不定期到達的，所以請經常檢查。
The aperiodicity of the system makes prediction difficult. 系統的非週期性使得預測變得困難。
Scientists analyzed the aperiodicity of the heart rhythm. 科學家分析了心律的非週期性。
Aperispermic seeds do not have a specialized nutritional tissue. 無外胚乳種子沒有專門的營養組織。
The botanist classified the plant as aperispermic. 植物學家將該植物歸類為無外胚乳類。
Aperistalsis can lead to severe intestinal obstruction. 腸蠕動停止可能導致嚴重的腸梗阻。
The medical team monitored the patient for signs of aperistalsis. 醫療團隊監測病人是否有腸蠕動停止的跡象。
We enjoyed an aperitive before dinner. 我們在晚餐前喝了開胃酒。
This herb has aperitive effects that stimulate the appetite. 這種草藥具有刺激食慾的開胃效果。
His apert disregard for the rules was shocking. 他對規則的公開無視令人震驚。
The evidence was apert to everyone in the room. 證據對房間裡的每個人來說都是顯而易見的。
He apertly expressed his disapproval. 他公開表達了他的反對。
The truth was apertly revealed during the trial. 真相在審判中被公開揭露。
The apertness of his character was admired by many. 他性格的坦率受到許多人的讚賞。
She appreciated the apertness of the discussion. 她欣賞討論的公開透明。

meaning: 孔徑計（測量透鏡數值孔徑的儀器）
sentences: The technician used an apertometer to calibrate the microscope. 技術人員使用孔徑計來校準顯微鏡。
An apertometer is essential for precision optical engineering. 孔徑計對於精密光學工程至關重要。
The apertural opening of the shell was very narrow. 貝殼的開口非常窄。
Apertural characteristics are used to identify fossil species. 孔部特徵被用於鑑定化石物種。

meaning: 小或窄的開口、間隙、狹縫或孔。
sentences: an aperture in a wall 牆上的一個孔
The term aperture refers to a small or narrow opening, gap, slit, or hole. 術語「孔徑」是指小或窄的開口、間隙、狹縫或孔。
The apertured wall allowed light to enter the room. 有孔的牆壁讓光線進入房間。
She wore an apertured lace dress. 她穿著一件有孔的蕾絲連衣裙。

meaning: 巴西的一種土語或地名（罕見）
sentences: The map marked Aperu near the river. 地圖在河邊標出了阿佩魯。
They heard Aperu spoken in the village. 他們在村子裡聽到有人說阿佩魯。
The children's play was full of silly apery. 孩子們的遊戲充滿了傻氣的模仿。
He dismissed the new fashion as mere apery of old styles. 他對新時尚不屑一顧，認為這只是對舊風格的模仿。

meaning: 失去觸覺（尤其指對壓力的感覺）
sentences: The neurological exam showed signs of apesthesia in the hands. 神經系統檢查顯示手部有觸覺喪失的跡象。
Apesthesia can result from nerve damage. 觸覺喪失可能是由神經損傷引起的。
The apesthetic areas were mapped out by the doctor. 醫生繪製出了無觸覺的區域。
An apesthetic condition requires careful protection of the skin. 無觸覺狀態需要對皮膚進行仔細保護。
The treatment aimed to apesthetize the painful region temporarily. 該治療旨在暫時使疼痛區域失去知覺。
Special techniques are used to apesthetize specific nerves. 使用特殊技術來使特定神經失去知覺。
Apetalae is a group of flowering plants that lack petals. 無花瓣類是一組缺乏花瓣的開花植物。
Botanists of the past often used the category Apetalae. 過去的植物學家經常使用無花瓣類這一類別。
The sepals were apetaloid in appearance. 萼片在外觀上不具花瓣狀。
The flower was small and apetaloid. 這朵花很小且不具花瓣狀。
The apetalose flowers are pollinated by the wind. 無花瓣的花是由風授粉的。
This species is characterized by being apetalose. 該物種的特徵是無花瓣。
Many trees produce apetalous flowers in early spring. 許多樹木在早春開出無花瓣的花。
The apetalous nature of the plant aids in its classification. 該植物的無花瓣特性有助於其分類。
The apetalousness of the bloom was unexpected. 花朵的無花瓣狀態是出人意料的。
He wrote a thesis on the apetalousness in certain plant families. 他寫了一篇關於某些植物科中無花瓣現象的論文。
Apetaly is common among wind-pollinated species. 無花瓣狀態在風媒傳粉物種中很常見。
Evolutionary adaptation led to apetaly in this genus. 進化適應導致了該屬的無花瓣狀態。

meaning: 某物的最高或最大部分，尤其是形成一個點。
sentences: the apex of the building 建築物的頂點
Drone cameras show that his car reached the apex first. 無人機攝影機顯示，他的車首先到達了山頂。
The mountain was sharply apexed. 這座山有著陡峭的頂峰。
The design featured an apexed roof. 該設計以尖頂屋頂為特色。
The word 'round' from 'around' is an example of aphaeresis. 從 around 變成 round 是首音脫落的一個例子。
Aphaeresis is a common process in the evolution of language. 首音脫落在語言演變中是一個常見的過程。
He analyzed the aphaeretic forms found in old dialects. 他分析了古方言中發現的首音脫落形式。
The aphaeretic spelling of the word is now standard. 該詞的首音脫落拼寫現在已成為標準。
Aphagia can be a symptom of various neurological disorders. 吞嚥困難可能是各種神經系統疾病的症狀。
The patient required a feeding tube due to aphagia. 由於不能吞嚥，病人需要胃管進食。
Aphakia most commonly results from cataract surgery. 無晶狀體最常由白內障手術引起。
Corrective lenses are necessary for those with aphakia. 對於無晶狀體者，矯正鏡片是必要的。
The doctor examined the aphakial eye of the patient. 醫生檢查了病人的無晶狀體眼睛。
Aphakial vision requires strong convex lenses. 無晶狀體視覺需要強凸透鏡。
The aphakic patient was satisfied with his new glasses. 無晶狀體病人對他的新眼鏡感到滿意。
Special contact lenses are available for aphakic individuals. 有無晶狀體的人可以使用的特殊隱形眼鏡。

meaning: （古生物）毛里求斯紅秧雞（已滅絕）
sentences: Aphanapteryx was a flightless bird once native to Mauritius. 毛里求斯紅秧雞曾是毛里求斯原產的一種不會飛的鳥。
The extinction of Aphanapteryx occurred in the 17th century. 毛里求斯紅秧雞在 17 世紀滅絕。
Aphanes is a genus of small annual herbs. 羽衣草屬是一類小型一年生草本植物。
You can find Aphanes species in many temperate regions. 你可以在許多溫帶地區找到羽衣草屬物種。
Aphanesite is a mineral containing copper and arsenic. 光粉石是一種含有銅和砷的礦物。
The mineralogist added a fine sample of aphanesite to the collection. 礦物學家在他的收藏中增加了一個優質的光粉石樣本。
Aphaniptera is the biological order that includes all species of fleas. 蚤目是包括所有種類跳蚤的生物目。
Insects in Aphaniptera are wingless and parasitic. 蚤目的昆蟲是無翅且寄生的。
The aphanipterous characteristic is essential for their parasitic lifestyle. 蚤目（無翅）的特徵對於它們的寄生生活方式至關重要。
He studied the morphology of aphanipterous insects. 他研究了無翅昆蟲的形態。
Aphanite is an igneous rock with crystals too small to be seen with the naked eye. 隱晶岩是一種晶體小到肉眼看不見的火成岩。
The geologist identified the sample as a type of aphanite. 地質學家將樣本鑑定為一種隱晶岩。
Basalt often has an aphanitic texture due to rapid cooling. 由於快速冷卻，玄武岩通常具有隱晶質紋理。
The aphanitic nature of the rock indicates it formed on the surface. 岩石的隱晶質特性表明它是在地表形成的。
The study examined the aphanitism in various volcanic rocks. 該研究檢查了各種火山岩中的隱晶質狀態。
Aphanitism is a key concept in petrology. 隱晶質狀態是岩石學中的一個關鍵概念。
Aphanomyces is a genus of water molds that can cause plant diseases. 絲囊黴屬是一類可能導致植物病害的水黴。
The researcher investigated the impact of Aphanomyces on legume crops. 研究人員調查了絲囊黴對豆科作物的影響。
Aphanophyre is a porphyritic rock with an aphanitic groundmass. 隱晶斑岩是一種具有隱晶基質的斑狀岩石。
The mineral composition of the aphanophyre was analyzed in the lab. 實驗室分析了隱晶斑岩的礦物成分。

meaning: （人類學）隱頰弓的；顴弓被頭顱掩蓋的
sentences: An aphanozygous skull has zygomatic arches that are not visible from above. 隱頰弓頭骨的顴弓從上方看不見。
The anthropologist used the term aphanozygous to describe the specimen. 人類學家使用隱頰弓一詞來描述該標本。
The Apharsathacites are mentioned in the Book of Ezra. 阿法薩提族人在《以斯拉記》中被提及。
They were among the groups that opposed the rebuilding of the temple. 他們是反對重建聖殿的團體之一。
Aphasia is a condition that affects a person's ability to communicate. 失語症是一種影響人溝通能力的疾病。
The patient developed aphasia following a stroke. 病人在中風後患上了失語症。
The therapist worked closely with the aphasiac to improve his speech. 治療師與失語症患者密切合作以改善其語言能力。
Aphasiac symptoms can vary depending on the area of brain damage. 失語症症狀可能因大腦受損區域的不同而異。
An aphasic patient may have difficulty finding the right words. 失語症患者可能難以找到正確的詞語。
She provided support for families of aphasic individuals. 她為失語症患者的家庭提供支持。

meaning: 單藥花屬（爵床科的一屬植物）
sentences: The zebra plant is a well-known species of Aphelandra. 金脈單藥花是單藥花屬中著名的物種。
Aphelandra is prized for its attractive foliage and bright flowers. 單藥花屬因其迷人的葉子和鮮豔的花朵而受到青睞。
Aphelenchus is a genus of nematodes found in soil. 滑刃線蟲屬是土壤中發現的一類線蟲。
Some species of Aphelenchus feed on fungi. 滑刃線蟲屬的某些物種以真菌為食。
The aphelian distance of the planet was calculated by astronomers. 天文學家計算了該行星的遠日點距離。
Aphelian position affects the amount of solar radiation received. 遠日點位置影響接收到的太陽輻射量。
Aphelinus is a genus of wasps that parasitize aphids. 蚜小蜂屬是寄生於蚜蟲的一類蜂。
The release of Aphelinus mali helped control apple aphids. 蚜小蜂的釋放有助於控制蘋果蚜蟲。
The Earth reaches its aphelion in early July. 地球在七月初到達遠日點。
Aphelion is the point in an orbit furthest from the sun. 遠日點是軌道中距離太陽最遠的一點。
Roots are often apheliotropic, growing away from the light. 根通常是背日性的，向著遠離光的方向生長。
The study observed apheliotropic responses in certain seedlings. 該研究觀察了某些幼苗的背日性反應。
The plant's organs moved apheliotropically during the experiment. 在實驗期間，植物器官表現出背日性移動。
The cells responded apheliotropically to the intense light source. 細胞對強光源表現出背日性反應。
Apheliotropism is the tendency of an organism to turn away from the sun. 背日性是生物體背向太陽生長的傾向。
Scientists investigated the mechanisms behind apheliotropism. 科學家調查了背日性背後的機制。
Aphelops was a prehistoric rhinoceros that lived in North America. 無角犀是生活在北美的史前犀牛。
Fossils of Aphelops date back to the Miocene and Pliocene. 無角犀的化石可以追溯到中新世和上新世。
Aphemia is the loss of the ability to produce articulate speech. 失語症是失去產生清晰語言的能力。
The patient struggled with aphemia despite having normal comprehension. 儘管理解能力正常，病人仍與失語症作鬥爭。
The aphemic patient used a communication board. 失語症患者使用溝通板。
Aphemic symptoms were analyzed by the speech-language pathologist. 言語病理學家分析了失語症狀。
The teacher used an aphengescope to project images from a book. 老師使用不透明物投影儀投影書中的圖像。
An aphengescope allows for the projection of non-transparent objects. 不透明物投影儀允許投影非透明物體。
The old aphengoscope was found in the school's storage room. 在學校儲藏室發現了舊的不透明物投影儀。
Modern projectors have largely replaced the aphengoscope. 現代投影儀已在很大程度上取代了不透明物投影儀。
He demonstrated how the aphenoscope could project a solid object. 他演示了不透明物投影儀如何投影固體物體。
The museum displayed an early model of an aphenoscope. 博物館展出了一個早期型號的不透明物投影儀。

meaning: （醫學）成份獻血；（語言學）首音脫落
sentences: During apheresis, specific components are removed from the blood. 在成份獻血期間，血液中的特定成分被移除。
Apheresis of the first syllable is common in some dialects. 某些方言中常見首音節脫落現象。

meaning: 成份獻血的；首音脫落的
sentences: The patient underwent an apheretic procedure. 病人接受了成份獻血程序。
The linguist studied apheretic changes in English. 語言學家研究了英語中的首音脫落變化。

meaning: （語言學）首音脫落（尤指非重讀首元音）
sentences: The word 'mend' from 'amend' is a result of aphesis. 從 amend 變成 mend 是首音脫落的結果。
Aphesis often occurs over centuries of language use. 首音脫落通常發生在數百年的語言使用過程中。
The apheta is a planet or point used to determine the length of life. 壽星是用於確定壽命長短的行星或點。
Calculating the apheta is a complex task in traditional astrology. 在傳統占星術中，計算壽星是一項複雜的任務。
The dictionary lists several aphetic forms of common words. 字典列出了常見單詞的幾種首音脫落形式。
Aphetic words are common in informal speech. 首音脫落的單詞在非正式語言中很常見。
In that dialect, people say "nother" aphetically. 在那種方言裡，人們會用首音脫落的方式說 nother。
The teacher pointed out the aphetically shortened form. 老師指出那個首音脫落的縮略形式。
He wrote a paper on aphetism in Romance languages. 他寫了一篇關於羅曼語中首音脫落現象的論文。
Aphetism is an interesting topic for students of etymology. 對於詞源學學生來說，首音脫落現象是一個有趣的主題。
Children sometimes aphetize the first sound when they speak fast. 孩子們講得快時，有時會把開頭的音省掉。
The singer seemed to aphetize the word at the start of the line. 那位歌手在開頭似乎把那個字的首音吞掉了。
The farmer applied an aphicidal spray to the crops. 農民在農作物上噴灑了殺蚜蟲劑。
The aphicidal properties of the plant were studied in the lab. 實驗室研究了該植物的殺蚜蟲特性。
This new aphicide is highly effective against garden pests. 這種新型殺蚜蟲劑對花園害蟲非常有效。
He bought a bottle of aphicide at the garden center. 他在園藝中心買了一瓶殺蚜蟲劑。
Aphids can cause significant damage to rose bushes. 蚜蟲會對玫瑰叢造成重大損害。
Ladybugs are natural predators of aphids. 瓢蟲是蚜蟲的天敵。
The leaves were covered in tiny green aphides. 葉子上覆蓋著微小的綠色蚜蟲。
Scientists studied the reproduction rates of various aphides. 科學家研究了各種蚜蟲的繁殖率。
The aphidian infestation spread quickly through the greenhouse. 蚜蟲的侵襲在溫室中迅速蔓延。
Aphidian species are known for their complex life cycles. 蚜蟲物種以其複雜的生命週期而聞名。
The use of aphidicide is common in industrial agriculture. 殺蚜蟲劑的使用在工業化農業中很常見。
She researched the environmental impact of synthetic aphidicides. 她研究了合成殺蚜蟲劑對環境的影響。

meaning: 生活在蚜蟲群中的；與蚜蟲共生的
sentences: Certain ant species are aphidicolous and protect the aphids. 某些螞蟻物種與蚜蟲共生並保護蚜蟲。
The aphidicolous behavior of these insects is quite remarkable. 這些昆蟲與蚜蟲共生的行為非常引人注目。
The aphidid produces honeydew that attracts ants. 蚜蟲產生吸引螞蟻的蜜露。
He collected several aphidid specimens for his study. 他收集了幾個蚜蟲標本用於研究。
Aphididae is a large family of small plant-sucking insects. 蚜科是一個大型的小型吸汁昆蟲家族。
Members of Aphididae are major agricultural pests. 蚜科成員是主要的農業害蟲。
Aphidiinae is a subfamily of parasitoid wasps that target aphids. 蚜繭蜂亞科是針對蚜蟲的寄生蜂亞科。
The Aphidiinae play a crucial role in natural pest control. 蚜繭蜂亞科在自然害蟲防治中起著至關重要的作用。
The plant showed signs of aphidious damage. 植物顯示出蚜蟲損害的跡象。
Aphidious populations can explode under favorable conditions. 蚜蟲種群在有利條件下會爆炸式增長。
Aphidius colemani is often used in integrated pest management. 蚜繭蜂常用於綜合害蟲管理中。
The female Aphidius lays its eggs inside the body of an aphid. 雌性蚜繭蜂將卵產在蚜蟲體內。
Hoverfly larvae are aphidivorous and consume many aphids. 食蚜蠅幼蟲是食蚜蟲的，會消耗大量蚜蟲。
The gardener encouraged aphidivorous insects to stay in the garden. 園丁鼓勵食蚜昆蟲留在花園裡。
Aphidolysin is a substance found in certain predatory insects. 蚜蟲毒素是在某些捕食性昆蟲中發現的物質。
Researchers studied the chemical composition of aphidolysin. 研究人員研究了蚜蟲毒素的化學成分。
Aphidophagous predators help maintain the balance of the ecosystem. 食蚜捕食者有助於維持生態系統的平衡。
The study focused on the feeding habits of aphidophagous beetles. 該研究專注於食蚜甲蟲的進食習慣。
The aphidozer is a machine designed to vacuum aphids from crops. 捕蚜機是一種設計用於從農作物中吸走蚜蟲的機器。
Using an aphidozer is an eco-friendly alternative to chemical pesticides. 使用捕蚜機是化學農藥的一種環保替代方案。

meaning: 缺乏博愛精神；對人類缺乏同情心。
sentences: His aphilanthropy was evident in his refusal to help the poor. 他的缺乏博愛精神在他拒絕幫助窮人時顯而易見。
She criticized his aphilanthropy and cold demeanor. 她批評他的缺乏同情心和冷酷舉止。
The gardener used natural remedies to control the Aphis population. 園丁使用天然藥物來控制蚜蟲的數量。

meaning: 脫水烏頭鹼（一種化學物質）。

meaning: 活力減退的；壽命縮短的。

sentences: The apocalypst read the final visions aloud to the class. 這位啟示文學研究者把最後的異象朗讀給全班聽。

sentences: The apocalypt warned the village about the coming storm. 那位預言大災難的人警告村民暴風雨將至。

sentences: The film portrays an apocalyptical future for humanity. 這部電影描繪了人類災難性的未來。

Apocalypticism was a significant trend in early Jewish thought. 天啟論是早期猶太思想的一個重要趨勢。
The rise of apocalypticism often occurs during times of social upheaval. 天啟論的興起通常發生在社會動盪時期。
The book examines the influence of apocalyptism on modern culture. 這本書考察了天啟主義對現代文化的影響。
Apocalyptism provides a framework for understanding historical events. 天啟主義為理解歷史事件提供了一個框架。
The apocalyptist believed that a divine intervention was imminent. 天啟論者相信神聖的干預即將到來。
Scholars identified several different styles among the ancient apocalyptists. 學者們在古代天啟論者中鑑定出幾種不同的風格。
The chemist synthesized an apocamphoric derivative. 化學家合成了一種脫水樟腦酸衍生物。
Apocamphoric acid is used in specialized chemical reactions. 脫水樟腦酸用於專門的化學反應。
An apocarp consists of several separate carpels. 離心皮果由幾個獨立的心皮組成。
The raspberry is an example of an apocarp. 覆盆子是離心皮果的一個例子。

The degree of apocarpy can vary significantly among species. 離心皮狀態的程度在不同物種之間可能存在顯著差異。

meaning: 萬物復興；萬物回歸原始狀態（神學/哲學）。
sentences: Apocatastasis is the doctrine that all souls will eventually be reconciled to God. 萬物復興論是指所有靈魂最終都將與上帝和解的教義。
The concept of apocatastasis has roots in ancient Greek philosophy. 萬物復興的概念源於古希臘哲學。

sentences: He presented an apocatastatic view of history and the future. 他提出了一種萬物復興的歷史和未來觀。
The apocatastatic theology of Origen was controversial. 奧利金的萬物復興神學是有爭議的。
The treatment aimed to achieve a thorough apocatharsis of the body. 該治療旨在實現身體的徹底淨化。
Apocatharsis was a central concept in some ancient medical systems. 完全淨化是某些古代醫學體系中的核心概念。

meaning: 遠中心點（天體軌道中距離中心天體最遠的點）。
sentences: The satellite reached its apocenter at midnight. 衛星在午夜到達其遠中心點。

The apocentric position of the moon varies over time. 月球的遠中心位置隨時間而變化。

meaning: 離心性；遠離中心的狀態。
sentences: The study examined the apocentricity of the galaxy's outer stars. 該研究檢查了銀河系外圍恆星的離心性。
Apocentricity is a key factor in determining the stability of an orbit. 離心性是決定軌道穩定性的關鍵因素。
The merchant provided an apocha to confirm the payment. 商人提供了一份收據以確認付款。

The researcher investigated the properties of apocholic compounds. 研究人員調查了脫水膽酸化合物的性質。

Apochromatic lenses provide better color correction than achromatic ones. 複消色差透鏡比消色差透鏡提供更好的色彩校正。
He bought an apochromatic refractor for astrophotography. 他買了一個複消色差折射鏡用於天文攝影。
Apochromatism is the result of using specialized glass types in a lens. 複消色差現象是在透鏡中使用專門玻璃類型的結果。

The chemical properties of apocinchonine were investigated in the study. 研究中調查了脫水辛可寧的化學性質。

The Apocrypha contains books not included in the standard Hebrew Bible. 次經包含未列入標準希伯來聖經的書籍。
Scholars study the Apocrypha for historical context. 學者們研究次經以獲取歷史背景。

The discovery of the ancient apocryphon shed light on early beliefs. 古代偽經的發現揭示了早期的信仰。

He studied the pharmacological properties of apocynaceous plants. 他研究了夾竹桃科植物的藥理性質。
The specimen was identified as an apocyneous shrub. 該標本被鑑定為夾竹桃科灌木。
Apocyneous flowers are often brightly colored and fragrant. 夾竹桃科的花朵通常色彩鮮艷且芳香。
Apocynum grew along the dry riverbank. 羅布麻屬植物長在乾燥的河岸邊。
The herbalist pointed to an Apocynum stem. 草藥師指著一根羅布麻屬植物的莖。
The apod larvae move by undulating their bodies. 無足幼蟲通過波動身體來移動。
Many types of worms are considered apods. 許多類型的蠕蟲被認為是無足動物。

Members of Apoda are primarily found in tropical regions. 無足目成員主要分佈在熱帶地區。
The apodal fish navigated the reef with ease. 這條無足魚（如鰻魚類）輕鬆地在珊瑚礁中穿行。
He studied the skeletal structure of apodal vertebrates. 他研究了無足脊椎動物的骨骼結構。

His mathematical apodeixis was clear and concise. 他的數學論證清晰簡明。
The philosopher used apodeixis to support his core arguments. 這位哲學家使用論證來支持他的核心觀點。

Apodemes serve as sites for muscle attachment. 內突作為肌肉附著的位點。

The apodous larvae are often found in decaying wood. 無足幼蟲常在腐爛的木頭中被發現。
He observed the movements of the apodous amphibian. 他觀察了這隻無足兩棲動物的運動。
The bathers left their clothes in the apodyterium. 沐浴者將衣服留在更衣室裡。
Excavations revealed beautiful mosaics on the floor of the apodyterium. 挖掘顯示更衣室的地板上有美麗的馬賽克。

meaning: 無融合生殖；單性生殖（植物）。

The appropinquity of the houses made privacy difficult. 房屋的鄰近使得隱私變得很困難。

sentences: The remaining funds are appropriable for other projects. 剩餘資金可用於其他項目。
Are these natural resources appropriable by the state? 這些自然資源可由國家佔用嗎？
Please ensure that your clothing is appropriate for the wedding. 請確保您的著裝適合參加婚禮。
The manager decided to take appropriate action to solve problem. 經理決定採取適當的行動來解決問題。
Please ensure that you are dressed appropriately for the interview. 請確保您的面試著裝得體。
The situation was handled appropriately by the manager. 經理妥善處理了這種情況。
The appropriateness of her response was questioned. 她的回答是否合適受到了質疑。
We need to consider the appropriateness of the gift. 我們需要考慮這份禮物是否合適。
The term appropriation refers to An act or instance of appropriating. 挪用一詞是指挪用的行為或例子。

The appropriative bill was passed by the senate. 撥款法案已由參議院通過。
The appropriativeness of the measure was debated in parliament. 議會辯論了該措施的佔用性質（或撥款性質）。
They discussed the appropriativeness of the budget allocation. 他們討論了預算分配的撥款性質。
The appropriator of the funds was later arrested. 挪用資金的人後來被捕了。
He is the primary appropriator of the new technology. 他是這項新技術的主要佔用者（或採用者）。
The application is approvable if all conditions are met. 如果符合所有條件，申請是可以核准的。
The project seems approvable by the board. 該項目似乎可以得到董事會的認可。

They checked the approvableness of the legal documents. 他們檢查了法律文件的可核准性。
The board of directors decided to give their formal approval. 董事會決定給予正式的批准（贊同）。
She sought her parents' approval before making the final decision. 她在做出最終決定前尋求父母的認可。

sentences: They waited for the king's approvance. 他們等待國王的許可。
The plan was carried out with the manager's approvance. 該計劃是在經理的認可下執行的。
The board of directors decided to approve the new proposal. 董事會決定批准這項新提案。

The method has been approvedly used in many hospitals. 該方法已在許多醫院中被認可地使用。
He is approvedly the best candidate for the job. 他被公認是這份工作的最佳人選。
The approvedness of the product is essential for its sale. 產品的被認可狀態對其銷售至關重要。
We must maintain the approvedness of our standards. 我們必須維持我們標準的被認可性。

meaning: 改進；認可；批准（古語，常用 improvement 或 approval）
sentences: The land underwent significant approvement. 這片土地經歷了顯著的改良。
He sought his father's approvement for his decision. 他就自己的決定尋求父親的認可。

meaning: 認可者；批准者；（律）自首告密者
sentences: The approver of the design will sign the document today. 設計的批准者今天將簽署文件。
The criminal turned approver to get a lighter sentence. 該罪犯轉為自首告密者以獲得較輕的刑罰。
The father smiled approvingly at his son's achievements. 父親對兒子的成就露出了贊許的微笑。
The audience nodded approvingly during the presentation. 演講期間，聽眾贊許地點頭。
The dentist examined the approximal surfaces of the teeth. 牙醫檢查了牙齒的鄰接面。
The two structures are in an approximal position. 這兩個結構處於鄰接位置。
The approximate total cost of the trip is about five hundred dollars. 這次旅行的估計總花費約為五百美元。
Could you please provide an approximate time for your arrival tomorrow? 您能提供明天大約抵達的時間嗎？
The journey will take approximately three hours by train. 搭火車旅行大約需要三個小時。
There were approximately fifty people at the meeting. 會議上大約有五十個人。

The result is a close approximation to the truth. 結果非常接近真相。

The approximative value of the property is $1 million. 該房產的大約價值為 100 萬美元。
The work will take approximatively three months. 這項工作大約需要三個月。
There are approximatively 500 people in the hall. 大廳裡大約有 500 人。
The approximativeness of the measurements was acceptable. 測量的近似性是可以接受的。
They discussed the approximativeness of the results. 他們討論了結果的近似程度。
The algorithm acts as a powerful approximator for complex functions. 該算法是複雜函數的強大逼近器。
In this model, the neural network is used as an approximator. 在這個模型中，神經網絡被用作逼近元。
An appulse of the moon and a star will occur tonight. 今晚將發生月球與一顆恆星的視接近。
The appulse of the waves against the shore was constant. 波浪對海岸的衝擊是持續不斷的。
The appulsion of the two particles resulted in a reaction. 兩個粒子的撞擊導致了反應。
Scientists studied the appulsion of the celestial bodies. 科學家研究了天體的接近。
The appulsive force of the water damaged the bridge. 水的衝擊力損壞了橋樑。
An appulsive movement was detected in the seismic data. 在地震數據中檢測到了一種衝擊性運動。
The object hit the ground appulsively. 該物體猛烈地（衝擊地）撞擊地面。
The waves moved appulsively against the sea wall. 波浪衝擊地拍打著海堤。
The garage is an appurtenance to the main house. 車庫是主屋的附屬建築。
They sold the farm along with all its appurtenances. 他們賣掉了農場及其所有的附屬設施。
These rights are appurtenant to the ownership of the land. 這些權利是土地所有權的附屬權利。
The legal documents include all appurtenant information. 法律文件包含了所有相關信息。
The patient exhibited apractic symptoms after the stroke. 中風後，患者表現出失用症狀。
He had an apractic difficulty in performing simple tasks. 他在執行簡單任務時有失用性的困難。

meaning: 【醫】失用症（無法執行有目的的動作）
sentences: Apraxia can affect a person's ability to speak or move. 失用症會影響一個人說話或移動的能力。
The therapist is helping the child manage his apraxia. 治療師正在幫助孩子應對他的失用症。
The apraxic patient required special assistance. 患有失用症的患者需要特殊協助。
She conducted a study on apraxic speech disorders. 她進行了一項關於失用性言語障礙的研究。
The lizards like to apricate on the warm rocks. 蜥蜴喜歡在溫暖的岩石上曬太陽。
It is relaxing to apricate in the garden on a sunny day. 在陽光燦爛的日子裡，在花園裡曬太陽很放鬆。
Daily aprication can improve vitamin D levels. 每天曬太陽可以提高維生素 D 水平。
The cat found a perfect spot for aprication. 貓找到了一個曬太陽的絕佳地點。
The aprickle bush was difficult to clear. 那灌木叢多刺，很難清理。
Be careful not to touch the aprickle leaves. 小心不要碰到那些有刺的葉子。
She made a delicious jam using fresh apricots from her garden. 她用自家花園裡的新鮮杏子做出了美味的果醬。
The walls of the bedroom are painted a soft shade of apricot. 臥室的牆壁漆成了柔和的杏色。
April showers bring May flowers. 四月的雨帶來五月的花。
My birthday is in April. 我的生日在四月。

meaning: 四月式的；像四月的（多指天氣多變）
sentences: The weather today is very Aprilesque, with sudden rain and sun. 今天的氣候非常像四月，忽雨忽晴。
He enjoyed the Aprilesque freshness of the morning. 他喜歡早晨那種四月般的清新。
The garden was filled with Apriline blossoms. 花園裡開滿了四月的花朵。
They celebrated their anniversary in the Apriline sun. 他們在四月的陽光下慶祝他們的週年紀念日。
The Roman calendar called this month Aprilis. 羅馬曆把這個月份稱作四月。
Aprilis came with warmer days and longer light. 四月帶來了更暖的日子和更長的白晝。

meaning: 先天性的；推論的；先驗的
sentences: This is an apriori assumption that needs to be tested. 這是一個需要測試的先驗假設。
The conclusion was reached apriori. 這個結論是通過先驗推論得出的。
Apriorism is a philosophical concept regarding knowledge independent of experience. 先驗論是關於獨立於經驗的知識的哲學概念。
His arguments were based on pure apriorism. 他的論點基於純粹的先驗論。
As an apriorist, he believes that some knowledge is innate. 作為一名先驗論者，他相信某些知識是與生俱來的。
The apriorist philosopher debated with the empiricist. 先驗論哲學家與經驗論者進行了辯論。
The aprioristic method was criticized for lack of evidence. 先驗論方法因缺乏證據而受到批評。
She presented an aprioristic theory on logic. 她提出了一個關於邏輯的先驗理論。
The apriority of time and space is a central theme in Kant's work. 時空的先驗性是康德著作的核心主題。
They discussed the apriority of certain moral principles. 他們討論了某些道德原則的優先性（或先驗性）。
The zoology lecture explained that Aprocta are worms without an anus. 動物學課說明無肛類是沒有肛門的蠕蟲類。
The slide was labeled Aprocta under the microscope. 顯微鏡下那張玻片標著無肛類。
Aproctia is a rare congenital condition. 無肛畸形是一種罕見的先天性狀況。
Surgery is often required to correct aproctia. 通常需要手術來矯正無肛畸形。
The organism is aproctous, meaning it lacks an anus. 該生物是無肛的，這意味著它沒有肛門。
Some simple invertebrates are naturally aproctous. 一些簡單的無脊椎動物天生就是無肛的。
My mother always wears a clean white apron while cooking. 我媽媽做飯時總是穿著一件乾淨的白圍裙。
The carpenter put on his heavy leather apron before working. 木匠在工作前穿上了他的厚皮圍裙。

meaning: 穿圍裙的人；（指）小店主或工人（帶有蔑稱）
sentences: He was dismissively called an aproneer by the aristocrats. 他被貴族們輕蔑地稱為穿圍裙的小店主。
The aproneer worked tirelessly in his small workshop. 那個穿圍裙的工人在他的小作坊裡不知疲倦地工作。
She gathered an apronful of apples from the orchard. 她從果園裡摘了一圍裙的蘋果。
The child carried an apronful of toys into the house. 孩子抱著一圍裙的玩具走進房子。
The cook stood apronless in the messy kitchen. 廚師沒穿圍裙，站在凌亂的廚房裡。
She felt vulnerable working in the garden apronless. 她覺得沒穿圍裙在花園裡工作有些不便（或易弄髒）。
The bird has an apronlike patch of feathers on its chest. 這種鳥的胸部有一塊像圍裙一樣的羽毛。
He wore an apronlike garment for the ceremony. 他為了儀式穿了一件像圍裙一樣的服裝。
Apropos of our conversation, I found the book you mentioned. 關於我們的對話，我找到了你提到的那本書。
Your comment was very apropos. 你的評論非常及時且中肯。
The student's aprosexia affected his academic performance. 該學生的注意力不集中影響了他的學業表現。

Aprosopia is a severe developmental abnormality. 無面畸形是一種嚴重的發育異常。
The medical team discussed the case of aprosopia. 醫療團隊討論了這起無面畸形的案例。
The aprosopous fetus was identified through ultrasound. 通過超音波鑑定出了無面的胎兒。
He studied the genetic causes of aprosopous conditions. 他研究了無面狀況的遺傳原因。
The skull showed that the creature was aproterodont. 頭骨顯示這種生物前部無齒。
Some extinct reptiles were aproterodont. 一些已滅絕的爬行動物是前部無齒的。

meaning: 【建】（教堂東端半圓形的）後殿；弧形結構
sentences: The altar is located in the apse of the cathedral. 祭壇位於大教堂的後殿。

Apselaphesia can be a symptom of nerve damage. 觸覺缺失可能是神經損傷的症狀。
The patient complained of apselaphesia in his fingertips. 患者抱怨手指尖觸覺缺失。
Apselaphesis affects the ability to perceive physical contact. 觸覺缺失會影響感知身體接觸的能力。
Special tests were conducted to confirm the apselaphesis. 進行了專門的測試以確認觸覺缺失。

The apsidal distance of the planet varies over time. 行星的拱點距離會隨著時間而變化。
The chapel was apsidally arranged. 小教堂呈後殿狀排列。
The orbit was calculated apsidally. 軌道是在拱點處計算的。
The apsides of an orbit are the closest and farthest points. 軌道的拱點是最近點和最遠點。
Astronomers measured the shift in the apsides. 天文學家測量了拱點的位移。
Small chapels were built into the apsidioles. 附屬的小後殿裡建有小禮拜堂。
The architect added several apsidioles to the design. 建築師在設計中增加了幾個小後殿。
The satellite is currently at its apsis. 衛星目前正處於其拱點。
The priest stood in the apsis during the service. 牧師在儀式期間站在後殿中。
The sudden apsychia was caused by low blood pressure. 突然的昏厥是由低血壓引起的。
Apsychia can be a scary experience for the patient. 意識喪失對患者來說可能是一個可怕的經歷。
He explored the apsychical aspects of the biological process. 他探索了生物過程中非心理的方面。
The scientist focused on apsychical physical reactions. 科學家專注於無心理因素的物理反應。
The title of the book is very apt, as it perfectly describes the main theme. 書名非常恰當，因為它完美地描述了主題。
Some people are more apt to catch a cold than others during the winter months. 冬天有些人比其他人更容易感冒。

meaning: （罕用詞，可能指）適合的；（或地名/姓氏）
sentences: The teacher used Aptal to describe the example. 老師用這個形容詞描述例子。
She underlined Aptal because it was new to her. 她把這個形容詞畫線標起來。

meaning: 【動】企鵝屬（特別指國王企鵝和皇帝企鵝）
sentences: Aptenodytes forsteri is the scientific name for the Emperor Penguin. Aptenodytes forsteri 是皇帝企鵝的學名。
The genus Aptenodytes includes the largest living penguins. 企鵝屬包含了現存最大的企鵝。
Aptera is a group of insects that lack wings. 無翅類是一群沒有翅膀的昆蟲。
He studied the evolutionary history of the Aptera. 他研究了無翅類的進化歷史。
The ancient temple has an apteral design. 這座古廟採用了無側廊的設計。
The apteral insect was camouflaged on the ground. 那隻無翅昆蟲在地面上偽裝得很好。
An apteran species was discovered in the deep forest. 在深林中發現了一種無翅昆蟲。
He collected various apteran specimens for his research. 他為研究收集了各種無翅標本。
The apterial tracks on the bird's skin were examined. 檢查了鳥類皮膚上的無羽區路徑。
Feathers do not grow on the apterial parts of the body. 羽毛不會長在身體的無羽區部分。
An apterium is a bare patch on a bird's skin. 無羽區是鳥類皮膚上的一塊裸露區域。
The size of the apterium varies between different species. 不同物種之間無羽區的大小各不相同。

meaning: 像無翅昆蟲的；翅膀退化的
sentences: The beetle has an apteroid appearance. 這種甲蟲外觀像無翅昆蟲。
Its wings are apteroid and non-functional. 它的翅膀已經退化，沒有功能。
The female of this species is apterous. 這個物種的雌性是無翅的。
Apterous insects often live in hidden environments. 無翅昆蟲通常生活在隱蔽的環境中。

meaning: 【動】無翼類（幾維鳥所屬的目，現常用 Apterygiformes）
sentences: Apteryges is an older name for the order containing kiwis. Apteryges 是包含幾維鳥的目的一個舊稱。
The birds in the Apteryges group are flightless. 無翼類中的鳥類都是不會飛的。
The apterygial fish moved through the water strangely. 那條無鰭魚在水中移動得很奇怪。
He studied the development of apterygial traits. 他研究了無翅（或無鰭）特徵的發育。
Apterygidae is the family to which kiwis belong. 幾維鳥科是幾維鳥所屬的科。
All members of the Apterygidae are endemic to New Zealand. 幾維鳥科的所有成員都是紐西蘭特有的。
Apterygiformes are small flightless birds from New Zealand. 幾維鳥目是來自紐西蘭的小型不飛鳥。
The Kiwi is the most famous member of the order Apterygiformes. 幾維鳥是幾維鳥目中最著名的成員。
The textbook placed fleas in Apterygogenea. 教科書把跳蚤放進無翅昆蟲綱。
The museum drawer held several Apterygogenea specimens. 博物館抽屜裡放著幾個無翅昆蟲綱標本。
Apterygota includes primitive insects that never evolved wings. 無翅亞綱包括從未演化出翅膀的原始昆蟲。
Silverfish are a common example of Apterygota. 衣魚是無翅亞綱的一個常見例子。
The researcher found an interesting apterygote in the soil. 研究人員在土壤中發現了一種有趣的無翅亞綱昆蟲。
Apterygote insects are often very small. 無翅亞綱昆蟲通常非常小。
Apterygotous species provide insights into early insect evolution. 無翅亞綱物種為早期昆蟲進化提供了見解。
He specialized in the study of apterygotous creatures. 他專門從事無翅亞綱生物的研究。
Apteryx is the only genus in the family Apterygidae. 幾維鳥屬是幾維鳥科中唯一的屬。
The Apteryx is a national symbol of New Zealand. 幾維鳥是紐西蘭的國家象徵。

meaning: 【地】阿普第階（下白堊紀的一個階段）
sentences: The Aptian age occurred approximately 125 to 113 million years ago. 阿普第階發生在大約 1.25 億至 1.13 億年前。
Fossils from the Aptian stage are found in many parts of the world. 在世界許多地方都發現了阿普第階的化石。

meaning: （罕用詞，可能指）與阿普第階相關的特徵或生物
sentences: Aptiana appeared in the notes for the Aptian layer. 那個名稱出現在阿普第階地層的筆記裡。
The paleontologist wrote Aptiana beside the fossil bed. 古生物學家把這個詞寫在化石層旁。

meaning: 獲得知識或技能的自然能力。
sentences: She showed an early aptitude for mathematics. 她很早就展現了數學天賦。
The test measures a student’s aptitude for language learning. 此測驗衡量學生的語言學習能力。
The school uses aptitudinal tests to identify gifted students. 學校使用才能測試來識別天才學生。
She showed great aptitudinal potential for music. 她表現出巨大的音樂才能潛力。
Aptitudinally, he was better suited for engineering than art. 就才能而言，他比藝術更適合工程。
The candidates were evaluated aptitudinally. 候選人接受了資質方面的評估。
The book is aptly titled 'The Great Escape'. 這本書被恰如其分地命名為《大逃亡》。
He aptly described the situation in just a few words. 他用寥寥數語就貼切地描述了情況。
The aptness of his comment surprised everyone. 他評論的貼切性讓每個人都感到驚訝。
She showed an unusual aptness for learning foreign languages. 她表現出學習外語的非凡天賦。
In some languages, many nouns are aptotes. 在某些語言中，許多名詞是無格變化的。
The linguist explained the function of an aptote in the sentence. 語言學家解釋了句子中無格變化名詞的功能。
English nouns are largely aptotic compared to Latin. 與拉丁語相比，英語名詞在很大程度上是無格變化的。
He studied aptotic languages in Southeast Asia. 他研究了東南亞的無格變化語言。
Aptyalia can cause difficulty in swallowing. 唾液缺乏會導致吞嚥困難。
The patient suffered from severe aptyalia as a side effect. 作為副作用，患者患有嚴重的無唾液症。
Aptyalism is a condition where the salivary glands do not produce enough saliva. 無唾液症是指唾液腺不能產生足夠唾液的狀況。
The treatment for aptyalism involves stimulating the salivary glands. 無唾液症的治療包括刺激唾液腺。
An aptychus is a type of marine fossil. Aptychus 是一種海洋化石。
Paleontologists found several aptychus specimens in the limestone. 古生物學家在石灰岩中發現了幾個菊石口蓋標本。

meaning: 阿普利亞的（義大利地名）；阿普利亞人
sentences: The Apulian region is famous for its olive oil. 阿普利亞地區以其橄欖油而聞名。
He studied the ancient Apulian pottery styles. 他研究了古代阿普利亞陶器的風格。
The infant was born with an apulmonic condition. 這名嬰兒出生時患有肺部發育不全的狀況。
He conducted research on apulmonic congenital defects. 他對肺部發育不全的先天性缺陷進行了研究。

meaning: 衝擊；（天體）視接近（同 appulse）
sentences: The apulse of the comet was observed by astronomers. 天文學家觀察到了彗星的視接近。
We felt the apulse of the explosion from miles away. 我們在幾英里外都能感覺到爆炸的衝擊。

meaning: 故意地；為了特定目的（同 on purpose）
sentences: He did it apurpose to see my reaction. 他故意這樣做是為了看我的反應。
She arrived early apurpose to get a good seat. 她特意早到是為了搶個好位子。
Apus is a small constellation in the southern sky. 天燕座是南天的一個小星座。
Apus apus is the scientific name for the common swift. Apus apus 是普通雨燕的學名。

meaning: 【藥】阿皮奧寧（一種黃色染料，曾用作防腐劑）
sentences: Apyonin was once used in the treatment of eye infections. 阿皮奧寧曾被用於治療眼部感染。
The chemical properties of apyonin were studied in the laboratory. 在實驗室研究了阿皮奧寧的化學性質。
Some varieties of grapes are apyrene. 某些品種的葡萄是無核的。
The apyrene condition is preferred by many consumers. 許多消費者更喜歡無核的情況。
The patient remained apyretic throughout the observation. 在整個觀察期間，患者都沒有發燒。
An apyretic illness can still be serious. 不發燒的疾病仍可能很嚴重。
The period of apyrexia lasted for several days. 退熱期持續了幾天。
Apyrexia indicates that the fever has subsided. 無熱狀態表示發燒已經消退。
The apyrexial patient was allowed to go home. 無熱（或退熱期中）的患者被允許回家。
He monitored the apyrexial phase of the disease. 他監測了該疾病的無熱階段。
The onset of apyrexy was a good sign for the recovery. 退熱的開始是康復的好兆頭。
Doctors observed a sudden apyrexy in the patient. 醫生觀察到患者突然退熱。
The archive kept an apyrotype plate in a box. 檔案室把一塊非高溫印相版收在盒子裡。
The museum displayed an apyrotype print from the 1800s. 博物館展出了一張十九世紀的非高溫印相。

meaning: 耐火的；耐高溫的；不可燃的
sentences: Asbestos is an apyrous material. 石棉是一種耐火材料。
The apyrous nature of the substance makes it useful for insulation. 該物質的耐火性質使其可用於絕緣。

meaning: 一種顏色，通常是藍色和綠色的混合，類似綠松石色。
sentences: The term aqua refers to a shade of colour, usually a mix of blue and green similar to the colour turquoise. 水綠色一詞指的是一種顏色，通常是藍色和綠色的混合，類似於綠松石。
The lesson introduced aqua as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了水作為一個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 水上芭蕾女明星；水中美女
sentences: The aquabelle performed a stunning routine in the pool. 那位水中美女在泳池中表演了令人驚嘆的節目。
She dreamed of becoming a famous aquabelle. 她夢想成為一名著名的水上芭蕾明星。
As an aquabib, he never touches alcohol. 作為一個只喝水的人，他從不碰酒。
He was the only aquabib at the rowdy party. 他是那場喧鬧派對上唯一一個不喝酒的人。

meaning: 水上表演；水上芭蕾表演
sentences: Thousands of people attended the grand aquacade. 成千上萬的人參加了這場盛大的水上表演。
The city's annual aquacade features synchronized swimming and diving. 該市一年一度的水上表演以花樣游泳和跳水為特色。
The government promotes aquacultural development in coastal areas. 政府在沿海地區推廣水產養殖發展。
They studied the aquacultural practices of the local farmers. 他們研究了當地農民的水產養殖做法。

meaning: 水生植物、魚類、其他水生動物等水產品養殖。
sentences: The term aquaculture refers to the cultivation of aquatic produce such as aquatic plants, fish, and other aquatic animals. 水產養殖是指水生植物、魚類和其他水生動物等水產的養殖。
The lesson introduced aquaculture as a useful term to understand. 本課程介紹了水產養殖這個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: （中世紀）洗手水罐（通常為動物形狀）
sentences: A bronze aquaemanale in the shape of a lion was on display. 展示著一個獅子形狀的青銅洗手水罐。
Aquaemanale vessels were common in medieval noble households. 在中世紀貴族家庭中，洗手水罐是很常見的。
The aquafortist spent months on a single copper plate. 那位蝕刻家在一個銅版上花了幾個月的時間。
He is considered one of the finest aquafortists of his time. 他被認為是那個時代最優秀的蝕刻家之一。
The farmers were concerned about the blockage in the aquage. 農民們擔心水道堵塞。
They had to pay a small aquage for using the irrigation system. 他們必須為使用灌溉系統支付少量水費。
The room was painted in a soothing aquagreen color. 房間被漆成令人放鬆的水綠色。
She wore an aquagreen dress to the party. 她穿著一件水綠色的連衣裙去參加聚會。
She wore a beautiful aquamarine necklace. 她戴著一條漂亮的海藍寶石項鍊。
The tropical sea was a brilliant aquamarine. 熱帶海洋呈現出燦爛的水藍色。
The aquameter showed that the water consumption was increasing. 量水表顯示用水量正在增加。
They installed an aquameter to monitor the flow of the river. 他們安裝了一個測水計來監測河流的流量。

meaning: 滑水板；（飛機或車輛）在水面滑行
sentences: He enjoyed riding the aquaplane behind the speedboat. 他喜歡在快艇後面玩滑水板。
The car began to aquaplane on the wet highway. 汽車開始在潮濕的高速公路上發生水漂（滑行）。
Aquapuncture is a technique used in veterinary medicine. 液針是獸醫學中使用的一種技術。
The therapist recommended aquapuncture for the back pain. 治療師建議針對背痛進行液針治療。
The museum has a collection of 19th-century aquarelles. 博物館收藏了一批 19 世紀的水彩畫。
She mastered the delicate technique of aquarelle. 她掌握了精細的水彩畫技法。
The famous aquarellist captured the light of the landscape perfectly. 那位著名的水彩畫家完美地捕捉了風景的光影。
He worked as an aquarellist for many years. 他擔任水彩畫家多年。

meaning: 水族館；養魚缸（aquarium 的複數形式）
sentences: The city has several large aquaria for public visit. 該市有幾個大型水族館供公眾參觀。
They maintain multiple aquaria in their research facility. 他們在研究設施中維護多個水族缸。
The aquarial display included rare species of jellyfish. 水族展示包括了稀有品種的水母。
He is an expert in aquarial management. 他是水族管理方面的專家。

meaning: 水瓶座的；寶瓶宮的；水瓶座的人
sentences: As an Aquarian, she is known for her independent spirit. 作為水瓶座的人，她以獨立精神聞名。
The Aquarian age is said to be a time of great change. 據說水瓶座時代是一個發生巨大變化的時代。
The school project focused on aquarian life. 學校項目專注於水族生物。
He enjoys visiting aquarian parks during the summer. 他喜歡在夏天參觀水族公園。

meaning: 【天】寶瓶座流星群的一顆流星
sentences: The Aquarid meteor shower is visible in early May. 寶瓶座流星雨在五月初清晰可見。
Astronomers tracked the path of a single Aquarid. 天文學家追踪了一顆寶瓶座流星的軌跡。
Aquarii shone faintly above the desert. 寶瓶座的恆星在沙漠上空微微發亮。
The astronomer marked Aquarii on the sky chart. 天文學家在星圖上標出了寶瓶座的恆星。

meaning: 水族愛好者；水族館工作人員
sentences: The experienced aquariist gave us advice on caring for goldfish. 那位經驗豐富的水族愛好者給了我們照顧金魚的建議。
He works as an aquariist at the National Museum. 他在國家博物館擔任水族技術員。
The kids enjoyed seeing the exotic fish at the city aquarium. 孩子們很喜歡在城市水族館看那些外來魚類。
We saw several small sharks swimming in the tropical aquarium. 我們在熱帶水族館看到幾隻小鯊魚在游動。
Aquarius is the eleventh sign of the zodiac. 寶瓶座是黃道十二宮的第十一宮。
The sun enters Aquarius in late January. 太陽在元月下旬進入寶瓶座。
The enemy ship was spotted aquarter. 在側後方發現了敵船。
The wind blew strongly from aquarter. 風從船尾部強勁地吹來。

meaning: （品牌名）雅格獅丹；（泛指）防水風衣
sentences: He wore an Aquascutum coat to protect himself from the rain. 他穿著一件雅格獅丹大衣（或防水風衣）來擋雨。
The company Aquascutum is known for its trench coats. 雅格獅丹公司以其風衣聞名。
The aquarium displays many rare species of aquatic plants and animals. 水族館展示了許多稀有的水生動植物品種。
Swimming and water polo are popular aquatic sports. 游泳和水球是受歡迎的水上運動。
The lake is home to many aquatical plants. 這個湖泊是許多水生植物的家園。
He is an expert in aquatical biology. 他是水生生物學專家。
Some animals live aquatically for part of their lives. 某些動物生命中的一部分時間生活在水中。
The spores are dispersed aquatically. 孢子是通過水傳播的。
The scientist studied various aquatile species in the river. 科學家研究了河流中的各種水生特有物種。
Turtles are partly aquatile creatures. 烏龜是部分水生的生物。

meaning: 【藝】（銅版畫的）色調蝕刻法；色調蝕刻畫
sentences: The artist combined etching and aquatint in his work. 藝術家在他的作品中結合了蝕刻與色調蝕刻法。
He learned how to aquatint a metal plate. 他學會了如何對金屬板進行色調蝕刻。
Aquatinta creates a range of tonal values in prints. 色調蝕刻法在印相中創造了一系列的色調值。
The book features several beautiful aquatinta illustrations. 這本書有幾幅美麗的色調蝕刻插圖。
The aquatinter was famous for his landscape prints. 那位色調蝕刻家以其風景印畫聞名。
She works as a professional aquatinter and etcher. 她擔任專業的色調蝕刻家和蝕刻師。
The process of aquation was studied in the chemistry lab. 在化學實驗室研究了水合作用的過程。
Aquation involves the substitution of a ligand by water. 配位水化作用涉及配體被水取代。

meaning: （罕用，可能指）對水的傾向或喜愛
sentences: The plant's aquativeness allows it to thrive in wet soil. 該植物對水的喜愛使其能在潮濕土壤中茂盛生長。
He noted the aquativeness of the local wildlife. 他注意到了當地野生動物對水的依賴性。
The high-quality images were produced using aquatone. 高品質的影像是使用膠版照相凹板印刷術產生的。
He is a technician specialized in aquatone printing. 他是一位專門從事膠版照相凹板印刷的技術員。

meaning: 【化】（罕用）與水等價的；等水價的
sentences: The researcher discussed the aquavalent properties of the elements. 研究人員討論了元素的等水價屬性。
They conducted an experiment to determine the aquavalent ratio. 他們進行了一項實驗來確定等水價比例。
Aquavit is a popular spirit in Scandinavian countries. 阿誇維特（生命之水）是斯堪地那維亞國家受歡迎的烈酒。
They toasted each other with small glasses of chilled aquavit. 他們用裝滿冰鎮阿誇維特的小杯子互相敬酒。

meaning: 導水管；引水渠；【解】導水管
sentences: The ancient Romans built impressive aqueducts to carry water to cities. 古羅馬人建造了令人印象深刻的引水渠，將水輸送到城市。
The cerebral aqueduct is a narrow channel in the brain. 中腦導水管是腦部的一條狹窄通道。
Aqueoglacial deposits are found in areas once covered by glaciers. 在曾被冰河覆蓋的地區發現了冰水沉積物。
He studied the aqueoglacial landscape of Northern Europe. 他研究了北歐的冰水地貌。

meaning: 【地】水火成因的；水熱作用形成的
sentences: Aqueoigneous rocks were formed by the action of both water and heat. 水火成因岩石是由水和熱共同作用形成的。
The mineral has an aqueoigneous origin. 該礦物具有水熱成因。
The aqueomercurial solution was used as an early disinfectant. 含水汞溶液曾被用作早期消毒劑。
He analyzed the components of the aqueomercurial mixture. 他分析了含水汞混合物的成分。
An aqueous solution is one in which the solvent is water. 水溶液是指溶劑為水的溶液。
The aqueous humor is the clear fluid inside the eye. 水樣液是眼睛內部的透明流體。
The teacher gave one simple sentence with aqueously. 老師用這個副詞舉了一個簡單句子。
She marked aqueously in her notebook after class. 她下課後把這個副詞記在筆記本裡。
The aqueousness of the mixture made it difficult to handle. 混合物的含水性質使其難以處理。
Scientists measured the aqueousness of the lunar soil. 科學家測量了月球土壤的含水量。
Aquicolous insects are adapted to life in ponds and streams. 水棲昆蟲適應了池塘和溪流中的生活。
He studied the behavior of various aquicolous organisms. 他研究了各種水棲生物的行為。
The region has great potential for aquicultural expansion. 該地區在水產養殖擴張方面有巨大潛力。
Aquicultural experts are working to improve fish health. 水產養殖專家正致力於改善魚類健康。
Aquiculture is becoming an increasingly important source of food. 水產養殖正成為日益重要的食物來源。
The farm uses aquiculture to grow both fish and vegetables. 該農場利用水產養殖同時飼養魚類和種植蔬菜。
As an aquiculturist, she specializes in shrimp farming. 作為一名水產養殖專家，她專門從事蝦類養殖。
The aquiculturist monitored the water quality daily. 水產養殖專家每天監測水質。

meaning: 地下的含水多孔石頭、泥土或礫石層。
sentences: The village well tapped a deep aquifer beneath the rocks. 村裡的井汲取了岩層下方深處的含水層。
A dry summer can lower the aquifer faster than expected. 乾旱的夏天會讓含水層下降得比預期更快。
The aquifer is an aquiferous layer of rock that stores groundwater. 含水層是儲存地下水的含水岩層。
They mapped the aquiferous channels beneath the desert. 他們繪製了沙漠下方的導水通道圖。
The holly tree belongs to the family Aquifoliaceae. 冬青樹屬於冬青科。
Aquifoliaceae consists of several genera of shrubs and trees. 冬青科包含幾個屬的灌木和樹木。
Aquifoliaceous plants are often used for holiday decorations. 冬青科植物常用於節日裝飾。
He identified several aquifoliaceous species in the forest. 他在森林中鑑定出了幾種冬青科物種。
The substance has an aquiform consistency. 該物質具有水狀的稠度。
He observed the aquiform discharge from the pipe. 他觀察到管道中排出的水狀物。
Aquila is a constellation on the celestial equator. 天鷹座是天球赤道上的一個星座。
The Golden Eagle belongs to the genus Aquila. 金雕屬於雕屬。
Aquilaria trees are the primary source of agarwood. 沉香屬樹木是沉香的主要來源。
The resin from Aquilaria is highly valued in perfumery. 來自沉香屬的樹脂在香水業中價值極高。
Aquilawood has been used for incense for centuries. 沉香（或稱鷹木）作為熏香已有數世紀的歷史。
He collected rare samples of aquilawood during his travels. 他在旅行期間收集了稀有的沉香樣本。
The aquilege was responsible for maintaining the village's water supply. 引水者負責維護村莊的供水。
An ancient aquilege system was discovered near the ruins. 在遺跡附近發現了一個古代的集水系統。
Aquilegia is a genus of perennial plants with distinctive spurred flowers. 耬斗菜屬是具有獨特距狀花朵的多年生植物屬。
Columbine is a common name for plants in the genus Aquilegia. 耬斗菜是耬斗菜屬植物的通稱。
The Aquilian law provided for compensation for damage to property. 阿奎利亞法規定了對財產損失的賠償。
He wrote a thesis on Aquilian liability in modern law. 他寫了一篇關於現代法律中阿奎利亞責任的論文。

meaning: 【天】天鷹座流星群的一顆流星
sentences: An Aquilid meteor streaked across the night sky. 一顆天鷹座流星劃過夜空。
The Aquilid shower peaks in mid-July. 天鷹座流星雨在七月中旬達到峰值。

meaning: 鷹的；像鷹的；（鼻子）鷹鉤狀的
sentences: The old man had a sharp, aquiline nose. 那位老人有一隻尖尖的鷹鉤鼻。
His aquiline features gave him a commanding appearance. 他那像鷹一樣的特徵使他顯得很有威嚴。

meaning: （義大利語/西班牙語）鷹的；像鷹的
sentences: The artist captured the aquilino profile of the statue. 藝術家捕捉了雕像那像鷹一樣的側面輪廓。
Aquilino is often used as a surname in Latin countries. Aquilino 在拉丁國家常被用作姓氏。
Certain species of birds are classified as aquincubital. 某些鳥類被歸類為缺第五次列羽的。
The researcher noted the aquincubital wing structure. 研究人員注意到了缺第五次列羽的翅膀結構。
Aquincubitalism is common among certain orders of birds. 缺第五次列羽的現象在某些目類的鳥類中很常見。
They discussed the evolutionary significance of aquincubitalism. 他們討論了缺第五次列羽現象的進化意義。

meaning: 阿奎那學派者（追隨聖多馬·阿奎那的哲學）
sentences: As an Aquinist, he studied the relationship between faith and reason. 作為一名阿奎那學派者，他研究了信仰與理性之間的關係。
The Aquinist philosophy has had a profound influence on the Church. 阿奎那哲學對教會產生了深遠的影響。
The aquintocubital condition is found in many large birds. 缺第五次列羽的狀況在許多大型鳥類中都有發現。
