meaning: 關節損傷；由於外力導致的關節傷害。
sentences: Athletes are particularly susceptible to various forms of arthrotrauma. 運動員特別容易受到各種形式的關節損傷。
Immediate care after arthrotrauma can prevent long-term complications. 關節損傷後的立即護理可以防止長期併發症。

meaning: 向關節的；對關節有親和力或趨向性的。
sentences: Certain viruses exhibit an arthrotropic behavior, targeting joint tissues. 某些病毒表現出向關節性，瞄準關節組織。
The researchers studied why the medication was specifically arthrotropic. 研究人員研究了為什麼該藥物具有特定的向關節性。

meaning: 關節型傷寒；伴有明顯關節症狀的傷寒。
sentences: Arthrotyphoid presents with standard typhoid symptoms plus joint pain. 關節型傷寒表現為標準傷寒症狀加上關節疼痛。
The rare case of arthrotyphoid was documented in the medical journal. 這例罕見的關節型傷寒被記錄在醫學期刊中。

meaning: 有節的；具有關節或節段的。
sentences: The arthrous structure of the appendage allows for a wide range of motion. 該附肢的有節結構允許大範圍的運動。
Most arthropods have an arthrous body plan. 大多數節肢動物都有有節的身體構造。

meaning: 關節乾燥症；關節液減少導致的乾燥狀況。
sentences: Arthroxerosis can lead to increased friction and wear within the joint. 關節乾燥症可能導致關節內摩擦和磨損增加。
Injectable lubricants can help patients suffering from arthroxerosis. 注射用潤滑劑可以幫助患有關節乾燥症的患者。

meaning: 關節動物類；一個過時的生物分類，包含節肢動物和某些蠕蟲。
sentences: Arthrozoa was a term used by early naturalists for segmented animals. 關節動物類是早期博物學家用來描述分節動物的術語。
Modern biology has largely abandoned the classification of Arthrozoa. 現代生物學在很大程度上已經放棄了關節動物類的分類。

meaning: 關節動物；屬於關節動物門（已廢棄）的動物。
sentences: The scientist described the creature as an arthrozoan due to its segmented body. 科學家因其分節的身體而將該生物描述為關節動物。
Ancient classifications often placed insects in the arthrozoan group. 古代的分類法常將昆蟲歸入關節動物類。

meaning: 關節動物的；與關節動物有關的。
sentences: Arthrozoic characteristics can be observed in various fossilized remains. 在各種化石殘骸中可以觀察到關節動物的特徵。
The biology teacher explained the importance of arthrozoic body plans. 生物老師解釋了關節動物體型構造的重要性。

meaning: 亞瑟；人名，也指著名的亞瑟王。
sentences: King Arthur is a legendary British leader of the late 5th and early 6th centuries. 亞瑟王是五世紀末到六世紀初傳說中的不列顛領袖。
Arthur is a common name in many English-speaking countries. 亞瑟在許多英語國家是一個常見的名字。

meaning: 亞瑟王的；關於亞瑟王及其傳說的。
sentences: She has a deep interest in Arthurian legends and the Knights of the Round Table. 她對亞瑟王傳說和圓桌武士有著濃厚的興趣。
Many Arthurian stories focus on themes of chivalry and honor. 許多亞瑟王的故事都集中在騎士精神和榮譽的主題上。

meaning: 亞瑟王文獻；關於亞瑟王傳說的文學、藝術或文物的集合。
sentences: The shelf held rare Arthuriana. 架子上放著罕見的亞瑟王文獻。
She spent years collecting Arthuriana about Camelot. 她花了好幾年收集關於卡美洛的亞瑟王文獻。

meaning: 偶價元素；化合價為偶數的化學元素。
sentences: In chemistry, an artiad is an element with an even valency. 在化學中，偶價元素是指化合價為偶數的元素。
Oxygen is a well-known example of an artiad. 氧是偶價元素的一個著名例子。
She prepared a delicious dip with steamed artichoke and garlic. 她用蒸熟的朝鮮薊和蒜泥調製了一份美味的沾醬。
Artichokes are a popular ingredient in many Mediterranean dishes. 朝鮮薊是許多地中海料理中常用的食材。
I'm reading a very interesting article about artificial intelligence. 我正在讀一篇關於人工智慧的有趣文章。
The magazine published an article on the benefits of regular exercise. 該雜誌發表了一篇關於定期運動益處的文章。

meaning: 受契約束縛的；（通常指見習生）簽訂實習契約的。
sentences: He worked as an articled clerk for a prestigious law firm. 他在一家知名法律事務所擔任實習助理。
An articled apprentice must complete several years of training. 受實習契約束縛的學徒必須完成幾年的培訓。

meaning: 可清晰發音性；能被明確表達的可能性。
sentences: The articulability of the phonemes is crucial for clear speech. 音素的可清晰發音性對於清晰的說話至關重要。
The speaker's poor articulability made it hard to follow the presentation. 演講者糟糕的表達能力使得人們很難聽懂他的報告。

meaning: 可清晰發音的；可以用言語表達的。
sentences: Some emotions are so complex they are barely articulable. 有些情緒如此複雜，幾乎無法用言語表達。
The main points of the argument should be clearly articulable. 論點的主旨應該能夠被清晰地表達出來。
Her articulacy and confidence made her a great political leader. 她的口才和自信使她成為一位偉大的政治領袖。
Articulacy is a highly valued skill in many professional fields. 在許多專業領域中，流利的表達能力是一項備受重視的技能。

meaning: 發音者；發出聲音的人或物。
sentences: The teacher carefully corrected each articulant in the language lab. 老師在語言實驗室仔細糾正了每位發音者的發音。
As an articulant, one must be aware of tongue placement. 作為發音者，必須注意舌頭的位置。
The patient complained of articular pain in her knees. 患者主訴膝關節疼痛。
The surgeon repaired the damaged articular surface. 外科醫生修復了受損的關節面。

meaning: 關節點；在解剖學中指下頜骨的一個測量點。
sentences: The orthodontist identified the articulare on the patient's X-ray. 齒列矯正醫生在患者的 X 光片上標出了關節點。
The articulare is used in cephalometric analysis. 關節點被用於頭影測量分析中。
The skeletal structure was articularly complex. 骨骼結構在關節連接方面非常複雜。
He spoke articularly so that everyone in the back could hear him. 他說話發音清晰，以便後面的每個人都能聽到。
The articulary cartilage acts as a cushion for the bones. 關節軟骨起到了骨骼緩衝墊的作用。
Arthritis can lead to articulary degeneration over time. 隨著時間的推移，關節炎可能導致關節退化。

meaning: 有鉸類；腕足動物的一個類群，也指某些海百合。
sentences: The Articulata is a large and diverse group of brachiopods. 有鉸類是腕足動物中一個大而多樣的群體。
Fossil evidence of Articulata is abundant in many geological layers. 有鉸類的化石證據在許多地層中都很豐富。

meaning: 口齒清晰的、清晰地表達
sentences: She is a very articulate speaker who can present her ideas clearly and logically. 她是一位口齒清晰的演講者，能邏輯清晰地表達想法。
It can be difficult to articulate your feelings when you are under a lot of stress. 壓力大時可能很難清晰地表達自己的感受。

meaning: 鉸接的；有關節連接的；發音清晰的。
sentences: The city uses articulated buses to carry more passengers. 這座城市使用鉸接式公車以載運更多乘客。
She gave an articulated and well-reasoned response. 她給出了一個發音清晰且理由充足的回答。

meaning: 清晰地表達地；發音明確地。
sentences: He was able to explain his ideas very articulately. 他能夠非常清晰地表達他的想法。
The actor spoke his lines slowly and articulately. 這位演員緩慢且清晰地說出他的台詞。
Her articulateness was impressive during the debate. 在辯論中，她的表達能力令人印象深刻。
Articulateness is a key trait of successful public speakers. 表達清晰是成功的公共演講者的一個關鍵特徵。

meaning: 某物透過鉸接或鉸接以進行彎曲的接頭或接頭集合。
sentences: The articulation allowed the robot to move around corners. 這種關節允許機器人在角落處移動。
The term articulation refers to A joint or the collection of joints at which something is articulated, or hinged, for bending. 術語「關節」是指關節或關節的集合，在該關節或關節處，物體被鉸接或鉸接以進行彎曲。

meaning: 發音學家；研究發音或清晰表達的人。
sentences: The articulationist provided valuable tips for improving the students' speech. 發音學家為提高學生的演講水平提供了寶貴的建議。
As an articulationist, she focused on the mechanics of sound production. 作為一名發音學家，她專注於聲音產生的機制。
The tongue is one of the primary articulative organs. 舌頭是主要的發音器官之一。
He struggled with certain articulative movements of the jaw. 他難以完成下頜的某些發音動作。
The lips and teeth function as articulators during speech. 唇和齒在說話時充當發音器官。
The dentist used an articulator to align the dental crowns. 牙醫使用咬合架來對齊牙冠。

meaning: 發音的；關於發音器官的。
sentences: Articulatory phonetics studies how humans produce speech sounds. 發音語音學研究人類如何產生言語聲音。
She had an articulatory impairment that made some sounds difficult. 她有發音障礙，使得某些發音變得很困難。

meaning: 可彎曲砂岩；一種具有柔韌性的石英岩。
sentences: The quarry yielded a slab of articulite that bent under pressure. 採石場出產了一塊受力會彎曲的可彎曲砂岩。
The sample of articulite flexed like stone with a secret hinge. 那塊可彎曲砂岩樣本彎起來時，像藏著隱形鉸鏈的石頭。

meaning: 節節；微小的關節或節段。
sentences: Each articulus of the microscopic organism was perfectly formed. 微生物的每個節節都形成得很完美。
The scientist examined the structure of the tiny articulus. 科學家檢查了這個微小節節的結構。
Artie waited by the bus stop. 那位名叫阿蒂的人站在公車站旁等著。
The note was addressed to Artie. 那張便條是寫給阿蒂的。

meaning: 具有考古或歷史意義的物體，例如工具、裝飾品或武器，特別是在考古發掘中發現的物體。
sentences: The dig produced many Roman artifacts. 這次挖掘出土了許多羅馬文物。

The term artifact refers to an object, such as a tool, ornament, or weapon of archaeological or historical interest, especially such an object found at an archaeological excavation. 術語「人工製品」是指具有考古或歷史意義的物體，例如工具、裝飾品或武器，尤其是在考古發掘中發現的物體。

meaning: 人造的；非天然的（較少見的用法）。
sentences: The researcher identified several artifactitious elements in the sample. 研究人員在樣本中鑑定出幾種人造元素。
The data showed some artifactitious spikes due to equipment interference. 數據顯示由於設備干擾而出現了一些人造的峰值。
The magician's performance was full of clever artifice. 魔術師的表演充滿了聰明的詭計。
He used every artifice he could think of to win the game. 他用盡了他能想到的每一種巧計來贏得比賽。
The skilled artificer created a beautiful watch from scratch. 這位技藝精湛的工匠從頭開始製作了一隻漂亮的手錶。
In the past, an artificer was highly respected for their technical knowledge. 在過去，工匠因其技術知識而備受尊重。
His masterly artificership was evident in the intricate carvings. 他精湛的技藝在複雜的雕刻中顯而易見。
The guild promotes excellence in artificership among its members. 該公會致力於提升其成員在工藝方面的卓越表現。
Artificial intelligence is becoming more and more advanced nowadays. 人工智慧（人造的）現今正變得日益先進。
The garden was decorated with beautiful colorful artificial flowers. 花園裡裝飾著美麗繽紛的人造花。
The lifeguard performed artificial respiration on the drowning swimmer. 救生員對溺水的泳者進行了人工呼吸。
Learning how to perform artificial respiration is an essential first-aid skill. 學習如何進行人工呼吸是一項必不可少的急救技能。

meaning: 人造論；（心理學）認為所有自然現象都是人類或神靈創造的觀點。
sentences: In developmental psychology, artificialism is common in young children. 在發展心理學中，人造論在幼兒中很常見。
Artificialism leads some people to view nature through a man-made lens. 人造論使一些人透過人為的視角來看待自然。
The artificiality of the plastic plants was quite obvious. 這些塑膠植物的人造感非常明顯。
She disliked the artificiality of modern social media interactions. 她不喜歡現代社交媒體互動中的虛偽感。

meaning: 使人工化；使變得不自然。
sentences: Excessive editing can artificialize a photograph. 過度的編輯會使照片顯得不自然。
The architect tried not to artificialize the landscape too much. 建築師試圖不要過度使景觀人工化。

meaning: 通過或由於人類的努力。
sentences: The teacher gave one simple sentence with artificially. 老師用這個副詞舉了一個簡單句子。
She marked artificially in her notebook after class. 她下課後把這個副詞記在筆記本裡。
The artificialness of the lighting made the room feel cold. 燈光的人工感使房間顯得陰冷。
There was a certain artificialness in his smile. 他的笑容中帶有一種不自然的感覺。
The artiller carefully aimed the heavy cannon at the target. 砲兵仔細地將重砲對準目標。
He served as an artiller during the great war. 他在戰爭期間擔任砲兵。
The artillerist was an expert in calculating shell trajectories. 砲兵專家是計算彈道軌跡的專家。
Experienced artillerists are essential for modern military operations. 經驗豐富的砲兵專家對於現代軍事行動至關重要。

meaning: 大型彈射武器，在現代使用中通常是大型火砲，但也有火箭砲。
sentences: The term artillery refers to large projectile weapons, in modern usage usually large guns, but also rocket artillery. 火砲一詞指的是大型彈射武器，在現代用法中通常是大型火砲，但也包括火箭。
The lesson introduced artillery as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了火砲作為一個需要理解的有用術語。
The artilleryman stood ready at his station. 砲兵在他的崗位上準備就緒。
Being an artilleryman requires both physical strength and technical skill. 成為一名砲兵既需要體力也需要技術技能。
The soldiers practiced their artilleryship daily. 士兵們每天練習他們的砲術。
His superior artilleryship helped win the battle. 他卓越的砲術幫助贏得了戰鬥。

meaning: 裝作有藝術品味的；附庸風雅的特質。
sentences: The cafe's artiness felt a bit forced and pretentious. 這家咖啡館的藝術氣息讓人覺得有點刻意且自命不凡。
She criticized the artiness of the new fashion collection. 她批評了新時裝系列中附庸風雅的特質。

meaning: 水鎂石；一種含水的鎂碳酸鹽礦物。
sentences: Artinite crystals are typically white and fibrous. 水鎂石晶體通常是白色且呈纖維狀的。
The museum's mineral collection includes a rare specimen of artinite. 該博物館的礦石收藏中包含一件罕見的水鎂石標本。

meaning: 阿丁斯克階；二疊紀的一個地質年代階。
sentences: The Artinskian stage is known for its diverse marine fossils. 阿丁斯克階以其多樣的海洋化石而聞名。
Geologists studied the Artinskian layers in the Ural Mountains. 地質學家研究了烏拉爾山脈的阿丁斯克階地層。
A deer is a common example of an artiodactyl. 鹿是偶蹄類動物的一個常見例子。
Artiodactyls have an even number of toes on each foot. 偶蹄類動物每隻腳上有偶數個腳趾。

meaning: 偶蹄目；包含豬、牛、鹿、駱駝等的哺乳動物目。
sentences: The order Artiodactyla includes many economically important species. 偶蹄目包括許多具有經濟重要性的物種。
Cows and sheep both belong to the Artiodactyla order. 牛和羊都屬於偶蹄目。
Artiodactylous mammals are found on almost every continent. 幾乎每個大陸都有偶蹄類哺乳動物。
The fossil shows clearly artiodactylous limbs. 該化石顯示出明顯的偶蹄類肢體。

meaning: 具關節葉的；葉片具關節的。
sentences: The botanist identified the plant as artiphyllous. 植物學家將該植物鑑定為具關節葉的。
Artiphyllous structures are found in some fern species. 在一些蕨類植物中發現了具關節葉的結構。
The artisan made each bowl by hand. 那位工匠手工製作了每一個碗。
Visitors watched an artisan carve wood in the market. 遊客在市場裡看著一位手藝人雕刻木頭。
The fine artisanship of the leather bag is evident. 這皮包精湛的工藝顯而易見。
Traditional artisanship is being preserved by local craftsmen. 傳統技藝正由當地工匠保存下來。
She is a very talented artist who paints beautiful landscapes. 她是一位非常有才華的藝術家，畫出的風景畫非常漂亮。
The museum has a large collection of works by local artists. 博物館收藏了大量當地藝術家的作品。

meaning: 藝術家界；藝術家的身分。
sentences: He aspired to enter the realm of artistdom. 他渴望進入藝術家之林。
Artistdom often brings both great creativity and financial uncertainty. 藝術家的身分往往既帶來巨大的創造力，也帶來經濟上的不穩定。
The circus featured a talented trapese artiste. 馬戲團有一位才華橫溢的空中飛人藝人。
She is a true artiste who takes her craft very seriously. 她是一位真正的藝人，對自己的手藝非常認真。
She has a very artistic personality and loves painting and music. 她性格非常有藝術氣息，喜愛繪畫與音樂。
The city center is famous for its unique and artistic architecture. 市中心以其獨特且具藝術感的建築聞名。
The room was decorated in an artistical manner. 房間裝飾得非常有藝術感。
She has a very artistical temperament. 她非常有藝術氣息。
The photographs were artistically arranged on the wall. 牆上的照片排列得非常有藝術感。
He designed the website to be both functional and artistically pleasing. 他將網站設計得既實用又具有藝術美感。
The pianist's artistry left the audience in awe. 鋼琴家的藝術技巧讓觀眾驚嘆不已。
The film was praised for its visual artistry. 這部電影因其視覺藝術性而受到稱讚。

meaning: 單純的；自然的；不詭詐的。
sentences: The child's artless questions often made her smile. 孩子純真的問題常讓她微笑。
He admired her artless beauty and simple lifestyle. 他欣賞她自然的姿色和簡單的生活方式。
She spoke so artlessly that everyone believed her. 她說話如此純真，以至於每個人都相信她。
He artlessly admitted to his mistake. 他很自然地承認了自己的錯誤。
There was an appealing artlessness in her behavior. 她的行為中有一種吸引人的純真。
His artlessness made him vulnerable in the world of politics. 他的天真使他在政治世界中顯得脆弱。
The shelf was decorated with several charming artlets. 架子上裝飾著幾件迷人的小藝術品。
He collects unique artlets from his travels around the world. 他從世界各地的旅行中收集獨特的小藝術品。

meaning: 像藝術的；具有藝術特徵的。
sentences: The sunset created an artlike scene over the ocean. 日落在大海上營造出如藝術般的景象。
The intricate patterns on the butterfly wings are truly artlike. 蝴蝶翅膀上複雜的圖案確實像藝術品一樣。

meaning: 桑科（波羅蜜科）；植物分類名。
sentences: Artocarpaceae is a family of flowering plants that includes breadfruit. 桑科（波羅蜜科）是一個包含麵包果在內的開花植物科。
Botanists study the diverse species within the Artocarpaceae family. 植物學家研究桑科（波羅蜜科）內的多樣物種。

meaning: 桑科植物；屬於桑科的人。
sentences: An artocarpad is any member of the Artocarpaceae family. 桑科植物是指桑科中的任何成員。
The scientist categorized the tropical tree as an artocarpad. 科學家將這棵熱帶樹木歸類為桑科植物。

meaning: 桑科的；類似波羅蜜屬的。
sentences: The teacher used artocarpeous to describe the example. 老師用「桑科」來描述這個例子。
She chose an artocarpeous example for class. 她選了一個「桑科」的課堂例子。
Many tropical regions are home to artocarpous trees. 許多熱帶地區是結波羅蜜類果實樹木的家園。
The artocarpous fruit is a staple food in some cultures. 波羅蜜類果實是某些文化中的主食。

meaning: 波羅蜜屬；植物的一個屬，包含波羅蜜和麵包果。
sentences: Artocarpus heterophyllus is the scientific name for jackfruit. Artocarpus heterophyllus 是波羅蜜的學名。
Trees in the genus Artocarpus are widely cultivated for their fruit and timber. 波羅蜜屬的樹木因其果實和木材而被廣泛栽培。

meaning: 崇拜麵包者；聖餐崇拜者。
sentences: An artolater is one who worships the eucharistic bread. 崇拜麵包者是指崇拜聖餐麵包的人。
The term artolater was sometimes used in religious controversies. 崇拜麵包者一詞有時被用於宗教爭議中。
The diet of the monks was largely artophagous. 僧侶們的飲食主要是以麵包為食的。
Ancient texts describe certain groups as being artophagous. 古代文獻將某些群體描述為以麵包為食的。

meaning: 聖餅盒；存放聖餐麵包的容器。
sentences: The priest carefully placed the bread back into the artophorion. 牧師小心地將麵包放回聖餅盒中。
The artophorion was beautifully decorated with gold and silver. 聖餅盒裝飾著精美的金銀。

meaning: 珂羅版；一種照相平版印刷法。
sentences: An artotype can produce high-quality reproductions of photographs. 珂羅版可以產生高品質的照片複製件。
The vintage book featured several beautiful artotype plates. 這本老書裡有幾張精美的珂羅版插圖。
Artotypy was a popular method for printing fine art in the 19th century. 珂羅版印刷術是19世紀印刷精美藝術品的流行方法。
He specialized in the difficult process of artotypy. 他專攻難度很高的珂羅版印刷術。

meaning: 麵包乳酪派；早期基督教的一個異端教派，在聖餐中使用麵包和乳酪。
sentences: The Artotyrites were a 2nd-century Christian sect. 麵包乳酪派是2世紀的一個基督教教派。
Historians study the unique rituals of the Artotyrite group. 歷史學家研究麵包乳酪派團體獨特的儀式。
The festival celebrates the performing arts, including theater and dance. 這個節日慶祝表演藝術，包括戲劇與舞蹈。
He is currently a student at the university's Faculty of Arts. 他目前是該大學文學院（人文科學院）的學生。
The shop sells a variety of local artware and pottery. 這家店出售各種當地的手工藝品和陶器。
Fine artware can be both beautiful and functional. 精美的手工藝品可以既美觀又實用。
The museum's collection includes many original artworks by famous artists. 博物館的收藏包含許多知名藝術家的原創藝術品。
She spent months creating a beautiful piece of digital artwork. 她花了幾個月時間創作出一件漂亮的數位藝術品。

meaning: 附庸風雅的；藝術氣息濃厚的（通常帶有貶義）。
sentences: The neighborhood has become very arty and expensive. 這個社區變得藝術氣息濃厚且房價昂貴。
He wears arty glasses to look more like an intellectual. 他戴著附庸風雅的眼鏡，想讓自己看起來更像個知識分子。

meaning: 阿魯；地名，如印尼的阿魯群島。
sentences: The Aru Islands are known for their unique biodiversity. 阿魯群島以其獨特的生物多樣性而聞名。
He spent the summer researching birds in Aru. 他整個夏天都在阿魯研究鳥類。

meaning: 阿拉瓦克人；南美洲的一個印第安民族。
sentences: The Aruac people traditionally inhabit parts of South America and the Caribbean. 阿拉瓦克人傳統上居住在南美洲和加勒比海的部分地區。
Aruac languages are a major family of indigenous American languages. 阿拉瓦克語系是美洲土著語言的一個主要語系。

meaning: 蠻羊；一種北非的野生羊類。
sentences: The arui is also known as the Barbary sheep. 蠻羊也被稱為北非髯羊。
Arui are well-adapted to the rocky and arid terrain of the Sahara. 蠻羊非常適應撒哈拉沙漠多岩石且乾旱的地形。

meaning: 一種植物名（較罕見或特定地區用法）。
sentences: The healer gathered aruke leaves at dawn. 藥草師在清晨採集阿魯克葉子。
A patch of aruke grew near the stream. 溪邊長著一片阿魯克。
Arulo is a less common surname in this region. 阿魯洛在這個地區是一個較不常見的姓氏。
The village of Arulo is located deep in the mountains. 阿魯洛村位於大山深處。

meaning: 天南星屬；一類具有佛焰苞的植物。
sentences: The Arum lily is a popular choice for gardens. 天南星百合是花園的熱門選擇。
Be careful, as some species of Arum can be toxic if ingested. 要小心，因為某些種類的天南星屬植物如果誤食可能有毒。

meaning: 鋁銀合金；一種特定的合金名稱（較舊或特定用途）。
sentences: Arumin was used in the manufacturing of lightweight instruments. 鋁銀合金曾被用於製造輕量化儀器。
The scientist analyzed the composition of the arumin sample. 科學家分析了這件鋁銀合金樣本的成分。

meaning: 假升麻屬；植物的一個屬，如山羊鬍子。
sentences: Aruncus dioicus is commonly known as goat's beard. Aruncus dioicus 通常被稱為山羊鬍子。
The tall white plumes of Aruncus add beauty to the shady garden. 假升麻屬高大的白色羽狀花序為遮陰花園增添了美感。

meaning: 產蘆葦的；具有蘆葦狀莖的。
sentences: The arundiferous marsh provided materials for making baskets. 這片產蘆葦的沼澤為編織籃子提供了材料。
Many arundiferous plants grow along the riverbanks. 許多具蘆葦狀莖的植物生長在河岸邊。
The grass has a distinct arundinaceous appearance. 這種草具有明顯的蘆葦狀外觀。
Arundinaceous stems are often hollow and strong. 蘆葦狀的莖通常是中空且強韌的。

meaning: 青籬竹屬；竹類的一個屬。
sentences: Arundinaria gigantea is the only bamboo native to North America. 青籬竹是唯一原產於北美的竹子。
Species of Arundinaria form dense thickets known as canebrakes. 青籬竹屬的物種形成稱為甘蔗林的密集灌叢。
The landscape was mostly arundineous near the lake. 湖泊附近的景觀大部分都是蘆葦叢生。
He used an arundineous pen for his calligraphy. 他使用一枝蘆葦筆練習書法。

meaning: 蘆竹屬；禾本科的一個屬。
sentences: Arundo donax is also known as giant cane. 蘆竹也被稱為大蘆葦。
The stems of Arundo are used to make reeds for woodwind instruments. 蘆竹的莖被用來製作木管樂器的簧片。

meaning: 阿蘭達人；澳洲的一個原住民族。
sentences: The Arunta people have a rich cultural and spiritual heritage. 阿蘭達人擁有豐富的文化和精神遺產。
Anthropologists have extensively studied the kinship systems of the Arunta. 人類學家廣泛研究了阿蘭達人的親屬制度。

meaning: 無色；（佛教）指無形狀或無物質的狀態。
sentences: The teacher used arupa to describe the example. 老師用「無色」來描述這個例子。
She chose an arupa example for class. 她選了一個「無色」的課堂例子。

meaning: 一種地名或民族名（如阿魯沙）。
sentences: The Arusa people are an ethnic group in East Africa. 阿魯沙人是東非的一個族群。
They traveled to the Arusa region to observe the local customs. 他們前往阿魯沙地區觀察當地習俗。

meaning: 阿魯沙；坦尚尼亞的一個城市。
sentences: Arusha is a major diplomatic hub in East Africa. 阿魯沙是東非的一個主要外交樞紐。
Many safaris to the Serengeti start from Arusha. 許多前往塞倫蓋提的野生動物探險都是從阿魯沙開始的。
The dry leaves were arustle in the autumn wind. 枯葉在秋風中發出沙沙聲。
The curtains were arustle as she opened the window. 當她打開窗戶時，窗簾沙沙作響。
The arval landscape was dotted with small farmhouses. 耕地的景觀中點綴著小農舍。
The ancient Arval Brothers were a college of priests in Rome. 古代的阿爾瓦兄弟會是羅馬的一個祭司團。

meaning: 葬禮宴會；葬禮（舊時用法）。
sentences: The arvel dinner was a tradition in some northern English villages. 葬禮宴會是英格蘭北部一些村莊的傳統。
They gathered for the arvel to honor their late grandfather. 他們聚集在一起參加葬禮宴會，以紀念已故的祖父。

meaning: 阿維爾尼人；古代高盧的一個強大部落。
sentences: The Arverni were led by Vercingetorix during the Gallic Wars. 阿維爾尼人在高盧戰爭期間由維欽托利領導。
The capital of the Arverni was Gergovia. 阿維爾尼人的首都是熱爾戈維亞。

meaning: 水鼠屬；囓齒目倉鼠科的一個屬。
sentences: Arvicola amphibius is commonly known as the European water vole. Arvicola amphibius 通常被稱為歐洲水鼠。
Members of the genus Arvicola are primarily semi-aquatic. 水鼠屬的成員主要是半水生的。

meaning: 田鼠；住在田間的囓齒動物。
sentences: The arvicole scurried through the tall grass of the meadow. 田鼠在草地的高草叢中疾走。
The arvicole population fluctuates with the seasons. 田鼠的數量隨著季節而波動。

meaning: 田鼠亞科；包含田鼠、旅鼠和麝鼠的亞科。
sentences: Arvicolinae is a diverse subfamily of rodents. 田鼠亞科是囓齒動物中一個多樣的亞科。
Researchers study the evolution and distribution of Arvicolinae. 研究人員研究田鼠亞科的演化和分佈。

meaning: 田鼠亞科的；類似田鼠的。
sentences: The fossils show distinct arvicoline dental patterns. 化石顯示出明顯的田鼠亞科牙齒模式。
Arvicoline rodents are important components of many ecosystems. 田鼠亞科囓齒動物是許多生態系統的重要組成部分。
Many arvicolous species are adapted to life in open grasslands. 許多生活在田野的物種都適應了在開闊草原上的生活。
The biologist studied the behavior of arvicolous birds. 生物學家研究了田野鳥類的行為。
The success of the civilization was based on advanced arviculture. 該文明的成功建立在先進的農耕基礎之上。
Improvements in arviculture led to a surplus of food. 農耕的進步導致了糧食盈餘。

meaning: 堡壘；（古羅馬）衛城或要塞。
sentences: The Roman arx was located on the Capitoline Hill. 羅馬衛城位於卡比托利歐山。
The arx served as a place of refuge and a religious center. 衛城作為避難所和宗教中心。

meaning: 任何一個（any 的方言或古語用法）。
sentences: He didn't have ary a coin in his pocket. 他口袋裡連一個硬幣都沒有。
I haven't seen ary soul all day. 我整天都沒見過任何一個人。

meaning: 雅利安；尊貴者；（梵文）高貴的。
sentences: The term Arya has complex historical and cultural meanings. 雅利安一詞具有複雜的歷史和文化意義。
Arya is a popular name in several different cultures today. 今天，雅利安在幾種不同的文化中都是一個受歡迎的名字。

meaning: 雅利安人；印歐語系的；雅利安語的。
sentences: The Aryan migration into India is a subject of ongoing debate. 雅利安人遷移到印度是一個持續辯論的話題。
The term Aryan was misappropriated by the Nazis in the 20th century. 雅利安一詞在20世紀被納粹分子盜用。

meaning: 雅利安主義；關於雅利安人優越性的學說（多具爭議性）。
sentences: The ideology of Aryanism played a central role in 20th-century history. 雅利安主義意識形態在20世紀歷史中扮演了核心角色。
Historians study the origins and impact of Aryanism. 歷史學家研究雅利安主義的起源及其影響。

meaning: 雅利安化；使符合雅利安標準的過程。
sentences: Aryanization involved the forced transfer of property from non-Aryans. 雅利安化涉及強行轉移非雅利安人的財產。
The process of Aryanization was a key part of the regime's policy. 雅利安化過程是該政權政策的關鍵部分。
The government sought to Aryanize all public institutions. 政府試圖使所有公共機構雅利安化。
They attempted to Aryanize the local culture and language. 他們試圖使當地的文化和語言雅利安化。

meaning: 似小油瓶的；形狀像油瓶的。
sentences: The pottery fragment had an aryballoid shape. 這塊陶器碎片呈小油瓶狀。
Archaeologists found several aryballoid vessels in the tomb. 考古學家在墳墓中發現了幾個小油瓶狀的容器。

meaning: 小油瓶；古希臘的一種圓形瓶，用於盛放油或香水。
sentences: The athlete carried an aryballus containing olive oil. 這位運動員帶著一個裝有橄欖油的小油瓶。
The museum displays a finely decorated Greek aryballus. 博物館展出了一個裝飾精美的希臘小油瓶。

meaning: 杓狀會厭的；與喉部的杓狀軟骨和會厭有關的。
sentences: The aryepiglottic folds help protect the airway during swallowing. 杓狀會厭襞有助於在吞嚥時保護氣道。
The doctor examined the patient's aryepiglottic muscles. 醫生檢查了患者的杓狀會厭肌。

meaning: 芳基；從芳香烴中衍生出的官能基。
sentences: An aryl group is often represented by the symbol Ar in chemistry. 在化學中，芳基常由符號 Ar 表示。
The properties of the molecule are affected by the attached aryl group. 分子的性質受到所連接芳基的影響。

meaning: 芳香胺；含有芳基的胺類化合物。
sentences: Arylamines are important intermediates in the production of dyes. 芳香胺是染料生產中重要的中間體。
Certain arylamines are known to be potentially hazardous. 已知某些芳香胺具有潛在危險。

meaning: 芳胺基；由芳香胺衍生出的原子基團。
sentences: The arylamino group was successfully synthesized in the lab. 芳胺基在實驗室中被成功合成。
Chemists studied the reactivity of various arylamino compounds. 化學家研究了各種芳胺基化合物的反應性。

meaning: 芳基化；使芳基進入化合物。
sentences: The researchers aimed to arylate the organic compound. 研究人員旨在使該有機化合物芳基化。
The process to arylate the substrate required a catalyst. 使底物芳基化的過程需要催化劑。

meaning: 杓狀的；喉部的杓狀軟骨。
sentences: The arytenoid cartilages play a key role in vocal cord movement. 杓狀軟骨在聲帶運動中起關鍵作用。
He experienced swelling near his left arytenoid. 他的左側杓狀軟骨附近出現腫脹。
The arytenoidal muscles control the opening of the glottis. 杓狀軟骨肌控制聲門的開啟。
Arytenoidal movement is essential for clear speech production. 杓狀軟骨的運動對於清晰的發音至關重要。

meaning: 阿爾贊；（某些文化中）指一種穀物或地名。
sentences: Arzan is a type of millet grown in parts of Asia. 阿爾贊是亞洲部分地區種植的一種小米。
The explorers reached the village of Arzan by sunset. 探險家在日落前到達了阿爾贊村。

meaning: 阿爾扎瓦；古代安納托利亞的一個地區或國家（同 Arzawa）。
sentences: Arzava was a major power in western Anatolia during the Bronze Age. 阿爾扎瓦是青銅時代晚期安納托利亞西部的一個強國。
Hittite records contain many references to Arzava. 西台帝國的記錄中多次提到阿爾扎瓦。

meaning: 阿爾扎瓦；古代安納托利亞西部的地區。
sentences: The history of Arzawa is reconstructed from archaeological findings. 阿爾扎瓦的歷史是根據考古發現重建的。
Arzawa often found itself in conflict with the Hittite Empire. 阿爾扎瓦經常與西台帝國發生衝突。

meaning: 阿氏礦；一種罕見的含銅、鉛、氯的硫酸鹽礦物。
sentences: Arzrunite was first discovered in Chile. 阿氏礦最早在智利被發現。
The crystal structure of arzrunite is quite complex. 阿氏礦的晶體結構非常複雜。

meaning: 阿爾尊；地名或特定文化術語。
sentences: Arzun is a historical site located in the Middle East. 阿爾尊是位於中東的一個歷史遺址。
They studied the ancient architecture found at Arzun. 他們研究了在阿爾尊發現的古代建築。
He works as a software engineer at a big company. 他在一間大公司擔任軟體工程師。
As it was getting dark, we decided to head home. 因為天快黑了，我們決定回家。
The copy should read as, not asa. 那份副本應改用表示「正如」的正確拼法。
He corrected the typo from asa to as. 他把這個拼寫錯誤改成了正確的 as。
He spent the entire day asaddle, traveling across the plains. 他整天都在馬背上渡過，橫跨平原旅行。
She felt most at home when she was asaddle. 當她跨在馬背上時，她感到最自在。

meaning: 阿魏；一種具有強烈氣味的植物樹脂，用作調料或藥材。
sentences: Asafetida is a common ingredient in Indian vegetarian cooking. 阿魏是印度素食烹飪中的常用成分。
Despite its strong smell, asafetida adds a unique flavor to dishes. 儘管氣味強烈，阿魏能為菜餚增添獨特的風味。
Asahel was known for being as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle. 亞撒黑以像野羚羊一樣腳步飛快而聞名。
In the Bible, Asahel was a nephew of King David. 在聖經中，亞撒黑是亞瑟王的侄子。
Asak was an early capital of the Parthian Empire. 阿薩克是安息帝國早期的首都。
Archaeologists have conducted surveys near the ancient site of Asak. 考古學家在古代阿薩克遺址附近進行了調查。

meaning: 阿薩萊（地名或特定術語）。
sentences: Lake Asale in Ethiopia is famous for its salt flats. 衣索比亞的阿薩萊湖以其鹽灘聞名。
Workers harvest salt from the shores of Lake Asale. 工人們從阿薩萊湖岸邊收穫鹽。
The yoga instructor demonstrated a complex asana to the class. 瑜珈教練向班級示範了一個複雜的體式。
Practicing different asanas can help to improve flexibility and strength. 練習不同的體式有助於提高靈活性與力量。

meaning: 亞薩；聖經人名，著名的樂師。
sentences: Asaph was a leader of choral music during the reign of King David. 亞薩在亞瑟王統治時期是一位合唱音樂領袖。
Several psalms in the Bible are attributed to Asaph. 聖經中的幾篇詩篇被歸於亞薩名下。
The patient exhibited signs of asaphia after the stroke. 患者在中風後表現出發音不清的跡象。
Speech therapy can help improve conditions like asaphia. 語言治療可以幫助改善發音不清等狀況。

meaning: 亞薩的；關於聖經中亞薩的。
sentences: The choir performed an Asaphic hymn during the service. 唱詩班在禮拜期間演唱了一首亞薩風格的聖歌。
Scholars discussed the musical traditions of the Asaphic line. 學者們討論了亞薩系的音樂傳統。
The collector found a well-preserved asaphid fossil. 收藏家發現了一個保存完好的褶頰蟲化石。
Asaphids were common in the Ordovician period. 褶頰蟲在奧陶紀非常普遍。

meaning: 褶頰蟲科；三葉蟲綱的一科。
sentences: Members of the family Asaphidae are known for their large size. 褶頰蟲科的成員以其巨大的體型而聞名。
The classification of Asaphidae includes several different genera. 褶頰蟲科的分類包括幾個不同的屬。

meaning: 褶頰蟲屬；三葉蟲的一個屬。
sentences: Asaphus fossils are often used as index fossils for geological dating. 褶頰蟲屬化石常用作地質年代測定的標準化石。
The eyes of Asaphus were sometimes elevated on stalks. 褶頰蟲屬的眼睛有時高高地長在柄上。

meaning: 阿沙普羅；一種用作防腐劑或藥物的化合物。
sentences: Asaprol was once used as an internal antiseptic. 阿沙普羅曾被用作體內防腐劑。
The chemical properties of asaprol were detailed in the report. 報告中詳細說明了阿沙普羅的化學性質。
Asarabacca has been used in traditional herbal medicine. 細辛已被用於傳統草藥中。
The leaves of the asarabacca plant are kidney-shaped. 細辛植物的葉子呈腎形。

meaning: 細辛科；植物分類名（現多歸入馬兜鈴科）。
sentences: The family Asaraceae included several species of aromatic plants. 細辛科曾包括幾種芳香植物。
Botanical classifications have evolved to move Asaraceae into Aristolochiaceae. 植物分類法已演變為將細辛科併入馬兜鈴科。

meaning: 地名或特定術語（較罕見）。
sentences: Asarh is a small village mentioned in the local archives. 阿薩爾是當地檔案中提到的一個小村莊。
The explorers passed through Asarh on their way to the coast. 探險家在前往海岸的途中經過了阿薩爾。

meaning: 細辛腦；從細辛中提取的物質。
sentences: Asarite is a crystalline substance derived from the roots of asarum. 細辛腦是從細辛根部提取的結晶物質。
Researchers studied the sedative effects of asarite. 研究人員研究了細辛腦的鎮靜作用。
Asaron is another name for the compound asarone. 這個名稱是化合物細辛腦的另一種稱呼。
The concentration of asaron varies between different plant species. 不同植物物種中的這種化合物濃度各不相同。

meaning: 細辛腦；一種化學物質，存在於細辛和石菖蒲中。
sentences: Asarone is used in some fragrances and traditional medicines. 細辛腦用於某些香料和傳統藥物中。
The safety of asarone has been evaluated by food health authorities. 細辛腦的安全性已由食品健康管理部門進行評估。

meaning: 不掃地；（古羅馬）一種表現地面上有殘羹剩飯的馬賽克裝飾。
sentences: The ancient villa featured a beautiful asarotum mosaic in the dining room. 這座古代別墅的餐廳裡有一幅精美的不掃地馬賽克拼貼畫。
An asarotum creates the illusion of a floor that hasn't been cleaned after a feast. 不掃地圖案營造出一種宴會後地板尚未清理的錯覺。

meaning: 細辛屬；馬兜鈴科下的一個屬。
sentences: Asarum canadense is commonly known as wild ginger. 加拿大細辛通常被稱為野生薑。
Plants in the genus Asarum prefer shady and moist environments. 細辛屬植物喜歡陰涼潮濕的環境。
Asbest was widely used in construction before its health risks were known. 在其健康風險為人所知之前，石棉被廣泛用於建築中。
The old factory had to be cleared of all traces of asbest. 這座舊工廠必須清除所有石棉痕跡。
The asbestic insulation was removed for safety reasons. 出於安全原因，含石棉的隔熱材料已被移除。
He studied the properties of various asbestic materials. 他研究了各種石棉材料的特性。

meaning: 石棉狀的；呈纖維狀的（指礦物）。
sentences: Certain minerals can occur in an asbestiform habit. 某些礦物可能以石棉狀的形態出現。
The geologist identified the crystals as having an asbestiform structure. 地質學家鑑定這些晶體具有石棉狀結構。

meaning: 石棉的；似石棉的；耐火的。
sentences: The curtains were made of an asbestine fabric for fire resistance. 窗簾是由石棉狀織物製成的，以起到防火作用。
His asbestine resolve could not be shaken by criticism. 他那如石棉般堅韌（耐火）的決心不會被批評所動搖。
The workers were told to asbestinize the exterior walls. 工人們被告知要對外牆進行石棉化處理。
It is no longer common practice to asbestinize building materials. 現在已不再流行對建築材料進行石棉化處理。

meaning: 類石棉的；具有石棉特徵的。
sentences: The sample had an asbestoid appearance but a different chemical makeup. 樣本具有類石棉的外觀，但化學組成不同。
He described the fibrous mineral as asbestoid in nature. 他將這種纖維狀礦物描述為本質上類石棉的。
Asbestoidal fibers can be dangerous if inhaled. 類石棉纖維如果被吸入可能會有危險。
The geologist examined the asbestoidal veins in the rock. 地質學家檢查了岩石中的類石棉脈。

meaning: 石棉；一種具高抗熱性的礦物纖維。
sentences: Asbestos was once hailed as a miracle material for its fireproof qualities. 石棉曾因其防火特性而被譽為神奇材料。
Many buildings now undergo asbestos removal to ensure safety. 許多建築現在都要進行石棉拆除以確保安全。

meaning: 石棉沉著症；長期吸入石棉粉塵引起的肺部疾病。
sentences: Asbestosis can lead to severe breathing difficulties and lung damage. 石棉沉著症會導致嚴重的呼吸困難和肺部損傷。
He was diagnosed with asbestosis after years of working in the construction industry. 在建築業工作多年後，他被診斷出患有石棉沉著症。

meaning: 石棉的；含有石棉的（同 asbestic）。
sentences: The asbestous waste must be disposed of carefully. 含石棉的廢棄物必須小心處理。
They found asbestous layers within the old roof tiles. 他們在舊屋頂瓦片中發現了石棉層。

meaning: 石棉（asbestos 的另一種拼寫）。
sentences: Asbestus is another way to spell asbestos. Asbestus 是 asbestos 的另一種拼法。
The chemical properties of asbestus are identical to those of asbestos. Asbestus 的化學性質與 asbestos 完全相同。

meaning: 煤煙膠；從煤煙中提取的一種物質。
sentences: Asbolin was once used in the treatment of certain skin conditions. 煤煙膠曾被用於治療某些皮膚狀況。
The scientist analyzed the components of asbolin. 科學家分析了煤煙膠的成分。

meaning: 鈷土礦；一種含鈷的錳氧化物礦物。
sentences: Asbolite is an important ore of cobalt. 鈷土礦是鈷的一種重要礦石。
The dark, earthy mineral was identified as asbolite. 這種深色、土狀的礦物被鑑定為鈷土礦。

meaning: 阿斯卡巴特；中世紀傳說中的巨人名。
sentences: Ascabart is a famous giant from the romance of Bevis of Hampton. 阿斯卡巴特是《漢普頓的貝維斯》傳奇故事中著名的巨人。
The legend tells of how Ascabart was defeated and became a servant. 傳說講述了阿斯卡巴特如何被打敗並成為僕人的故事。

meaning: 壁虎亞目；爬行動物的一類。
sentences: Ascalabota is a suborder of reptiles that includes geckos. 壁虎亞目是包含壁虎在內的爬行動物亞目。
Members of Ascalabota are known for their ability to climb smooth surfaces. 壁虎亞目的成員以其攀爬光滑表面的能力而聞名。
He looked ascan at the stranger entering the room. 他斜著眼看著進入房間的陌生人。
She viewed the new proposal ascan, doubting its effectiveness. 她懷疑地（斜視地）看待這項新提議。

meaning: 阿斯卡尼亞的；指德國的一個古老王朝。
sentences: The Ascanian dynasty ruled parts of Germany for centuries. 阿斯卡尼亞王朝統治了德國部分地區數百年。
He is a descendant of the Ascanian noble family. 他是阿斯卡尼亞貴族家庭的後裔。

meaning: 阿斯卡尼烏斯；希臘與羅馬神話中埃涅阿斯的兒子。
sentences: Ascanius was the legendary founder of Alba Longa. 阿斯卡尼烏斯是阿爾巴隆加傳說中的建立者。
In the Aeneid, Ascanius is also known as Iulus. 在《埃涅阿斯紀》中，阿斯卡尼烏斯也被稱為尤盧斯。

meaning: 害怕地；驚恐地（較罕見用法）。
sentences: The animal stood ascare in the middle of the road. 那隻動物驚恐地站在馬路中間。
He looked ascare after hearing the sudden loud noise. 聽到突然的巨響後，他顯得十分驚恐。

meaning: 蛔蟲病；由蛔蟲感染引起的疾病。
sentences: Ascariasis is common in regions with poor sanitation. 蛔蟲病在衛生條件差的地區很常見。
Symptoms of ascariasis can include abdominal pain and coughing. 蛔蟲病的症狀包括腹痛和咳嗽。
The doctor prescribed an ascaricidal medication. 醫生開了一種殺蛔蟲的藥物。
Researchers are testing new ascaricidal compounds. 研究人員正在測試新的殺蛔蟲化合物。
The use of ascaricide is essential for treating large-scale infections. 使用驅蛔蟲藥對於治療大規模感染至關重要。
The pharmaceutical company developed a more effective ascaricide. 這家製藥公司開發了一種更有效的驅蛔蟲藥。

meaning: 蛔蟲；屬於蛔蟲科的線蟲。
sentences: An ascarid is a type of parasitic roundworm. 蛔蟲是一種寄生圓蟲。
The veterinarian found ascarids in the puppy's stool. 獸醫在小狗的糞便中發現了蛔蟲。
Ascaridae includes several genera of significant medical importance. 蛔蟲科包括幾個具有重要醫學意義的屬。
Biologists study the life cycle of parasites in the Ascaridae family. 生物學家研究蛔蟲科寄生蟲的生命週期。
Ascarides can cause various health problems in humans and animals. 蛔蟲會引起人類和動物的各種健康問題。
The treatment aimed to eliminate all ascarides from the system. 治療旨在清除體內所有的蛔蟲。

meaning: 雞蛔蟲屬；寄生於家禽的線蟲屬。
sentences: Ascaridia galli is a common parasite found in chickens. 雞蛔蟲是雞體內常見的寄生蟲。
Farmers monitor their flocks for signs of Ascaridia infection. 農民監測其禽群是否有雞蛔蟲感染的跡象。
Ascaridiasis affects millions of people worldwide. 蛔蟲病影響著全球數百萬人。
Public health programs focus on preventing ascaridiasis through education. 公共衛生計劃專注於通過教育預防蛔蟲病。

meaning: 驅蛔素；從土荆芥油中提取的具有驅蟲作用的化學物質。
sentences: Ascaridole is the active component responsible for the anthelmintic effect. 驅蛔素是負責驅蟲效果的活性成分。
The chemist synthesized ascaridole in the laboratory. 化學家在實驗室中合成了驅蛔素。

meaning: 蛔蟲屬；引起人蛔蟲病的屬。
sentences: Ascaris lumbricoides is the largest nematode parasitizing the human intestine. 人蛔蟲是寄生於人體腸道最大的線蟲。
The eggs of Ascaris are highly resistant to environmental stress. 蛔蟲卵對環境壓力具有很強的抵抗力。

meaning: 蛔蟲毒素；從蛔蟲中提取的具有毒性的物質。
sentences: Ascaron can cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals. 蛔蟲毒素可能在敏感群體中引起過敏反應。
Researchers studied the physiological effects of ascaron. 研究人員研究了蛔蟲毒素的生理影響。

meaning: 腋座；射手座的一顆恆星（射手座ζ）。
sentences: Ascella is a binary star system in the constellation Sagittarius. 腋座是人馬座中的一個雙星系統。
Astronomers measured the brightness of Ascella. 天文學家測量了腋座的亮度。

meaning: 小腋；微小的腋窩狀結構。
sentences: The scientist observed the tiny ascellus under the microscope. 科學家在顯微鏡下觀察了這個微小的腋窩狀結構。
Each segment of the insect has a small ascellus. 昆蟲的每個體節都有一個小腋。
The hikers began to ascend the mountain early in the morning to see the sun. 登山者一大早就開始登山，以便看日出。
We watched the hot air balloon slowly ascend into the clear blue sky. 我們看著熱氣球緩慢升（上升）入晴朗的藍天。
The peak is only ascendable during the summer months. 該山峰僅在夏季月份可以攀登。
The old tower remains ascendable for those who are physically fit. 對於體能良好的人來說，這座舊塔仍然是可以登上的。
The company's ascendance in the market was rapid. 該公司在市場上的崛起非常迅速。
She has been in the ascendance within the political party. 她在該政黨內的權勢一直在上升。
The empire gained ascendancy over its neighbors. 帝國取得了對其鄰國的主宰地位。
The intellectual ascendancy of the group influenced national policy. 該團體的智力優勢影響了國家政策。

meaning: 優勢的同義詞（“指揮影響力；主導控制；優越性，至高無上”）。
sentences: The ascendant in the room belonged to her. 房間裡的主導權屬於她。
After the win, the ascendant shifted to the home team. 比賽贏了之後，優勢就轉到主隊身上。
The star's ascendence was observed early in the evening. 傍晚早些時候觀察到了這顆星的上升。
They celebrated the family's social ascendence. 他們慶祝家族社會地位的上升。
The new technology challenged the ascendency of traditional methods. 新技術挑戰了傳統方法的優勢地位。
Moral ascendency can be more powerful than physical force. 道德優勢可能比武力更強大。

meaning: 上升的；占優勢的（同 ascendant）。
sentences: His career is currently in an ascendent phase. 他的職業生涯目前正處於上升階段。
The ascendent sign in his horoscope is Leo. 他星盤中的上升星座是獅子座。

meaning: 上升者；（印刷）字母的向上延伸部分（如 b, d, f, h, k, l, t）。
sentences: The ascender on the letter 'h' is very clear in this font. 在這種字體中，字母 'h' 的向上延伸部分非常清晰。
He is a skilled rock ascender who enjoys challenging climbs. 他是一位擅長挑戰性攀登的熟練攀岩者。

meaning: 可上升的；可攀登的（同 ascendable）。
sentences: The steep path is barely ascendible without proper equipment. 如果沒有合適的裝備，這條陡峭的小徑幾乎無法攀登。
They checked if the structure was safely ascendible. 他們檢查了該結構是否可以安全攀登。

meaning: 上升或增加到更高的水平、價值或程度。
sentences: Please arrange these numbers in an ascending order. 請按升序排列這些數字。
We used an ascending sort. 我們使用升序排序。
The data points were plotted ascendingly on the graph. 數據點在圖表上按升序繪製。
The prices have been moving ascendingly over the past month. 價格在過去一個月裡一直呈上升趨勢。
The ascension of the hot-air balloon gave us a better view. 熱氣球的升空讓我們看到了更好的景色。
The term ascension refers to the act of ascending; an ascent. 揚升一詞指的是揚升的行為；一次上升。
The aircraft's ascensional force was measured during takeoff. 飛機起飛時的上升力被測量了出來。
Hot air provides the ascensional power for the balloon. 熱空氣為氣球提供了上升的動力。

meaning: 登山運動員；追求社會地位上升的人。
sentences: The famous ascensionist reached the summit in record time. 這位著名的登山運動員以破紀錄的時間登頂。
She was accused of being a social ascensionist, always trying to meet influential people. 她被指責是一個追求社會地位攀升的人，總是試圖結識有影響力的人。

meaning: 耶穌升天節期；指從升天節到五旬節之間的這段時間。
sentences: The church prepared special services for Ascensiontide. 教會為耶穌升天節期準備了特別的崇拜活動。
Ascensiontide is an important period in the Christian liturgical calendar. 耶穌升天節期是基督教禮拜曆中的一個重要時期。
The movement was characterized by an ascensive motion. 該運動的特徵是上升運動。
In grammar, an ascensive particle adds emphasis or increases intensity. 在語法中，遞進助詞用於增加強調或強度。
He made a tedious ascent of Mont Blanc. 他艱難地攀登了白朗峰。
The term ascent refers to the act of ascending; a motion upwards. 術語「上升」是指上升的行為；向上的動作。

meaning: 明確地找出來；發現或建立。
sentences: As soon as we ascertain what the situation is, we can plan how to proceed. 一旦我們確定了情況，我們就可以計劃如何進行。
To ascertain means to find out definitely; to discover or establish. 確定是指確定地查明；發現或建立。
The facts of the case are easily ascertainable. 案件事實很容易查明。
The exact date of the event is not currently ascertainable. 該事件的確切日期目前尚無法確定。
The ascertainableness of the truth was the lawyer's main goal. 查明真相（真相的可查明性）是律師的主要目標。
They discussed the ascertainableness of the project's total cost. 他們討論了該項目總成本的可確定性。
The value of the assets was ascertainably higher than reported. 資產價值顯然比報告的要高。
The impact of the policy can be ascertainably measured. 政策的影響可以被明確地測量出來。
The official served as the primary ascertainer of the election results. 該官員擔任選舉結果的主要查明者。
As an ascertainer of facts, he was meticulous in his work. 作為一名事實查明者，他在工作中非常細心。
The ascertainment of the cause of death required an autopsy. 查明死因需要進行屍檢。
Accurate ascertainment of public opinion is difficult. 準確查明公眾輿論是困難的。
The ascescency of the milk indicated it was no longer fresh. 牛奶發酸表明它不再新鮮。
He monitored the ascescency of the wine during the fermentation process. 他在發酵過程中監測葡萄酒的變酸情況。
The cider had an ascescent taste after being left out. 蘋果酒在外面放了一段時間後有一種發酸的味道。
Ascescent liquids are often used in pickling. 變酸的液體常用於醃製。
The monk lived a very ascetic life in the mountains. 僧侶在大山中過著非常清苦的修道生活。
As an ascetic, he renounced all worldly possessions. 作為一名苦行者，他放棄了所有的世俗財產。
She followed an ascetical regimen to discipline her mind. 她遵循一套禁慾的養生法來磨練心智。
The ascetical practices of the sect were well-known. 該教派的苦行實踐眾所周知。
The teacher gave one simple sentence with ascetically. 老師用這個副詞舉了一個簡單句子。
She marked ascetically in her notebook after class. 她下課後把這個副詞記在筆記本裡。
Asceticism is a common feature in many religious traditions. 苦行主義是許多宗教傳統中的一個共同特徵。
Extreme asceticism can be physically demanding. 極端的苦行主義對身體要求很高。

meaning: 小罈海綿屬；一種石灰海綿。
sentences: Ascetta is a genus of simple calcareous sponges. 小罈海綿屬是一個簡單的石灰海綿屬。
The researchers studied the cellular structure of Ascetta. 研究人員研究了小罈海綿屬的細胞結構。

meaning: 阿夏石；一種含有雲母的岩石。
sentences: Aschaffite is named after Aschaffenburg in Germany. 阿夏石是以德國的阿沙芬堡命名的。
The geologist analyzed a sample of aschaffite from the region. 地質學家分析了該地區的一塊阿夏石樣本。

meaning: 弓具櫃；存放弓箭的專用窄櫃。
sentences: The archer kept his best longbow in a hand-crafted ascham. 射箭運動員將他最好的長弓放在手工製作的弓具櫃中。
A proper ascham protects the bows from humidity and temperature changes. 合適的弓具櫃可以保護弓箭免受濕度和溫度變化的影響。

meaning: 不裂的；（岩石）成分不變的。
sentences: Aschistic dikes have the same composition as the parent magma. 不裂岩脈與母岩漿具有相同的成分。
The study focused on the differences between aschistic and diaschistic rocks. 這項研究集中於不裂岩和裂理岩之間的區別。
The asci contain the sexual spores of the fungus. 子囊包含真菌的有性孢子。
Microscopic examination revealed numerous asci within the tissue. 顯微鏡檢查顯示組織內有大量子囊。

meaning: 無影者；指居住在赤道地區的人（在太陽直射時無影）。
sentences: An ascian is someone who lives in a place where the sun is directly overhead at noon. 無影者是指居住在中午太陽直射頭頂地區的人。
The term ascian was used by ancient geographers for tropical inhabitants. 無影者一詞被古代地理學家用來稱呼熱帶居民。

meaning: 海鞘屬；一種海生被囊動物。
sentences: Ascidia is a common genus of sea squirts found in many oceans. 海鞘屬是許多海洋中常見的海鞘屬。
The biology student dissected an Ascidia specimen in class. 生物系學生在課堂上解剖了一個海鞘標本。

meaning: 海鞘綱；被囊動物亞門的一綱。
sentences: Ascidiacea includes a variety of marine animals known as sea squirts. 海鞘綱包括多種被稱為海鞘的海洋動物。
Most members of Ascidiacea are sessile as adults. 海鞘綱的大多數成員在成年後是固著生活的。

meaning: 海鞘類；（較舊的）海鞘綱名稱。
sentences: Ascidiae was a term used in earlier biological classifications. 海鞘類是早期生物分類中使用的術語。
The researcher reviewed old texts on the morphology of Ascidiae. 研究人員回顧了關於海鞘類形態學的舊文獻。

meaning: 海鞘；屬於海鞘綱的被囊動物。
sentences: The ascidian larvae have a primitive notochord. 海鞘幼蟲具有原始的脊索。
Ascidian species can be found in shallow coastal waters. 在淺海沿岸水域可以發現海鞘物種。

meaning: 具瓶狀體的；（植物）葉子呈瓶狀或囊狀的。
sentences: The pitcher plant has modified ascidiate leaves for catching insects. 豬籠草具有改良的瓶狀葉用於捕捉昆蟲。
The botanist described the unique ascidiate structure of the plant. 植物學家描述了該植物獨特的瓶狀結構。
Certain small crustaceans are ascidicolous in nature. 某些小型甲殼類動物本質上是寄生於海鞘體內的。
The scientist studied the behavior of ascidicolous organisms. 科學家研究了海鞘體內寄生生物的行為。

meaning: 具瓶狀體的；產生囊狀構造的。
sentences: The ascidiferous parts of the plant are used for nutrient storage. 該植物具瓶狀體的部分用於營養儲存。
The researchers identified the ascidiferous traits in the new species. 研究人員在新物種中鑑定出了具瓶狀體的特徵。
The organ has an ascidiform shape that aids its function. 該器官具有助其功能的瓶狀形狀。
They observed ascidiform structures during the microscopic analysis. 他們在顯微分析過程中觀察到了瓶狀結構。
The fossil had an ascidioid appearance, suggesting it might be an ancestor of sea squirts. 該化石具有似海鞘的外觀，表明它可能是海鞘的祖先。
She noted the ascidioid features of the underwater organism. 她注意到了這種水下生物似海鞘的特徵。

meaning: 海鞘目；海鞘綱下的一個目。
sentences: The order Ascidioida includes many well-known species of sea squirts. 海鞘目包括許多著名的海鞘物種。
Taxonomists have revised the classification of Ascidioida several times. 分類學家已多次修訂海鞘目的分類。

meaning: 海鞘總科；海鞘目下的一個總科。
sentences: Members of Ascidioidea are widespread across the world's oceans. 海鞘總科的成員廣泛分佈於世界各大洋。
The study compared the genetic markers of different families within Ascidioidea. 該研究比較了海鞘總科內不同科的遺傳標記。

meaning: 海鞘類動物（較舊的分類學術語）。
sentences: Ascidiozoa was once used to group all tunicate-like animals. 海鞘類動物曾被用於將所有類似被囊類動物歸為一類。
The term Ascidiozoa is now largely obsolete in modern biology. Ascidiozoa 一詞在現代生物學中已在很大程度上廢棄。

meaning: 海鞘個體；構成群體海鞘的單個個體。
sentences: Each ascidiozooid in the colony functions as an independent unit for feeding. 群落中的每個海鞘個體都作為一個獨立的攝食單位運作。
The researchers studied the arrangement of ascidiozooids in the common matrix. 研究人員研究了公共基質中海鞘個體的排列方式。

meaning: 瓶狀葉；（植物）如豬籠草的捕蟲瓶。
sentences: The ascidium of the pitcher plant is filled with digestive enzymes. 豬籠草的瓶狀葉中充滿了消化酶。
Insects are attracted to the nectar on the rim of the ascidium. 昆蟲被瓶狀葉邊緣的蜜液所吸引。
The asciferous layer of the fungus is where spores are produced. 真菌的具子囊層是產生孢子的地方。
They identified the asciferous tissue under the microscope. 他們在顯微鏡下鑑定出了具子囊的組織。
The ascigerous phase of the fungus is part of its sexual reproduction. 真菌的具子囊階段是其有性生殖的一部分。
Ascigerous cells are characterized by the presence of asci. 具子囊細胞的特徵是存在子囊。

meaning: 美國標準資訊交換碼；一種基於拉丁字母的電腦編碼系統。
sentences: The terminal accepted only ascii text. 終端機只接受美國標準資訊交換碼格式的文字。
Please save the file in ascii format. 請把檔案存成美國標準資訊交換碼格式。

meaning: 腹水；腹腔內異常積聚的液體。
sentences: Ascites can be a symptom of liver disease or heart failure. 腹水可能是肝病或心臟衰竭的症狀。
The patient required a procedure to drain the excess ascites. 患者需要接受引流過多腹水的手術。
The doctor examined the patient's ascitic fluid. 醫生檢查了患者的腹水（腹腔液）。
Ascitic accumulation can cause significant abdominal swelling. 腹水積聚會導致明顯的腹部腫脹。
The ascitical condition of the patient was carefully monitored. 患者的腹水狀況受到了仔細監測。
She suffered from ascitical symptoms due to her illness. 由於生病，她遭受了腹水症狀的困擾。

meaning: 附加的；額外的（較罕見用法）。
sentences: The teacher used ascititious to describe the example. 老師用這個形容詞描述例子。
She underlined ascititious because it was new to her. 她把這個形容詞畫線標起來。

meaning: 傾斜的（較罕見或方言用法）。
sentences: The asclent slope made the climb more difficult than expected. 傾斜的坡度使得攀登比預期的更困難。
The old building had an asclent wall that needed reinforcement. 這座舊建築有一面傾斜的牆，需要加固。

meaning: 阿斯克勒庇俄斯子孫；古代著名的醫生家族成員。
sentences: Hippocrates is often considered the most famous Asclepiad. 希波克拉底通常被認為是最著名的阿斯克勒庇俄斯子孫（醫道傳人）。
The Asclepiads were dedicated to the study and practice of medicine. 阿斯克勒庇俄斯家族致力於醫學的研究和實踐。

meaning: 阿斯克勒庇亞德詩體；一種特定的古希臘詩歌節律。
sentences: The poet used the asclepiad meter to create a specific rhythmic effect. 詩人使用阿斯克勒庇亞德詩體來營造特定的節律效果。
Classical scholars study the structure of the asclepiad verse. 古典學者研究阿斯克勒庇亞德詩句的結構。

meaning: 蘿藦科；植物的一個科（現多併入夾竹桃科）。
sentences: Asclepiadaceae is known for its milky sap and unique floral structures. 蘿藦科以其乳白色汁液和獨特的花卉結構而聞名。
Many garden favorites were once classified under Asclepiadaceae. 許多受歡迎的園藝植物曾被歸類於蘿藦科。

meaning: 蘿藦科的；類似蘿藦科植物的。
sentences: The plant exhibits classic asclepiadaceous traits. 該植物表現出經典的蘿藦科特徵。
Researchers studied the asclepiadaceous pollination mechanisms. 研究人員研究了蘿藦科植物的傳粉機制。

meaning: 阿斯克勒庇俄斯後裔（家族名）。
sentences: The Asclepiadae claimed descent from the god of medicine. 阿斯克勒庇俄斯後裔聲稱自己是醫神之子孫。
The traditions of the Asclepiadae influenced early medical ethics. 阿斯克勒庇俄斯後裔的傳統影響了早期的醫學倫理。

meaning: 阿斯克勒庇亞德式的；關於阿斯克勒庇亞德詩體的。
sentences: The teacher used Asclepiadean to describe the example. 老師用「阿斯克勒庇亞德式」來描述這個例子。
She chose an Asclepiadean example for class. 她選了一個「阿斯克勒庇亞德式」的課堂例子。
The asclepiadeous flowers are often highly specialized for specific insects. 蘿藦科的花朵通常高度專化，以適應特定的昆蟲。
Botanists categorize the vine as asclepiadeous. 植物學家將這種藤本植物歸類為蘿藦科。

meaning: 阿斯克勒庇亞德詩體的（同 Asclepiadean）。
sentences: The Asclepiadic meter is common in some Horace's odes. 阿斯克勒庇亞德詩體在賀拉斯的一些頌歌中很常見。
She analyzed the Asclepiadic structure of the ancient verses. 她分析了這些古代詩句的阿斯克勒庇亞德結構。

meaning: 醫神的；關於阿斯克勒庇俄斯的。
sentences: The Asclepian staff, a snake-entwined rod, is a symbol of medicine. 阿斯克勒庇俄斯之杖（靈蛇杖）是醫學的象徵。
Ancient patients sought healing in Asclepian temples. 古代的病人在醫神廟中尋求治癒。

meaning: 馬利筋屬；蘿藦科的一屬植物，乳草。
sentences: Asclepias syriaca is the common milkweed plant. 敘利亞馬利筋是常見的乳草植物。
Milkweed in the genus Asclepias is the primary food source for monarch butterfly caterpillars. 馬利筋屬的乳草是黑脈金斑蝶幼蟲的主要食物來源。

meaning: 馬利筋素；從馬利筋中提取的一種物質。
sentences: Asclepidin was once used in pharmacy as an emetic or expectorant. 馬利筋素曾被藥理學用作催吐劑或祛痰劑。
The chemist isolated asclepidin from the plant's roots. 化學家從植物的根部中分離出馬利筋素。

meaning: 似馬利筋的；似蘿藦科植物的。
sentences: The new specimen has an asclepidoid growth habit. 新標本具有似馬利筋的生長習性。
He described the leaf shape as asclepidoid. 他將葉片的形狀描述為似馬利筋的。

meaning: 醫神廟；古希臘供奉阿斯克勒庇俄斯的醫療聖殿。
sentences: The Asclepieion at Epidaurus was the most famous healing center in the ancient world. 埃皮達魯斯的醫神廟是古代世界最著名的醫療中心。
Patients would sleep in the Asclepieion, hoping for a dream that would reveal their cure. 病人會住在醫神廟裡，希望能做個預示治癒方法的夢。
Asclepin is a bitter substance found in the milkweed plant. 馬利筋素是乳草植物中發現的一種苦味物質。
Medical researchers studied the properties of asclepin. 醫學研究人員研究了馬利筋素的性質。

meaning: 阿斯克勒庇俄斯；希臘神話中的醫神。
sentences: Asclepius was the son of Apollo and Coronis. 阿斯克勒庇俄斯是阿波羅和科羅妮絲之子。
Temples dedicated to Asclepius were found throughout ancient Greece. 供奉阿斯克勒庇俄斯的神廟遍及整個古希臘。

meaning: 子囊果；子囊菌綱真菌的子實體。
sentences: The ascocarp protects the developing asci and spores. 子囊果保護發育中的子囊和孢子。
Morels are a well-known type of edible ascocarp. 羊肚菌是一種著名的食用子囊果。

meaning: 具子囊果的；產生子囊果的。
sentences: Ascocarpous development is a key feature of certain fungi. 具子囊果的發育是某些真菌的關鍵特徵。
They identified the ascocarpous structures in the sample. 他們在樣本中鑑定出了具子囊果的結構。

meaning: 殼二孢屬；一類能引起植物病害的真菌。
sentences: Ascochyta blight can cause significant damage to pea crops. 殼二孢枯萎病可能對豌豆作物造成重大損害。
Scientists are developing resistant varieties to combat Ascochyta infections. 科學家正在開發抗病品種以對抗殼二孢屬感染。
The ascogenous hyphae give rise to the asci in the fungus. 子囊發育菌絲在真菌中產生子囊。
Researchers studied the growth of ascogenous tissues. 研究人員研究了產生子囊組織的生長。

meaning: 產囊體；子囊菌的有性器官（同 ascogonium）。
sentences: The ascogone is the female reproductive structure in many ascomycetes. 產囊體是許多子囊菌中的雌性生殖結構。
Fertilization occurs when the male element reaches the ascogone. 當雄性元素到達產囊體時，受精就會發生。
The ascogonial cells are essential for the formation of the fruiting body. 產囊體細胞對於子實體的形成至關重要。
They observed ascogonial development under the microscope. 他們在顯微鏡下觀察了產囊體的發育。

meaning: 產囊小體；（地衣中）產囊體的小型組成部分。
sentences: The ascogonidium is involved in the reproduction of certain lichen species. 產囊小體參與某些地衣物種的繁殖。
Biologists examined the structure of the ascogonidium. 生物學家檢查了產囊小體的結構。

meaning: 產囊體；子囊菌中有性生殖的雌性器官。
sentences: The development of the ascogonium precedes the formation of the asci. 產囊體的發育早於子囊的形成。
In some fungi, the ascogonium is a multi-celled structure. 在某些真菌中，產囊體是一個多細胞結構。

meaning: 子囊地衣；真菌成分為子囊菌的地衣。
sentences: Most known lichens are ascolichens. 大多數已知的地衣都是子囊地衣。
Ascolichens can be found growing on rocks and tree bark worldwide. 在世界各地的岩石和樹皮上都可以發現子囊地衣。
Ascolichenes form a large and diverse class of symbiotic organisms. 子囊地衣類由一大群多樣的共生生物組成。
The classification of Ascolichenes is based on the characteristics of their fungal component. 子囊地衣類的分類是基於其真菌成分的特徵。
The ascoma is the macroscopic fruiting body of a cup fungus. 子囊果是盤菌目真菌肉眼可見的子實體。
The structure of the ascoma varies greatly between different species. 不同物種之間子囊果的結構差異很大。

meaning: 子囊菌的；關於子囊菌綱的。
sentences: The ascomycetal fungi are characterized by the production of asci. 子囊菌的特徵是產生子囊。
Researchers studied the ascomycetal spores collected from the soil. 研究人員研究了從土壤中採集的子囊菌孢子。

meaning: 子囊菌；子囊菌綱的真菌。
sentences: Yeast is a simple type of ascomycete used in baking and brewing. 酵母是用於烘焙和釀造的一種簡單子囊菌。
The ascomycete phylum is the largest group in the kingdom Fungi. 子囊菌門是真菌界中最大的群體。

meaning: 子囊菌綱；包含酵母、黴菌、羊肚菌等的真菌綱。
sentences: Ascomycetes play crucial roles as decomposers in various ecosystems. 子囊菌綱在各種生態系統中作為分解者發揮著至關重要的作用。
The study of Ascomycetes is a major field in mycology. 子囊菌綱的研究是真菌學中的一個主要領域。
The specimen shows ascomycetous characteristics under the microscope. 該標本在顯微鏡下顯示出子囊菌的特徵。
Many fungi are classified as ascomycetous species. 許多真菌被歸類為子囊菌物種。

meaning: 單體型珊瑚；最簡單的海綿構造
sentences: The ascon is the simplest form of sponge canal system. 單體型是海綿水道系統中最簡單的形式。
Biologists studied the structure of the ascon sponge. 生物學家研究了單體型海綿的結構。
Ascones are a group of sponges with a simple canal structure. 單體型海綿是一群具有簡單水道結構的海綿。
The classification of Ascones is based on their morphological features. 單體型海綿類的分類基於它們的形態特徵。
The ascophore supports the developing asci in certain fungi. 子囊托在某些真菌中支撐發育中的子囊。
Observation of the ascophore is essential for identification. 觀察產子囊體對於鑑定至關重要。
The ascophorous stage of the fungus was identified in the lab. 該真菌的產子囊階段在實驗室中被鑑定出來。
This species is known for its ascophorous structures. 該物種以其具子囊托的結構而聞名。
Ascophyllum is a genus of large brown algae in the family Fucaceae. 泡葉藻屬是墨角藻科中的一類大型褐藻。
Extracts from Ascophyllum are used in organic fertilizers. 泡葉藻屬的提取物被用於有機肥料。
Ascorbic acid is more commonly known as Vitamin C. 抗壞血酸更常見的名稱是維生素 C。
Citrus fruits are rich in ascorbic compounds. 柑橘類水果含有豐富的抗壞血酸化合物。
An ascospore is a spore contained in an ascus. 子囊孢子是包含在子囊中的孢子。
The fungus reproduces by releasing ascospores into the air. 該真菌通過將子囊孢子釋放到空氣中進行繁殖。
The ascosporic characteristics are used for fungal classification. 子囊孢子的特徵被用於真菌分類。
Scientists examined the ascosporic development of the specimen. 科學家檢查了標本的子囊孢子發育。
Ascosporous fungi play a significant role in the ecosystem. 具子囊孢子的真菌在生態系統中發揮重要作用。
The sample contained many ascosporous elements. 樣本中含有許多具子囊孢子的元素。

meaning: 阿斯科特（英國地名，以賽馬聞名）
sentences: The Royal Ascot is a world-famous horse racing event. 皇家阿斯科特賽馬會是世界著名的賽馬盛事。
Fashion is as important as the racing at Ascot. 在阿斯科特，時尚與賽馬同樣重要。
He wore a stylish ascot with his blazer. 他穿西裝外套時搭配了一條時尚的寬領帶。
The gentleman adjusted his silk ascot before the dinner. 那位紳士在晚宴前調整了他的絲綢寬領結。
Ascothoracica is a group of parasitic crustaceans. 囊胸亞綱是一群寄生性的甲殼動物。
Researchers studied the life cycle of Ascothoracica species. 研究人員研究了囊胸亞綱物種的生命週期。
The error is ascribable to a technical failure. 該錯誤可歸因於技術故障。
His success is partly ascribable to his hard work. 他的成功部分歸功於他的努力。
To what do you ascribe your long life? 你將長壽歸功於什麼？
They ascribe great importance to this project. 他們賦予這個項目極大的重要性。
In ancient times, certain people were ascript to the land. 在古代，某些人被歸屬於土地。
The data was ascript to the correct department. 數據被登記到正確的部門。
The ascription of this painting to Rembrandt is disputed. 這幅畫歸屬於倫勃朗的事實存在爭議。

The board snapped atwo. 木板折成兩半。
The apple was cut atwo. 蘋果被切成兩半。
The patient presented with atypic symptoms. 患者出現了非典型症狀。
This is an atypic case of the disease. 這是該疾病的一個非典型案例。
The teacher used atypical to describe the example. 老師用「不符合正常類型」來描述這個例子。
She chose an atypical example for class. 她選了一個「不符合正常類型」的課堂例子。
The weather has been atypically cold this spring. 今年春天的天氣反常地寒冷。
He behaved atypically during the meeting. 他在會議期間表現反常。
The biopsy showed signs of cellular atypy. 活檢顯示出細胞非典型性的跡象。
Atypy can sometimes indicate a precancerous condition. 非典型性有時可能預示著癌前病變。
The patient appeared auantic due to chronic illness. 由於慢性病，病人顯得消瘦。
He studied auantic conditions in ancient populations. 他研究了古代人群中的消瘦狀況。
The poet wrote an aube celebrating the sunrise. 詩人寫了一首讚美日出的黎明曲。
We waited for the aube in silence. 我們在沉默中等待著黎明。
The aubepine bush was covered in white blossoms. 山楂灌木叢開滿了白色的花朵。
Aubepine is often used in traditional herbal medicine. 山楂常用於傳統草藥中。
Aubrey is a name of Germanic origin. 奧布里是一個源自日耳曼語的名字。
We met a man named Aubrey at the party. 我們在派對上遇到了一個叫奧布里的人。
Aubrietia is a popular choice for rock gardens. 南芥屬是岩石花園的熱門選擇。
The purple aubrietia bloomed beautifully in the spring. 紫色的南芥在春天開得很漂亮。
The garden was filled with colorful aubrietia. 花園裡到處都是五顏六色的南芥。
Aubrietia is known for its ability to grow in rock crevices. 南芥以其在岩石縫隙中生長的能力而聞名。
Aubrite is a type of meteorite composed mostly of enstatite. 頑火無球隕石是一種主要由頑火輝石組成的隕石。
The scientist analyzed the chemical composition of the aubrite. 科學家分析了這塊頑火無球隕石的化學成分。

meaning: 深紅棕色，常用於描述頭髮顏色。
sentences: Her auburn hair caught the light. 她的赤褐色頭髮在光下很亮。
He wore an auburn scarf on the cold morning. 他在寒冷的早晨圍著一條赤褐色圍巾。
The room was decorated with a beautiful Aubusson tapestry. 房間裡裝飾著一塊漂亮的歐比松掛毯。
Aubusson carpets are famous for their intricate designs. 歐比松地毯以其複雜的設計而聞名。

meaning: 瓦歐拉尼人（厄瓜多原住民，舊稱奧卡人）
sentences: The Auca people live in the Amazon rainforest. 奧卡人居住在亞馬遜雨林中。
Anthropologists studied the language of the Auca. 人類學家研究了奧卡人的語言。
The word 'auca' was historically used to refer to certain tribes. 『奧卡』這個詞在歷史上被用來指代某些部落。
He read about the auca culture in an old book. 他在一本舊書中讀到了關於奧卡文化的內容。
They explored the Aucan territory. 他們探索了奧卡人的領地。
Aucan traditions have been passed down for generations. 奧卡人的傳統代代相傳。
The Aucaner are known for their deep knowledge of the forest. 奧卡人以其對森林的深厚知識而聞名。
He met an Aucaner while traveling in South America. 他在南美旅行時遇到了一位奧卡人。
The Aucanian dialect is unique. 奧卡方言是獨一無二的。
She is an expert in Aucanian history. 她是一位奧卡歷史專家。
Auchenia was formerly used as a genus name for llamas. Auchenia 以前被用作駱馬的屬名。
The classification of Auchenia has changed over time. Auchenia 的分類隨時間而改變。
The auchenia species are native to the Andes. 羊駝類物種原產於安地斯山脈。
He saw an auchenia during his trip to Peru. 他在秘魯旅行期間看到了一隻羊駝屬動物。
The biologist pointed to the auchenium of the specimen. 生物學家指出了標本的頸部。
The color of the auchenium varies between species. 頸部的顏色在不同物種之間有所不同。

meaning: 【蘇格蘭】（約四分之一蒲式耳的）容量單位
sentences: The farmer measured the grain with an auchlet. 農夫用一個約等於四分之一蒲式耳的蘇格蘭容量單位來量穀物。
The old ledger listed each auchlet beside the harvest. 舊帳本在收成旁逐項記下一個個蘇格蘭容量單位。
The rare diamond was sold for a record price at the auction in London. 這顆稀有鑽石在倫敦的拍賣會上以創紀錄的價格售出。
They decided to put their old house up for auction next month. 他們決定下個月把舊房子拿去拍賣。
The auctionary process took several hours. 拍賣過程持續了幾個小時。
They reviewed the auctionary rules before bidding. 他們在投標前審查了拍賣規則。
To auctioneer means to sell at an auction; to auction. 對拍賣師來說，意味著在拍賣會上出售；拍賣。
People may auctioneer in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下進行拍賣。
The teacher used auctorial to describe the example. 老師用「創作觀點」來描述這個例子。
She chose an auctorial example for class. 她選了一個帶有創作觀點的課堂例子。
Aucuba japonica is a popular ornamental shrub. 日本桃葉珊瑚是一種受歡迎的觀賞灌木。
The Aucuba genus belongs to the family Garryaceae. 珊瑚珠屬屬於絲纓花科。
The glossy leaves of the aucuba brighten the garden. 桃葉珊瑚光滑的葉子讓花園顯得明亮。
She planted an aucuba in the shade. 她在陰涼處種了一棵桃葉珊瑚。
In ancient times, men would aucupate for food. 在古代，人們會捕鳥為食。
He tried to aucupate more votes for the upcoming election. 他試圖為即將到來的選舉獵取更多選票。

meaning: 大膽的；魯莽的；厚顏無恥的
sentences: The explorer made an audacious move into the unknown. 探險家大膽地進入了未知領域。
It was an audacious plan, but it worked. 這是一個大膽的計畫，但它奏效了。
He audaciously challenged the king's authority. 他大膽地挑戰了國王的權威。
The startup audaciously entered the competitive market. 這家初創公司大膽地進入了競爭激烈的市場。
The audaciousness of the theft shocked everyone. 這次盜竊的膽大妄為震驚了所有人。
She was admired for her audaciousness in business. 她因在商業上的大膽而受到讚賞。

meaning: 傲慢無禮，尤其是在不謹慎或非常規的情況下。
sentences: The brash private had the audacity to criticize the general. 這個傲慢的二等兵竟然厚顏無恥地批評將軍。
Somebody never pays his loans, yet he has the audacity to ask the bank for money. 有人從來不還他的貸款，他敢向銀行要錢。

meaning: 奧德派信徒（早期基督教的一支）
sentences: The Audaean movement was considered heretical by some. 奧德派運動被一些人認為是異端。
Audaean beliefs centered on a literal interpretation of the Bible. 奧德派的信仰集中在對聖經的字面解釋上。
He studied the history of the Audian sect. 他研究了奧德教派的歷史。
Audian theology was influenced by various early traditions. 奧德派神學受到多種早期傳統的影響。
Audibertia species are often found in dry regions. 奧氏鼠尾草屬物種常發現於乾旱地區。
The botanist identified the plant as a type of Audibertia. 植物學家將該植物鑑定為奧氏鼠尾草的一種。
The audibility of the speaker's voice was poor in the large hall. 在大廳裡，演講者聲音的可聞度很低。
Adjust the volume to improve audibility. 調整音量以提高可聞度。

meaning: 透過大聲喊出新的方式來改變爭球線的比賽方式。
sentences: The quarterback audibled after seeing the defensive formation. 四分衛看到防守陣型後出聲。
To audible means to change the play at the line of scrimmage by yelling out a new one. 聽得見意味著透過喊出新的方式來改變爭球線的比賽方式。
The audibleness of the recording was affected by background noise. 錄音的清晰度受到了背景噪音的影響。
They checked the audibleness of the siren from different locations. 他們從不同位置檢查了警報器的可聞性。
She sighed audibly, expressing her frustration. 她大聲地嘆了口氣，表達了她的沮喪。
He whispered, but not audibly enough for others to hear. 他低聲說話，但音量不足以讓其他人聽到。
The audience broke into applause at the end of the concert. 音樂會結束時，觀眾爆發出掌聲。
The television program attracts a large audience every week. 該電視節目每週吸引大量觀眾。
The audiencier called the court to order. 開庭官宣佈法庭開庭。
An audiencier is responsible for certain administrative tasks in court. 執法吏負責法院的某些行政任務。
The audience remained audient throughout the performance. 觀眾在整個表演過程中都傾耳細聽。
The priest spoke to an audient crowd. 牧師向傾聽的人群發言。
As an audile learner, he prefers listening to lectures. 作為聽覺型學習者，他更喜歡聽講座。
The audile imagery in the poem is very vivid. 詩中的聽覺意象非常生動。
The new mobile application provides high-quality audio recordings. 這款新行動應用程式提供高品質的音訊錄製。
Please check the audio settings on your computer before the call. 在通話前請檢查妳電腦上的音訊設置。
The mice suffered from audiogenic seizures. 這些小鼠遭受了聽源性癲癇發作。
Audiogenic stress can affect health. 聲音引起的壓力會影響健康。
The audiogram showed a significant hearing loss in high frequencies. 聽力圖顯示高頻部分有顯著的聽力損失。
The doctor explained the results of her audiogram. 醫生解釋了她的聽力圖結果。
The audiologist recommended a hearing aid. 聽力學家建議配戴助聽器。
She is a certified audiologist with years of experience. 她是一位擁有多年經驗的執業聽力學家。
Audiology is the study of hearing and balance disorders. 聽力學是研究聽力和平衡障礙的學科。
He decided to pursue a degree in audiology. 他決定攻讀聽力學學位。
The technician calibrated the audiometer before the test. 技術人員在測試前校準了聽力計。
An audiometer is used to measure hearing thresholds. 聽力計用於測量聽力閾值。
The workers underwent regular audiometric screening. 工人們接受了定期的聽力篩查。
Audiometric data helps in diagnosing ear conditions. 聽力測試數據有助於診斷耳朵狀況。
Audiometry is essential for monitoring noise-induced hearing loss. 測聽術對於監測噪音引起的聽力損失至關重要。
Modern audiometry involves sophisticated digital equipment. 現代測聽術涉及先進的數位設備。

meaning: 奧迪恩三極管（早期真空管）
sentences: The Audion was a crucial invention in the history of radio. 奧迪恩三極管是無線電歷史上的一項關鍵發明。
Lee de Forest patented the Audion in 1906. 李·德·佛瑞斯特於 1906 年獲得了奧迪恩三極管的專利。
Early amplifiers used the audion to boost signals. 早期的放大器使用真空管來增強信號。
The audion transformed telecommunications. 真空管改變了電信業。

meaning: 音響發燒友；愛好音樂者
sentences: The audiophile spent thousands on his sound system. 這位音響發燒友在音響系統上花費了數千美元。
Audiophiles prefer high-quality vinyl records. 音響發燒友更喜歡高品質的黑膠唱片。

meaning: 助聽器（一種早期的齒傳導裝置）
sentences: The audiphone was used by pressing it against the teeth. 助聽器是通過將其壓在牙齒上來使用的。
He collected antique medical devices, including an old audiphone. 他收集古董醫療設備，包括一個舊助聽器。

She decided to audit the history course to broaden her knowledge of the past. 她決定旁聽歷史課程以擴大對過去的了解。

meaning: 有抱負的表演者為了展現自己的適合性或才華而進行的表演。
sentences: I've been to five auditions this week. 這週我參加了五次試鏡。
The term audition refers to a performance, by an aspiring performer, to demonstrate suitability or talent. 試鏡一詞是指由有抱負的表演者進行的表演，以證明其適合性或才華。
The auditive cortex processes sound information. 聽覺皮層處理聲音信息。
He has strong auditive memory. 他有很強的聽覺記憶。

meaning: 在許多司法管轄區，選舉或任命的負責公共帳戶的公職人員；審計員。
sentences: The term auditor refers to in many jurisdictions, an elected or appointed public official in charge of the public accounts; a comptroller. 在許多司法管轄區，審計員一詞是指負責公共帳戶的民選或任命的公職人員；審計員。
The lesson introduced auditor as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了審計員這個易於理解的有用術語。

meaning: 禮堂；觀眾席（auditorium 的複數）
sentences: The university has several large auditoria. 大學有幾個大型禮堂。
Modern auditoria are designed with perfect acoustics. 現代禮堂的設計具有完美的音響效果。

meaning: 聽眾的；聽覺的；審核的（同 auditory）
sentences: The auditorial hum came from the crowded hall. 那種聽覺上的嗡嗡聲來自擁擠的大廳。
The speech had an auditorial quality that filled the room. 那段演說帶著很強的聽覺感，充滿整個房間。
The room felt small auditorially because of the echo. 因為迴音，那個房間在聽覺上顯得很小。
The speech was easy to follow auditorially. 那場演說在聽覺上很好理解。
The child was tested auditorily for any impairments. 該兒童接受了聽覺方面的缺陷測試。
He perceived the melody auditorily. 他通過聽覺感知了這段旋律。
The graduation ceremony was held in the university's large auditorium. 畢業典禮在大學的大禮堂舉行。
The auditorium was packed with eager fans waiting for the concert to start. 禮堂裡擠滿了等待音樂會開始的熱情歌迷。
During his auditorship, the company's records were meticulously kept. 在他擔任審計員期間，公司的記錄保存得非常細緻。
She applied for the vacant auditorship at the firm. 她申請了該公司空缺的審計員職位。

meaning: 屬於或與聽覺有關的或與聽覺的感覺或器官有關的。
sentences: Something described as auditory is of, or relating to hearing, or to the sense or organs of hearing. 被描述為聽覺的事物屬於或與聽覺有關，或與聽覺的感覺或器官有關。
The word auditory is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 聽覺這個字常用來描述人、事物或情況。
The auditress completed the financial report on time. 女審計員準時完成了財務報告。
One attentive auditress asked the speaker a question. 一位專心的女聽眾向演講者提出了一個問題。
The auditual perception of animals is often superior to humans. 動物的聽覺感知通常優於人類。
He researched auditual stimuli in psychology. 他研究了心理學中的聽覺刺激。
The school invested in new audivise equipment. 學校投資了新的視聽設備。
Audivise aids are helpful in language learning. 視聽教具對語言學習很有幫助。
The audiviser was used to present the educational video. 視聽器被用來播放教育影片。
They updated the audiviser in the conference room. 他們更新了會議室的視聽裝置。
Audivision is a powerful tool in modern classrooms. 視聽教學是現代教室中一種強大的工具。
The museum uses audivision to enhance the visitor experience. 博物館利用視聽技術來提升遊客體驗。
Audrey Hepburn was a famous actress. 奧黛麗·赫本是一位著名的女演員。
Audrey is a name of Old English origin. 奧黛麗是一個源自古英語的名字。

meaning: 奧杜邦式的（關於鳥類研究或保護的）
sentences: The painting has an Audubonistic quality in its detail. 這幅畫在細節上具有奧杜邦式的特質。
He dedicated his life to Audubonistic pursuits. 他致力於鳥類研究與保護的事業。

meaning: 阿韋托人（巴西原住民的一支）
sentences: The Aueto live in the Xingu National Park. 阿韋托人居住在興古國家公園。
We studied the social structure of the Aueto tribe. 我們研究了阿韋托部落的社會結構。
Auganite is a variety of volcanic rock. 輝石安山岩是一種火山岩。
The geologist found samples of auganite near the volcano. 地質學家在火山附近發現了輝石安山岩樣本。

meaning: 【地】眼狀構造；（礦脈的）膨大部分
sentences: The rock features a distinct auge structure. 該岩石具有明顯的眼狀構造。
He examined the auge in the quartz vein. 他檢查了石英脈中的膨大部分。

meaning: 奧革阿斯的；極骯髒的；極困難的
sentences: Cleaning up the corruption was an Augean task. 清除腐敗是一項極其艱巨的任務。
The Augean stables were legendary for their filth. 奧革阿斯的牛圈因其骯髒而聞名傳奇。
Augelite is a phosphate mineral containing aluminum. 鋁磷石是一種含有鋁的磷酸鹽礦物。
The crystal structure of augelite is monoclinic. 鋁磷石的晶體結構是單斜晶系的。

meaning: 【地】眼狀物（複數，常指變質岩中的大晶體）
sentences: Augen gneiss is characterized by eye-shaped mineral grains. 眼狀片麻岩的特點是具有眼狀的礦物顆粒。
The geologist noted the presence of large feldspar augen. 地質學家注意到了大型長石眼狀物的存在。
In the equation 5 + 3 = 8, 5 is the augend. 在等式 5 + 3 = 8 中，5 是被加數。
The teacher explained the difference between an augend and an addend. 老師解釋了被加數和加數之間的區別。
He used an auger to drill holes for the fence posts. 他用螺絲鑽鑽孔來固定籬笆柱子。
The ice auger cut through the frozen lake easily. 冰鑽輕鬆地切穿了結冰的湖面。

meaning: 鑽孔者；使用鑽孔機的人
sentences: The augerer worked steadily throughout the afternoon. 鑽孔工人整個下午都在穩定地工作。
As an experienced augerer, he knew how to handle the machine safely. 作為一名經驗豐富的鑽孔者，他知道如何安全地操作機器。

meaning: （表示厭惡、輕蔑或不滿的感嘆詞）
sentences: Augh! I forgot my keys again. 喔！我又忘了帶鑰匙。
Augh, this food tastes terrible. 呸，這食物味道真糟糕。

meaning: 任何事物；（用作副詞）在任何程度上；零
sentences: For aught I know, he has already left. 據我所知，他已經離開了。
The temperature was aught degrees this morning. 今天早上的溫度是零度。
Is he aughtlins better today? 他今天好點了嗎？
I don't care aughtlins about it. 我一點也不在乎。
Augite is a common rock-forming mineral in igneous rocks. 普通輝石是火成岩中常見的造岩礦物。
The dark crystals in the basalt were identified as augite. 玄武岩中的黑色晶體被鑑定為普通輝石。
The augitic composition of the lava was analyzed. 岩漿的輝石成分受到了分析。
He studied the augitic minerals in the lunar samples. 他研究了月球樣本中的輝石礦物。
Augitite is an extrusive volcanic rock. 輝石岩是一種噴出型火山岩。
The formation consists largely of augitite. 該地層主要由輝石岩組成。
Augitophyre has large crystals of augite in a finer matrix. 輝石斑岩在細密的基質中含有大型輝石晶體。
The sample was classified as augitophyre by the mineralogist. 礦物學家將該樣本分類為輝石斑岩。
The money from renting out a spare room can augment a salary. 出租閒置房間的錢可以增加薪水。

sentences: The term aurora refers to the dawn or early morning light itself; the first light of day. 極光一詞指的是黎明或清晨的光本身；天的第一道陽光。

Solar flares are the primary cause of intense aurorae on Earth. 太陽耀斑是地球上產生強烈極光的主要原因。
The auroral display painted the sky in shades of green and purple. 極光的展示將天空染成了綠色和紫色的色調。
Auroral activity is more frequent during the solar maximum. 在太陽活動極大期，極光活動更為頻繁。
The horizon was aurorally lit just before the sun rose. 就在太陽升起之前，地平線像曙光般被照亮了。
The glowing gas shimmered aurorally in the laboratory chamber. 發光的氣體在實驗室的腔室中閃爍著極光般的光芒。
The early bird catch the worm at the first sign of aurore. 早起的鳥兒在黎明初現時捕捉蟲子。
She loved to watch the aurore from her balcony every morning. 她喜歡每天早上在陽台上觀看黎明。
The aurorean light filtered through the forest canopy. 黎明的曙光透過森林的樹冠過濾下來。
He had an aurorean freshness about him after his morning run. 晨跑後，他身上散發出一種黎明般的清新感。

meaning: 極光的；黎明的（有時指特定時代或文化）
sentences: The Aurorian myths often feature celestial spirits dancing in the sky. 極光神話中經常描繪在天空中跳舞的神靈。
Researchers studied the Aurorian patterns recorded by ancient observers. 研究人員研究了古代觀察者記錄的極光模式。

meaning: 極光元素（曾被假想存在於極光中的物質）
sentences: Early scientists proposed the existence of aurorium to explain the green line in the spectrum. 早期科學家提出了「極光元素」的存在來解釋光譜中的綠線。
The hypothesis of aurorium was later replaced by the understanding of oxygen transitions. 極光元素的假說後來被對氧躍遷的理解所取代。
Aurotellurite is a rare mineral found in gold deposits. 碲金礦是在金礦床中發現的一種稀有礦物。
The museum's mineral collection includes a small sample of aurotellurite. 博物館的礦物收藏包括一小份碲金礦樣本。
Sodium aurothiosulphate has been used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis. 硫代硫酸金鈉已被用於治療類風濕性關節炎。
The patient was monitored for side effects while receiving aurothiosulphate injections. 患者在接受硫代硫酸金鹽注射時，醫護人員會監測其副作用。
Aurothiosulphuric acid is an intermediate in some chemical processes. 硫代硫酸金酸是某些化學過程中的中間體。
The stability of the aurothiosulphuric complex depends on the pH of the solution. 硫代硫酸金配合物的穩定性取決於溶液的 pH 值。
The teacher used aurous to describe the example. 老師用「一價金」來描述這個例子。
She chose an aurous example for class. 她選了一個「一價金」的課堂例子。
The crowd applauded the aurrescu at the wedding. 婚禮上，群眾為巴斯克傳統舞歡呼。
He learned the aurrescu from his uncle. 他跟叔叔學了巴斯克傳統舞。
The queen wore an aurulent gown that shimmered with every step. 女王穿著一件金色的長袍，每走一步都閃閃發光。
The aurulent light of the afternoon sun warmed the ancient stone walls. 午後金色的陽光溫暖了古老的石牆。

meaning: 金（化學元素符號 Au 的來源）
sentences: Aurum is the Latin word for gold. Aurum 是拉丁語中「金」的意思。
In alchemy, aurum was considered the most perfect of metals. 在煉金術中，金被認為是金屬中最完美的。
The aurure of the setting sun was reflected in the calm lake. 落日金色的光輝反射在平靜的湖面上。
He captured the subtle aurure of the autumn forest in his painting. 他在畫作中捕捉到了秋季森林微妙的金黃色調。
The auryl group is present in certain complex gold compounds. 金醯基存在於某些複雜的金化合物中。
Researchers studied the reactivity of the auryl radical in organic synthesis. 研究人員研究了金醯基自由基在有機合成中的反應活性。
He is planning a trip to Aus next summer to visit his cousins. 他計劃明年夏天去澳洲看望他的表親。
Aussie is a common slang term for someone from Aus. Aussie 是對來自澳洲的人的常見俚語稱呼。
Auscult helped the doctor hear the murmur at the bedside. 聽診讓醫生在床邊聽見雜音。
The resident practiced auscult during rounds. 住院醫師在查房時練習聽診。

meaning: 聽診鏡（用於觀察聽診波形的儀器）
sentences: The specialist used an auscultascope to analyze the patient's heart rhythm. 專家使用聽診鏡來分析患者的心律。
Modern auscultascopes can record and store sound data for later review. 現代聽診鏡可以記錄和存儲聲音數據，以便日後查看。
It is important to auscultate the abdomen when diagnosing digestive issues. 診斷消化系統問題時，聽診腹部很重要。
The nurse began to auscultate the patient's chest during the routine checkup. 護士在例行檢查中開始聽診患者的胸部。
Auscultation is a fundamental diagnostic technique in medicine. 聽診是醫學中一項基本的診斷技術。
Through auscultation, the doctor detected a slight heart murmur. 通過聽診，醫生檢測到了輕微的心臟雜音。
The auscultative findings were consistent with a diagnosis of pneumonia. 聽診結果與肺炎的診斷一致。
He focused on the auscultative aspects of the physical examination. 他專注於體格檢查中聽診的部分。
As an experienced auscultator, the physician could identify subtle sounds. 作為一名經驗豐富的聽診者，醫生可以辨別出細微的聲音。
The ancient auscultator was much simpler than modern stethoscopes. 古代的聽診工具比現代的聽診器要簡單得多。
The auscultatory gap can sometimes lead to an incorrect blood pressure reading. 聽診間隙有時會導致血壓讀數不正確。
Medical students practice their auscultatory skills on simulated patients. 醫學生在模擬病人身上練習他們的聽診技巧。

meaning: 聽診鏡（商標名或特定類型）
sentences: The clinic recently purchased a high-tech Auscultoscope for the cardiology department. 診所最近為心臟科購買了一台高科技聽診鏡。
The Auscultoscope provides visual representation of heart sounds. 聽診鏡提供心音的視覺化表示。
The doctor reached for the auscultoscope. 醫生伸手去拿聽診鏡。
An old auscultoscope hung in the clinic museum. 診所博物館裡掛著一支老式聽診鏡。

meaning: 阿夫沙爾（伊朗的一個部落或地名）
sentences: The Aushar people are known for their beautiful hand-woven carpets. 阿夫沙爾人以其美麗的手織地毯而聞名。
The history of the Aushar tribe is rich with nomadic traditions. 阿夫沙爾部落的歷史充滿了游牧傳統。
In German, voiced consonants often become voiceless in the auslaut. 在德語中，濁輔音在詞尾音時通常會變成清輔音。
Linguists study the auslaut of words to understand phonetic shifts. 語言學家研究單詞的詞尾音以了解語音變化。

meaning: 語尾音（複數或特定形式）
sentences: The researcher analyzed the auslaute of various dialects. 研究人員分析了各種方言的詞尾音。
Changes in the auslaute can significantly affect the rhythm of a language. 詞尾音的變化會顯著影響一種語言的節奏。

meaning: 奧索尼人（古義大利的一個民族）
sentences: The Ausones were an ancient Italic people who lived in the southern part of the peninsula. 奧索尼人是居住在義大利半島南部的古義大利民族。
Little is known about the language and customs of the Ausones. 對於奧索尼人的語言和習俗知之甚少。

meaning: 奧索尼人的；義大利的（詩意稱法）
sentences: The poet referred to the beautiful Ausonian landscapes in his verses. 詩人在他的詩句中提到了美麗的義大利風景。
Ausonian culture had a significant impact on early Roman traditions. 奧索尼文化對早期羅馬傳統產生了重大影響。
The auspex observed the flight of birds to interpret the will of the gods. 占卜官觀察鳥類的飛行以解讀神靈的旨意。
Decisions about war and peace often required the consultation of an auspex. 關於戰爭與和平的決定通常需要諮詢占卜官。
They gathered to auspicate the new venture with a traditional ceremony. 他們聚集在一起，通過傳統儀式為這項新事業拉開序幕。
The favorable weather seemed to auspicate a successful harvest. 良好的天氣似乎預示著大豐收。
The concert was held under the auspice of the local arts council. 音樂會在當地藝術委員會的贊助下舉行。
Finding a four-leaf clover was considered a good auspice for the journey. 找到一片四葉草被認為是旅程的好兆頭。
The study was conducted under the auspices of the World Health Organization. 該研究是在世界衛生組織的資助下進行的。
The ancient Romans relied on the auspices to guide their political decisions. 古羅馬人依靠占卜來指導他們的政治決策。
The auspicial signs were carefully recorded by the priests. 占卜的跡象被祭司們仔細記錄了下來。
He had an auspicial feeling about the outcome of the competition. 他對比賽的結果有一種預兆感。
This is an auspicious day. 這是一個吉祥的日子。
The report describes the result as auspicious. 報告稱這一結果是吉祥的。
The project began auspiciously with a large grant from the government. 該項目在政府的一大筆資助下順利開始。
They were auspiciously met with sunny skies on their wedding day. 他們的婚禮當天幸運地遇到了晴朗的天空。
The auspiciousness of the date was a key factor in choosing it for the ceremony. 日期的吉利是選擇它進行儀式的一個關鍵因素。
Many cultures have symbols that represent auspiciousness and prosperity. 許多文化都有代表吉祥和繁榮的符號。
The success of the mission was predicted through careful auspicy. 通過仔細的占卜預測了任務的成功。
Auspicy played a major role in the religious life of ancient civilizations. 占卜在古代文明的宗教生活中發揮了重要作用。
The Aussie athlete won a gold medal in the swimming competition. 那位澳洲運動員在游泳比賽中獲得了金牌。
We enjoyed a classic Aussie barbecue at the beach. 我們在海邊享用了一頓經典的澳洲燒烤。
The museum featured an exhibit on Austafrican flora and fauna. 博物館展出了關於南非動植物的展覽。
Austafrican history is complex and diverse. 南非的歷史複雜且多元。
Austenite is a non-magnetic solid solution of carbon in iron. 奧氏體是碳在鐵中的非磁性固溶體。
The formation of austenite occurs at high temperatures during the steel-making process. 奧氏體的形成發生在煉鋼過程中的高溫階段。
Austenitic stainless steels are known for their excellent corrosion resistance. 奧氏體不鏽鋼以其優異的耐腐蝕性而聞名。
The engineer selected an austenitic alloy for the aerospace component. 工程師為航空航天組件選擇了一種奧氏體合金。

meaning: 南風（希臘及羅馬神話中的南風之神）
sentences: Auster brought the warm, moist winds of summer to the region. 奧斯特給該地區帶來了夏季溫暖潮濕的南風。
In classical poetry, Auster is often associated with rain and storms. 在古典詩歌中，奧斯特通常與雨水和風暴聯繫在一起。

meaning: 態度或外表冷酷或嚴厲。
sentences: The headmistress was an austere old woman. 校長是一位認真的老婦人。
The report describes the result as austere. 報告稱結果是嚴峻的。

The austereness of the landscape reflected the harsh climate. 風景的荒涼反映了惡劣的氣候。
She was known for her austereness and dedication to her work. 她以嚴謹和對工作的奉獻而聞名。

meaning: 舉止或生活的嚴肅性；極為嚴格或嚴格；嚴厲的紀律。
sentences: The term austerity refers to severity of manners or life; extreme rigor or strictness; harsh discipline. 節儉一詞指的是舉止或生活的嚴格性。極度嚴格或嚴格；嚴厲的紀律。
The lesson introduced austerity as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了緊縮作為一個值得理解的有用術語。

meaning: 奧斯特里茨（著名的戰役發生地）
sentences: The Battle of Austerlitz was one of Napoleon's greatest victories. 奧斯特里茨戰役是拿破崙最偉大的勝利之一。
Historians study the strategy used at Austerlitz to understand Napoleonic warfare. 歷史學家研究奧斯特里茨戰役中使用的策略，以了解拿破崙戰爭。

meaning: 奧斯汀（男子名；美國德州首府）
sentences: Austin is known for its vibrant music scene and outdoor activities. 奧斯汀以其充滿活力的音樂氛圍和戶外活動而聞名。
Her younger brother was named Austin after their grandfather. 她的弟弟隨他祖父的名字命名為奧斯汀。
The Austral summer occurs during the months of December, January, and February. 南半球的夏天發生在十二月、一月和二月。
He worked for an Austral airline for several years. 他在一家澳洲航空公司工作了幾年。
Many species of penguins are found in the austral regions of the globe. 許多種類的企鵝分佈在地球的南方地區。
The austral winds brought cooler temperatures to the coastal city. 南風給這座沿海城市帶來了較涼爽的溫度。

meaning: 澳大拉西亞的；澳大拉西亞人
sentences: The Australasian region includes Australia, New Zealand, and neighboring islands. 澳大拉西亞地區包括澳洲、紐西蘭及其鄰近島嶼。
She is an Australasian scholar specializing in Pacific history. 她是一位專門研究太平洋歷史的澳大拉西亞學者。
Australene is a chemical compound found in certain types of essential oils. 澳洲烯是在某些類型的精油中發現的一種化合物。
Chemists used the term australene before pinene became the standard name. 在蒎烯成為標準名稱之前，化學家使用澳洲烯這個術語。
Australia is both a country and a continent located in the Southern Hemisphere. 澳洲既是一個國家，也是一個位於南半球的大陸。
The Great Barrier Reef is one of Australia's most famous natural wonders. 大堡礁是澳洲最著名的自然奇觀之一。
The Australian accent is easily recognizable around the world. 澳洲口音在世界各地都很容易辨認。
An Australian scientist led the research team in the Antarctic. 一位澳洲科學家帶領研究小組在南極進行研究。
The phrase was an Australianism she used at home. 那句話是她在家常用的澳洲用語。
The article listed local Australianism and slang. 文章列出當地的澳洲用語和俚語。
The company decided to Australianize its marketing strategy for the local market. 公司決定將其營銷策略澳洲化以適應當地市場。
He quickly began to Australianize his speech after moving to Sydney. 搬到雪梨後，他很快就開始使他的談話澳洲化。
The Australic currents influence the climate of the southern islands. 澳洲洋流影響著南方島嶼的氣候。
Researchers studied the Australic origins of certain plant species. 研究人員研究了某些植物物種的澳洲起源。
The fossils showed Australioid characteristics in the skull structure. 化石在頭骨結構中顯示出類澳洲人種的特徵。
Anthropologists discussed the distribution of Australioid populations in ancient times. 人類學家討論了古代類澳洲人種種群的分佈。
Australite is a type of tektite found primarily in southern Australia. 澳洲玻隕石是一種主要在南澳發現的玻隕石。
Collectors prize australite for its unique button-like shape. 收藏家因澳洲玻隕石獨特的紐扣狀形狀而對其珍視。
The Australoid physical features are distinctive among human populations. 澳洲人種的體質特徵在人類群體中是獨特的。
Early theories of human migration focused on the spread of Australoid groups. 早期的人類遷徙理論側重於澳洲人種群體的擴散。
The Australopithecinae include several species of extinct hominids. 南方古猿亞科包括幾種已滅絕的人科動物。
Fossils of Australopithecinae have provided valuable insights into human evolution. 南方古猿亞科的化石為人類進化提供了寶貴的見解。
The australopithecine fossils were discovered in various parts of Africa. 南方古猿化石在非洲各處被發現。
Scientists analyzed the australopithecine diet based on dental wear. 科學家根據牙齒磨損分析了南方古猿的飲食。
Australopithecus afarensis is one of the most famous species in this genus. 阿法南方古猿是該屬中最著名的物種之一。
The skeleton known as 'Lucy' belongs to the genus Australopithecus. 被稱為「露西」的骨架屬於南方古猿屬。

meaning: 奧平頓雞（澳洲育成的雞種）
sentences: The Australorp is a popular breed of chicken known for its high egg production. 奧平頓雞是一個受歡迎的雞種，以其高產蛋量而聞名。
We decided to raise Australorps in our backyard for fresh eggs. 我們決定在後院飼養奧平頓雞以獲取新鮮雞蛋。

meaning: 奧斯特拉西亞的；奧斯特拉西亞人（法蘭克王國東部）
sentences: The Austrasian kingdom was a major power during the Merovingian period. 奧斯特拉西亞王國是墨洛溫王朝時期的一個主要勢力。

The policy aimed to Austrianize the administration of the newly acquired territory. 該政策旨在使新獲得領土的行政管理奧地利化。
