Linguists study the connections between various Austric branches. 語言學家研究澳斯特利克語系各分支之間的聯繫。

meaning: （曾被誤認為是新元素的）假想金屬
sentences: The chemist once thought austrium was a new metal. 化學家曾一度以為奧斯特里姆是一種新金屬。
Today, austrium survives only in the old notebooks. 如今，奧斯特里姆只存在於舊筆記裡。
Vietnamese and Khmer are two prominent Austroasiatic languages. 越南語和高棉語是兩種著名的南亞語系語言。
The Austroasiatic group is one of the oldest language families in mainland Southeast Asia. 南亞語系是東南亞大陸最古老的語系之一。
Austrogaea is characterized by its unique marsupial fauna. 澳洲動物地理區的特徵是其獨特的有袋動物群。
The isolation of Austrogaea led to the evolution of many endemic species. 澳洲動物地理區的隔離導致了許多特有物種的進化。
The Austrogaean realm includes Australia, Tasmania, and New Guinea. 澳洲動物地理區包括澳洲、塔斯馬尼亞和新幾內亞。
Biologists study Austrogaean ecosystems to understand evolutionary isolation. 生物學家研究澳洲動物地理區的生態系統，以了解進化的隔離。
Austromancy was used by ancient seers to predict future events based on the wind. 古代的先知使用風占卜來根據風向預測未來事件。
He studied old texts about austromancy to learn about ancient divination practices. 他研究了關於風占卜的古籍，以了解古代的占卜習俗。

meaning: 南島語系的；南島語系人
sentences: The Austronesian migration covered a vast area from Madagascar to Easter Island. 南島民族的遷徙覆蓋了從馬達加斯加到復活節島的廣大地區。

The autohemolysis test is used to diagnose certain blood disorders. 自體溶血測試用於診斷某些血液疾病。

The autoheterodyne circuit is used in some radio receivers. 自差電路用於某些無線電接收機中。
He explained the principles of autoheterodyne detection. 他解釋了自差檢測的原理。

The researcher studied the effects of autoheterosis on crop yield. 研究人員研究了同源雜種優勢對作物產量的影響。
An autohexaploid organism has six sets of chromosomes from the same species. 同源六倍體生物具有來自同一物種的六套染色體。
The study examined the chromosomal stability of the autohexaploid line. 該研究檢查了同源六倍體品系的染色體穩定性。
Autohybridization is a technique used in molecular biology. 自體雜交是分子生物學中使用的一項技術。
The results of the autohybridization experiment were inconclusive. 自體雜交實驗的結果尚無定論。
He used autohypnosis to help overcome his fear of flying. 他使用自我催眠來幫助克服對飛行的恐懼。
Autohypnosis is a state of deep relaxation achieved through self-suggestion. 自我催眠是通過自我暗示達到的一種深度放鬆狀態。
The patient was guided into an autohypnotic trance. 患者被引導進入自我催眠的恍惚狀態。
Autohypnotic techniques can be used for pain management. 自我催眠技術可以用於疼痛管理。
She studied autohypnotism to improve her concentration. 她學習自我催眠術以提高注意力。
Autohypnotism is often used in alternative therapy. 自我催眠術常用於替代療法。
The process of autohypnotization requires practice and patience. 自我催眠過程需要練習和耐心。
Autohypnotization can lead to a heightened state of awareness. 自我催眠可以導致意識狀態的增強。

meaning: 同株異苞的（指苔蘚類植物）
sentences: The autoicous moss has male and female reproductive organs on the same plant but in separate branches. 這種同株異苞苔蘚的雌雄生殖器官在同一植株上，但位於不同的分枝。
Botanists identified the sample as autoicous after checking its reproductive structures. 植物學家檢查生殖構造後，判定這個樣本是同株異苞的。
The autoignition temperature of the fuel is a critical safety parameter. 燃料的自燃溫度是一個關鍵的安全參數。
Autoignition can occur if the mixture is heated above its flash point. 如果混合物被加熱到閃點以上，可能會發生自燃。

Scientists are researching ways to prevent harmful autoimmunization. 科學家們正在研究預防有害自體免疫作用的方法。

The physician adjusted the dosage due to the patient's autoinduction. 由於患者的自誘導，醫生調整了劑量。
The autoinductive properties of the substance were studied in the lab. 該物質的自誘導特性在實驗室中進行了研究。
Autoinductive signals play a role in bacterial quorum sensing. 自誘導信號在細菌群體感應中起作用。
Autoinfection can happen if parasites from one part of the body spread to another. 如果寄生蟲從身體的一個部位傳播到另一個部位，就可能發生自身感染。
Proper hygiene is essential to prevent autoinfection. 良好的衛生習慣對於預防自身感染至關重要。
Autoinfusion of the patient's own blood was performed during the surgery. 手術期間對患者進行了自體血液回輸。
The technique of autoinfusion reduces the need for donor blood. 自體回輸技術減少了對捐贈血液的需求。
The enzyme is autoinhibited in its default state. 該酶在默認狀態下是自抑制的。
Relieving the autoinhibited state activates the protein. 解除自抑制狀態會激活蛋白質。
The virus is autoinoculable through skin contact. 該病毒可以通過皮膚接觸進行自身接種。
Warts are often autoinoculable to other parts of the body. 疣通常會自身接種到身體的其他部位。
Autoinoculation is the spread of infection from one site to another on the same body. 自身接種是感染在同一個身體上從一個部位傳播到另一個部位。
He accidentally caused autoinoculation by scratching the infected area. 他因抓撓受感染區域而不小心導致了自身接種。

meaning: 自發智慧的；自我認知的
sentences: The autointellectual development of the child was remarkable. 孩子的自發智慧發展非常顯著。

An autolater is someone who excessively admires themselves. 自我崇拜者是過度崇拜自己的人。

meaning: 自我研究者；自體學專家
sentences: As an autologist, he focused his career on the study of selfhood. 作為一名自我研究者，他的職業生涯專注於對自我的研究。

The automatization of the factory led to increased productivity. 工廠的自動化導致了生產力的提高。

meaning: 自動記錄儀；無意識動作記錄儀

meaning: 自動機器；機器人；機械行動者
sentences: The clock features an automaton that strikes the hour. 這座時鐘有一個整點報時的自動機器。

Autopsical procedures are conducted with great care and respect. 屍體解剖程序是在非常小心和尊重的基礎上進行的。

meaning: 對屍體進行解剖以找出可能的死亡原因。
sentences: The autopsy revealed he had died of multiple bullet wounds. 驗屍顯示他死於多處槍傷。
The term autopsy refers to a dissection performed on a cadaver to find possible cause(s) of death. 屍檢一詞是指對屍體進行解剖以找出可能的死亡原因。
Autopsychic orientation refers to a person's awareness of their own identity. 自我心理定向是指一個人對其自身身份的意識。
The patient suffered from autopsychic delusions. 患者患有自我心理妄想。
Freud famously practiced autopsychoanalysis on himself. 佛洛伊德著名地對自己進行了自我心理分析。
Autopsychoanalysis can be a challenging but rewarding process. 自我心理分析可能是一個充滿挑戰但有回報的過程。
Autopsychology focuses on the individual's subjective experience of self. 自我心理學專注於個人對自我的主觀體驗。
He wrote a treatise on the principles of autopsychology. 他寫了一篇關於自我心理學原理的論文。

meaning: 自我心理律動（一種精神狀態）
sentences: Autopsychorhythmia involves the repetition of certain thoughts or actions in the mind. 自我心理律動涉及在腦海中重複某些想法或行動。
The condition of autopsychorhythmia was described in early psychiatric literature. 自我心理律動的狀況在早期的精神病學文獻中有所描述。

meaning: 自我心理病；自發性精神病
sentences: Autopsychosis is a mental disorder where the person's awareness of self is disturbed. 自我心理病是一種人的自我意識受到干擾的精神障礙。
The therapist specialized in treating patients with autopsychosis. 治療師專門治療患有自我心理病的患者。
The scientist insisted on an autoptic verification of the findings. 科學家堅持要對發現進行親自觀察驗證。
Autoptic evidence is often the most reliable in court. 親自觀察的證據在法庭上通常是最可靠的。
The phenomenon was autoptically confirmed by several witnesses. 該現象得到了幾位證人的親自觀察證實。
The cause of death was autoptically determined. 死因是通過屍體解剖確定的。

meaning: 親自觀察的性質；自見性
sentences: The autopticity of the report made it very convincing. 報告的自見性使其非常有說服力。
He emphasized the importance of autopticity in scientific research. 他強調了科學研究中親自觀察的重要性。
Autopyotherapy is an obsolete medical treatment using a patient's own pus. 自體膿液療法是一種使用患者自身膿液的過時醫療方法。
History books mention autopyotherapy as a precursor to modern immunology. 歷史書提到自體膿液療法是現代免疫學的前身。
Autoracemization occurs when an optically active substance loses its activity over time. 當光學活性物質隨著時間的推移失去其活性時，就會發生自外消旋作用。
The stability of the compound was affected by autoracemization. 該化合物的穩定性受到自外消旋作用的影響。
An autoradiograph is an image produced by the radiation from a substance within the object. 放射顯影圖是由物體內物質產生的放射線所形成的圖像。
The scientist examined the autoradiograph to locate the radioactive tracer. 科學家檢查了放射顯影圖以定位放射性追蹤劑。
Autoradiographic techniques are used to study biological processes at the molecular level. 放射顯影技術用於在分子水平上研究生物過程。
The autoradiographic analysis provided detailed information about the sample. 放射顯影分析提供了關於樣本的詳細資訊。
Autoradiography is a powerful tool in molecular biology and medicine. 放射顯影法是分子生物學和醫學中的強大工具。
The development of autoradiography has revolutionized the study of DNA replication. 放射顯影法的發展徹底改變了 DNA 複製的研究。
Autoreduction occurs when a substance acts as its own reducing agent. 當一種物質充當其自身的還原劑時，就會發生自還原作用。
The chemical reaction involved a step of autoreduction. 該化學反應涉及一個自還原步驟。
The system is equipped with an autoregenerator to recycle waste heat. 該系統配備了一個自動再生器來回收廢熱。
Installing an autoregenerator can significantly improve energy efficiency. 安裝自動再生器可以顯著提高能源效率。
Autoregulation is the ability of an organ to maintain constant blood flow despite changes in pressure. 自我調節是器官在壓力變化下保持恆定血流量的能力。
The brain's autoregulation mechanism protects it from sudden changes in blood pressure. 大腦的自我調節機制保護其免受血壓突然變化的影響。
Autoreinfusion was used to replace the blood lost during the operation. 自體回輸被用來補充手術中流失的血液。
The medical team prepared the equipment for autoreinfusion. 醫療團隊準備了用於自體回輸的設備。
Autoretardation can slow down a chemical reaction as it progresses. 自阻滯作用會隨著化學反應的進行而使其減慢。
The chemist studied the factors contributing to autoretardation. 化學家研究了導致自阻滯作用的因素。

meaning: 自律律動的；自動跳動的
sentences: Cardiac muscle cells are autorhythmic and can beat without external signals. 心肌細胞具有自律律動性，可以在沒有外部信號的情況下跳動。
The autorhythmic nature of the heart is essential for maintaining life. 心臟的自律律動性對於維持生命至關重要。
Autorhythmus is the inherent rhythm of certain biological systems. 自律律動是某些生物系統固有的節律。
The study focused on the origins of autorhythmus in the embryonic heart. 該研究聚焦於胚胎心臟中自律律動的起源。

meaning: 授權者（通常指自動授權系統）
sentences: The electronic autoriser validated the credit card transaction. 電子授權系統驗證了信用卡交易。
Access was granted by the central autoriser. 中央授權者批准了訪問權限。
Autorotation allows a helicopter to land safely if the engine fails. 自旋允許直升機在發動機失效時安全降落。
The pilot practiced autorotation during his flight training. 飛行員在飛行培訓期間練習了自旋。
Autorrhaphy is a surgical procedure that uses the patient's own tissue as suture material. 自體縫合是一種使用患者自身組織作為縫合材料的手術程序。
The surgeon decided to use autorrhaphy for the delicate repair. 外科醫生決定使用自體縫合進行精細的修復。
Autosauri is a group that includes many common lizard species. 真蜥類是一個包括許多常見蜥蜴物種的群體。
The researcher specialized in the evolution of the Autosauri. 研究人員專攻真蜥類的進化。
Autosauria is a taxonomic group used in some classifications of reptiles. 真蜥類是某些爬行動物分類中使用的分類群。
The museum's collection features several skeletons from the Autosauria group. 博物館的館藏中有幾具來自真蜥類群體的骨骼。
His performance was a brilliant display of autoschediasm. 他的表演是即興創作的精彩展示。
The plan was criticized for being an act of autoschediasm without proper planning. 該計劃因未經妥善規劃、草率從事而受到批評。
The comedian's autoschediastic performance was surprisingly professional. 這位喜劇演員即席的表演令人驚訝地專業。
He is known for his autoschediastic speaking style. 他以即席演講的風格聞名。
The essay was an autoschediastical piece written in an hour. 這篇文章是他在一小時內隨意完成的即席之作。
Her autoschediastical remarks were quite insightful. 她即席的評論相當有見地。
He spoke autoschediastically during the meeting. 他在會議中即席發言。
She handled the difficult questions autoschediastically. 她無準備地處理了那些困難的問題。
The poet had to autoschediaze a few verses for the occasion. 詩人不得不為那個場合即席創作幾行詩。
When the script was lost, the actors had to autoschediaze. 當劇本丟失時，演員們不得不即興表演。

meaning: 自我科學；關於自我的科學研究
sentences: Autoscience focuses on the study of one's own consciousness. 自我科學專注於對自身意識的研究。
He published a paper on the philosophy of autoscience. 他發表了一篇關於自我科學哲學的論文。
The autoscope is used for self-examination of the throat. 自檢鏡用於喉部自檢。
The technician adjusted the autoscope for the experiment. 技術人員為實驗調整了自動觀察器。

meaning: 幻覺性自視的；幻身幻覺的
sentences: The patient described an autoscopic experience where he saw his own body. 患者描述了一種看到自己身體的幻覺性自視經驗。
Autoscopic phenomena are often studied in neurology. 幻身幻覺現象在神經病學中經常被研究。
Autoscopy is the experience of seeing one's own body from an external perspective. 自視是從外部角度看到自己身體的經驗。
Some near-death experiences involve autoscopy. 一些瀕死經驗涉及幻身幻覺。
The autosender transmits data packets every hour. 自動發射機每小時傳輸一次數據包。
A faulty autosender caused the signal loss. 故障的自動發射機導致了訊號丟失。

meaning: 自身致敏；自體免疫反應
sentences: Autosensitization can lead to chronic skin inflammation. 自身致敏可能導致慢性皮膚炎症。
The researcher is studying the mechanism of autosensitization. 研究人員正在研究自身致敏的機制。
The patient was found to be autosensitized to certain proteins. 發現患者對某些蛋白質產生了自身致敏。
Autosensitized cells react against the body's own tissues. 自身致敏的細胞會對身體自身的組織產生反應。
Autosepticemia is a rare medical condition. 自身敗血症是一種罕見的醫療狀況。
The doctor monitored the patient for signs of autosepticemia. 醫生監測患者是否有自身敗血症的徵兆。
Autoserotherapy involves injecting a patient with their own serum. 自體血清療法涉及給患者注射自己的血清。
The effectiveness of autoserotherapy is still being debated. 自體血清療法的有效性仍在辯論中。
The autoserum was prepared in the laboratory. 自體血清是在實驗室中準備的。
They used autoserum to treat the patient's condition. 他們使用自體血清來治療患者的病情。
Autosexing breeds allow farmers to distinguish chicks by color. 自動性別鑑定品種讓農民可以通過顏色區分雛雞。
The autosexing trait is useful for commercial poultry production. 自動性別鑑定特徵對商業家禽生產非常有用。
The rifle is equipped with an advanced autosight. 步槍配備了先進的自動瞄準器。
He adjusted the autosight before the competition. 他在比賽前調整了自動瞄準器。
The system uses an autosign feature for all outgoing emails. 該系統對所有發出的電子郵件使用自動簽署功能。
The autosign at the crossing warned of an approaching train. 路口的自動信號警告有火車駛近。

meaning: 自體寄生胎；獨立發育胎兒
sentences: In conjoined twins, the autosite is the more fully developed individual. 在連體嬰中，自體寄生胎是發育更完整的個體。
The biological study focused on the autosite's development. 生物學研究集中在自體寄生胎的發育上。
The autositic twin provided nutrients to the smaller parasite. 自體寄生胎雙胞胎為較小的寄生胎提供營養。
Scientists analyzed the autositic structure of the organism. 科學家分析了該生物的自體寄生結構。
The autoskeleton provides structural support to the organism. 自體骨骼為生物體提供結構支撐。
Research into the autoskeleton revealed unique calcification patterns. 對自體骨骼的研究揭示了獨特的鈣化模式。
They traveled across the tundra in an autosled. 他們乘坐自動雪橇穿越苔原。
The autosled was powered by a small engine. 自動雪橇由一台小引擎驅動。
The engineer monitored the autoslip of the conveyor belt. 工程師監測輸送帶的自動滑動。
Autoslip can occur if the friction is too low. 如果摩擦力太低，可能會發生自動滑流。
The trait was autosomal and appeared in both sexes. 這個性狀是常染色體的，男女都可能出現。
The lab checked whether the mutation was autosomal or sex-linked. 實驗室檢查這個突變是常染色體遺傳還是性聯遺傳。
Autosomatognosis is the ability to perceive one's own body parts. 自我身體覺知是感知自己身體部位的能力。
Stroke patients may suffer from a loss of autosomatognosis. 中風患者可能會失去自我身體覺知。
The doctor tested the patient's autosomatognostic functions. 醫生測試了患者的自我身體覺知功能。
An autosomatognostic disorder can lead to disorientation. 自我身體覺知障礙會導致定向障礙。
An autosome is any chromosome that is not a sex chromosome. 常染色體是除性染色體以外的任何染色體。
Geneticists map genes on each autosome. 遺傳學家在每條常染色體上繪製基因圖譜。

meaning: 自救的；依靠自身力量獲得救贖的
sentences: The philosophy promotes an autosoteric approach to life. 這種哲學提倡一種自救的人生方式。
His beliefs are largely autosoteric in nature. 他的信仰在性質上主要是自救的。
Autosoterism suggests that individuals can achieve salvation alone. 自救論認為個人可以獨自實現救贖。
Many Eastern religions incorporate elements of autosoterism. 許多東方宗教包含自救論的元素。
An autospore is an asexual spore that resembles the parent cell. 似親孢子是一種與親本細胞相似的無性孢子。
Some green algae reproduce via the formation of autospores. 一些綠藻通過形成似親孢子進行繁殖。
The plant undergoes an autosporic reproduction cycle. 該植物經歷一個似親孢子的繁殖週期。
Autosporic development is common in certain types of algae. 似親孢子的發育在某些類型的藻類中很常見。
The garden is equipped with an autospray system for watering. 花園配備了自動噴霧系統進行澆水。
Check the autospray for any clogs regularly. 定期檢查自動噴霧器是否有堵塞。
The aircraft features high autostability even in turbulence. 該飛機即使在湍流中也具有很高的自動穩定性。
Engineers worked to improve the autostability of the vehicle. 工程師們致力於提高車輛的自動穩定性。
The microscope's autostage allows for precise scanning of samples. 顯微鏡的自動載物台允許對樣本進行精確掃描。
Software controls the movements of the autostage. 軟體控制自動載物台的移動。
Autostandardization helps maintain consistency in data processing. 自動標準化有助於維持數據處理的一致性。
The system performs autostandardization before analyzing results. 該系統在分析結果前執行自動標準化。
The generator is equipped with an autostarter. 發電機配備了自動啟動器。
Press the button to engage the autostarter. 按下按鈕以啟動自動啟動器。
The autostethoscope can record heart sounds for later review. 自動聽診器可以記錄心音以供稍後查看。
Doctors use the autostethoscope to monitor patients remotely. 醫生使用自動聽診器遠程監測患者。
The shark's jaw suspension is not autostylic. 鯊魚的頜骨懸掛不是自接型的。
An autostylic skull structure is found in some primitive vertebrates. 在一些原始脊椎動物中發現了自接型顱骨結構。
Autostylism is a characteristic feature of lungfish. 自接型構造是肺魚的一個特徵。
Biologists studied the evolution of autostylism in fish. 生物學家研究了魚類中自接型構造的進化。
Autostyly involves the direct attachment of the upper jaw to the skull. 自接涉及上頜與顱骨的直接連接。
Different types of jaw suspension include hyostyly and autostyly. 不同類型的頜骨懸掛包括舌接型和自接型。

meaning: 自律暗示性；易受自我暗示的傾向
sentences: His high autosuggestibility made the therapy very effective. 他極高的自律暗示性使治療非常有效。
Autosuggestibility varies greatly among different people. 易受自我暗示的傾向在不同人之間差異很大。
People who are autosuggestible can often heal faster through positive thinking. 易受自我暗示的人通常可以通過積極思考癒合得更快。
She proved to be highly autosuggestible during the session. 在那一節中，她被證明是極易受自我暗示的。
Through autosuggestion, he convinced himself he was not afraid. 通過自我暗示，他說服自己並不害怕。
Autosuggestion is a common technique used in meditation. 自我暗示是冥想中常用的技術。

meaning: 自我暗示者；自我暗示研究者
sentences: The autosuggestionist taught the class to repeat calm phrases. 那位自我暗示研究者教全班重複平靜的短句。
As an autosuggestionist, she trusted repeated affirmations. 作為一名自我暗示者，她相信反覆肯定的力量。
Positive affirmations are a form of autosuggestive practice. 積極的肯定語是自我暗示練習的一種形式。
The therapist recommended autosuggestive exercises. 治療師建議進行自我暗示練習。
Autosuppression is a mechanism used by cells to control growth. 自我抑制是細胞用來控制生長的機制。
The study examined the role of autosuppression in immune responses. 研究探討了自我抑制在免疫反應中的作用。
The relationship between the two organelles is autosymbiontic. 這兩個細胞器之間的關係是自體共生的。
Autosymbiontic organisms provide insights into cellular evolution. 自體共生生物提供了關於細胞進化的見解。
The dream had an autosymbolic meaning related to his career. 這個夢具有一個與他的職業相關的自我象徵意義。
His art style is highly autosymbolic. 他的藝術風格具有高度的自我象徵性。
The autosymbolical nature of the poem was clear to the critics. 詩歌的自我象徵性質對評論家來說很清楚。
They analyzed the autosymbolical elements in the ritual. 他們分析了儀式中的自我象徵元素。
The images in the film function autosymbolically. 電影中的圖像起著自我象徵的作用。
He expressed his fears autosymbolically through music. 他通過音樂自我象徵地表達了他的恐懼。

meaning: 自我意識缺失；自我意識異常
sentences: Autosymnoia is a rare psychological condition. 自我意識異常是一種罕見的心理狀況。
Research into autosymnoia helps understand the nature of self. 對自我意識異常的研究有助於理解自我的本質。

meaning: 自動同步機；自整角機（商標名）
sentences: The engineer used an Autosyn to synchronize the two shafts. 工程師使用自動同步機來同步兩個軸。
Autosyn is a registered trademark for certain types of synchros. Autosyn 是某些類型自整角機的註冊商標。

meaning: 自體聯接（減數分裂中同源染色體的聯接）
sentences: Autosyndesis occurs in some polyploid organisms. 自體聯接發生在某些多倍體生物中。
The study of autosyndesis provides clues about chromosomal evolution. 對自體聯接的研究提供了關於染色體進化的線索。
The autotelegraph revolutionized long-distance communication. 自動電報機徹底改變了遠距離通訊。
Old models of the autotelegraph are now museum pieces. 舊型號的自動電報機現在是博物館的藏品。

meaning: 自成目的的；本身即為目的的
sentences: Playing for the sake of play is an autotelic activity. 為了玩而玩是一種自成目的的活動。
He finds writing to be an autotelic experience. 他發現寫作是一種自成目的的體驗。
The autotetraploid plant has four sets of chromosomes from the same species. 同源四倍體植物具有來自同一物種的四組染色體。
Autotetraploid induction is a common technique in plant breeding. 同源四倍體誘導是植物育種中的常用技術。
Autotetraploidy can lead to larger fruit size in some crops. 同源四倍性在某些作物中可以導致更大的果實尺寸。
Researchers studied the genetic stability of autotetraploidy. 研究人員研究了同源四倍性的遺傳穩定性。

meaning: 自吹自擂的神蹟表演者
sentences: The street performer was an autothaumaturgist of the highest order. 那位街頭表演者是一位最高等級的自吹自擂的神蹟表演者。
He dismissed the claims of the autothaumaturgist. 他對那位神蹟表演者的說辭不屑一顧。
The autotheater was packed on Saturday night. 汽車影院在週六晚上擠滿了人。
Watching movies at an autotheater is a nostalgic experience. 在汽車影院看電影是一種懷舊的體驗。

meaning: 自神論；視自己為神的教義
sentences: Autotheism is a central theme in some esoteric philosophies. 自神論是某些深奧哲學的中心主題。
Critics view autotheism as a form of extreme narcissism. 評論家將自神論視為一種極端自戀的形式。
The tyrant acted like an autotheist. 那個暴君舉止就像自神論者。
The king behaved as an autotheist and demanded worship. 國王像自神論者一樣行事，還要求人膜拜。
Meditation is often used for its autotherapeutic benefits. 冥想常因其自我治療的益處而被使用。
She followed an autotherapeutic regimen to recover from stress. 她遵循一套自我治療方案以從壓力中恢復。
Autotherapy can include exercises and dietary changes. 自我治療可以包括運動和飲食改變。
He practiced autotherapy to manage his chronic pain. 他練習自我治療來管理他的慢性疼痛。
Autothermy is observed in some large sea turtles. 在一些大型海龜中可以觀察到自溫性。
The study focuses on the mechanism of autothermy in insects. 研究集中在昆蟲自溫性的機制上。
The lizard has an autotomic tail that can break off easily. 這隻蜥蜴有一條可以輕易斷裂的自切尾巴。
Autotomic behavior is a defense mechanism against predators. 自切行為是一種對抗捕食者的防禦機制。
The crab may autotomize a claw to escape from a trap. 螃蟹可能會自切一隻螯以從陷阱中逃脫。
When threatened, certain animals will autotomize their limbs. 當受到威脅時，某些動物會自切其肢體。

The autotomous nature of the appendage aids in survival. 附屬器官的自切特性有助於生存。
Autotomy is the voluntary shedding of a body part. 自切是自願脫落身體部位的行為。

Autotoxaemia can result from poor digestion and waste buildup. 自身中毒可能是由於消化不良和廢物堆積引起的。
The patient was treated for symptoms of autotoxaemia. 患者因自身中毒的症狀接受治療。

Autotoxicity in plants prevents them from growing near their own species. 植物中的自身毒性防止它們在同種植物附近生長。
The experiment measured the level of autotoxicity in the soil. 實驗測量了土壤中的自身毒性水平。

Dietary adjustments were made to treat the autotoxicosis. 進行了飲食調整以治療自身中毒症。
An autotoxin is a toxin produced within the body. 自身毒素是體內產生的毒素。
Scientists are isolating the autotoxin from the blood sample. 科學家正在從血液樣本中分離自身毒素。
Autotoxis occurs when metabolic wastes are not eliminated. 當代謝廢物未被排除時，就會發生自身中毒。
The lecture covered the historical concept of autotoxis. 講座涵蓋了自身中毒的歷史概念。
The autotractor can plow fields without a human driver. 自動拖拉機可以在沒有人類駕駛員的情況下犁地。
Modern farms are increasingly using autotractor technology. 現代農場越來越多地使用自動拖拉機技術。
An autotransformer is more efficient than a traditional transformer. 自耦變壓器比傳統變壓器更有效率。
The technician replaced the faulty autotransformer. 技術人員更換了故障的自耦變壓器。
Autotransfusion reduces the risk of immune reactions. 自體輸血降低了免疫反應的風險。
The surgeon recommended autotransfusion for the upcoming operation. 外科醫生建議為即將進行的手術進行自體輸血。
The doctors decided to autotransplant skin from the patient's leg. 醫生決定從患者腿部進行自體皮膚移植。
Success rates for autotransplant procedures are generally high. 自體移植手術的成功率通常很高。
Autotransplantation of bone marrow is used in cancer treatments. 骨髓自體移植法用於癌症治療。
The patient recovered quickly after the autotransplantation. 患者在自體移植後恢復得很快。
Autotrepanation is a dangerous practice with ancient roots. 自我環鑽術是一種具有古代根源的危險做法。
The documentary explored the bizarre culture of autotrepanation. 紀錄片探討了自我環鑽術這種奇怪的文化。
Autotriploid fish are often sterile. 同源三倍體魚類通常是不育的。
The autotriploid condition was confirmed by genetic testing. 同源三倍體狀況已通過基因檢測確認。
Autotriploidy can result from the fusion of a diploid and haploid gamete. 同源三倍性可以由二倍體和單倍體配子的融合產生。
Agricultural researchers use autotriploidy to produce seedless fruits. 農業研究人員利用同源三倍性來生產無籽果實。
An autotroph produces its own food from inorganic substances. 自養生物從無機物質中產生自己的食物。
Plants are the most common type of autotroph. 植物是最常見的自養生物。
Autotrophic organisms form the base of the food chain. 自養生物構成了食物鏈的基礎。
The bacteria use an autotrophic metabolic pathway. 這種細菌使用自養代謝途徑。
Autotrophy is essential for the survival of the ecosystem. 自養作用對生態系統的生存至關重要。
The course covers the differences between heterotrophy and autotrophy. 課程涵蓋了異養作用和自養作用之間的差異。
The plant exhibits autotropic growth in response to gravity. 植物對重力表現出自向性生長。
Autotropic movements help the organism orient itself. 自向性運動有助於生物體定向。
The roots grew autotropically downward. 根自向性地向下生長。
The cells aligned autotropically along the gradient. 細胞沿著梯度自向性地排列。
Autotropism is the tendency of an organ to grow in a straight line. 自向性是器官直線生長的傾向。
The study investigated the causes of autotropism in seedlings. 研究調查了幼苗自向性的原因。
The autotruck delivered the supplies to the factory. 自動載重汽車將物資送到工廠。

Autotuberculin was used in some historical medical trials. 自體結核菌素曾用於一些歷史性的醫學試驗。

The factory upgraded its machines for autoturning capabilities. 工廠升級了機器以具備自動車削能力。
Autoturning increases the speed of component production. 自動車削提高了零件生產的速度。
Autotype is an early photographic printing process. 碳版印相是一種早期的攝影印刷製程。
The museum has several autotype prints in its collection. 博物館收藏了幾張碳版印相照片。
Autotyphization is a rare medical phenomenon. 自體傷寒化是一種罕見的醫學現象。
The report detailed the clinical signs of autotyphization. 報告詳細描述了自體傷寒化的臨床徵象。
The autotypic process produces very durable prints. 碳版印相製程生產出非常耐用的印刷品。
They examined the autotypic features of the document. 他們檢查了文件的自型特徵。
Autotypography was a popular method for reproducing maps. 自動印刷術曾是複製地圖的一種流行方法。
The book provides a history of autotypography. 這本書提供了自動印刷術的歷史。
Autotypy allows for high-quality image reproduction. 碳版印相法可以實現高品質的圖像複製。

Autourine therapy is a controversial alternative medicine practice. 自體尿液療法是一種有爭議的替代醫學實踐。
The practitioner claimed benefits from the use of autourine. 從業者聲稱使用自體尿液有好處。
Autovaccination involves using a vaccine derived from the patient's own tissues. 自體疫苗接種涉及使用源自患者自身組織的疫苗。
The patient underwent autovaccination to boost their immune system. 患者接受了自體疫苗接種以增強其免疫系統。
The autovaccine was custom-made for the individual patient. 自體疫苗是為個別患者定制的。

meaning: 自動清潔機；自動停車系統
sentences: The hotel installed an autovalet system in the parking garage. 飯店在停車場安裝了自動停車系統。

The autovalve controls the flow of steam in the pipes. 自動閥控制管道中蒸汽的流動。
A failed autovalve led to the system's overheating. 故障的自動閥導致系統過熱。
Autovivisection is an extreme and dangerous form of self-surgery. 自我活體解剖是一種極端且危險的自我手術形式。
The story mentions a scientist who performed autovivisection for research. 故事提到了一位為了研究而進行自我活體解剖的科學家。

Autoxidation can cause oils to become rancid over time. 自氧化作用會導致油隨著時間的推移而變質。

The autoxidizability of different fats was compared in the study. 研究比較了不同脂肪的自氧化能力。
Moisture can increase the autoxidizability of certain materials. 濕氣可以增加某些材料的自氧化能力。
These chemicals are highly autoxidizable and must be stored carefully. 這些化學品極易自氧化，必須小心存放。
The autoxidizable nature of the compound makes it unstable. 該化合物易自氧化的特性使其不穩定。
The metal will autoxidize when exposed to moist air. 當金屬暴露在潮濕空氣中時會發生自氧化。

An autoxidizer is a substance that undergoes spontaneous oxidation. 自氧化劑是會發生自發氧化的物質。
The presence of an autoxidizer accelerated the degradation process. 自氧化劑的存在加速了降解過程。
In a bryozoan colony, the autozooid is responsible for feeding. 在苔蘚蟲群落中，獨立個蟲負責攝食。
The structure of the autozooid was examined under a microscope. 在顯微鏡下檢查了獨立個蟲的結構。

meaning: 從前的；在別的時候的（法律術語）
sentences: The old statute used autrefois for a former event. 那部舊法規用這個法文法律詞來表示往昔事件。

meaning: 某人或某物已經過了鼎盛時期的時期。
sentences: The term autumn refers to the time period when someone or something is past its prime. 秋天這個字指的是某人或某物已經過了鼎盛時期的時期。
The lesson introduced autumn as a useful term to understand. 本課介紹了秋天作為一個易於理解的有用術語。
The autumnal leaves are changing color. 秋天的葉子正在變色。

The weather has turned autumnally crisp. 天氣已變得秋意盎然且清爽。
The room was decorated autumnally with pumpkins and dried leaves. 房間用南瓜和枯葉裝飾得非常有秋天氣息。

Autunite is a yellow-green fluorescent mineral. 鈣鈾雲母是一種黃綠色的螢光礦物。
The miners identified the autunite by its glow under UV light. 礦工們通過它在紫外線下的光芒辨認出鈣鈾雲母。
Auxamylase enhances the activity of amylase in the digestion process. 助澱粉酶在消化過程中增強澱粉酶的活性。
The researcher is investigating the chemical structure of auxamylase. 研究人員正在調查助澱粉酶的化學結構。
The auxanogram showed the growth response of the bacteria to different nutrients. 生長圖顯示了細菌對不同營養物質的生長反應。
Scientists analyzed the auxanogram to determine the optimal conditions for growth. 科學家分析生長圖以確定最佳生長條件。

His speech built with auxesis until it filled the hall. 他的演說一路用誇飾推升，最後填滿了整個大廳。

The company offers auxiliatory services to its clients. 公司向其客戶提供輔助服務。
Auxiliatory power was activated during the blackout. 停電期間啟動了輔助電源。

meaning: 援助；協助（法律或歷史術語）
sentences: The treaty promised mutual auxilium in case of attack. 該條約承諾在受到攻擊時相互援助。

Auxin is responsible for regulating plant cell elongation. 生長素負責調節植物細胞的伸長。

sentences: The tissue was treated auxinically to stimulate growth. 該組織經生長素處理以刺激生長。

Auxoamylase plays a role in breaking down starches. 助澱粉酶在分解澱粉中起作用。
The level of auxoamylase was measured in the sample. 樣本中測量了助澱粉酶的水平。
The auxoblast contributes to the formation of new tissues. 助生細胞有助於新組織的形成。
Microscopic analysis revealed the presence of auxoblasts. 顯微鏡分析揭示了助生細胞的存在。
The auxobody is a specialized structure in some organisms. 助長體是某些生物體中的特殊結構。

Auxocardia can be a sign of underlying heart disease. 心臟肥大可能是潛在心臟病的徵兆。

An auxochrome is a group of atoms that intensifies the color of a dye. 助色團是一組能增強染料顏色的原子。

The auxochromic effect was analyzed using spectroscopy. 助色效應使用光譜學進行了分析。
Certain functional groups have auxochromic properties. 某些官能基具有助色特性。
Auxochromism explains why certain dyes are more vibrant. 助色現象解釋了為什麼某些染料更鮮豔。
He wrote a dissertation on the theory of auxochromism. 他寫了一篇關於助色現象理論的論文。
Auxochromous groups are essential for high-quality pigments. 助色基團對於高品質顏料至關重要。
The molecule contains several auxochromous atoms. 該分子包含幾個助色原子。
An auxocyte is a cell that is about to undergo meiosis. 性母細胞是即將進行減數分裂的細胞。

Auxoflore is hypothesized to stimulate flowering in some plants. 助花素被假設能刺激某些植物開花。
The researchers applied auxoflore to the crop. 研究人員將助花素應用於作物。
The auxofluor enhances the brightness of the fluorescent probe. 助螢光團增強了螢光探針的亮度。
They synthesized a new dye with an efficient auxofluor. 他們合成了一種帶有高效助螢光團的新染料。
The auxograph provides a continuous record of plant growth. 植物生長記錄儀提供植物生長的連續記錄。
Data from the auxograph showed a spike in growth after watering. 來自植物生長記錄儀的數據顯示澆水後生長激增。

meaning: 助張的；（肌肉）收縮時張力增加的
sentences: An auxotonic contraction occurs when the muscle shortens against an increasing load. 當肌肉對抗增加的負荷而縮短時，會發生助張收縮。

The class notes used Axonia only as a placeholder name. 課堂筆記只把它當作臨時名稱。

meaning: 無軸動物亞目（動物分類）
sentences: Axonolipa includes various microscopic organisms. 無軸動物亞目包括多種微觀生物。
The biologist specialized in Axonolipa research. 生物學家專門從事無軸動物亞目的研究。

meaning: 有軸神經亞綱（動物分類）

Axonophorous cells are vital for signal transmission. 具有軸突的細胞對於信號傳輸至關重要。

The lawn was composed primarily of Axonopus fissifolius. 草坪主要由類地毯草組成。

meaning: 軸骨（魚類鰭條的支撐結構）
sentences: The axonost supports the dorsal fin of the fish. 軸骨支撐著魚的背鰭。
Ichthyologists examined the structure of the axonost. 魚類學家檢查了軸骨的結構。
The axopetal movement was observed under the microscope. 在顯微鏡下觀察到向軸運動。
Fluid flows in an axopetal direction within the system. 流體在系統內向軸方向流動。

meaning: 軸生植物（指具有中軸的植物）
sentences: An axophyte grows around a central axis. 軸生植物圍繞中心軸生長。

meaning: 軸桿（某些原生動物體內的支撐結構）

meaning: 阿克蘇姆人；阿克蘇姆王國的
sentences: The Axumite Empire was a major power in ancient Ethiopia. 阿克蘇姆帝國是古代衣索比亞的主要強權。
